senses.meaningEn: a period of time when a teacher teaches a group of students

examples.en: I have an English class at nine.
Don't be late for class again.

senses.note: 수업에 가다는 go to class(관사 없음). in class = 수업 중에.

senses.meaningEn: a group of students who are taught together

examples.en: There are thirty students in my class.
examples.ko: 우리 반에는 학생이 서른 명 있어.

examples.en: She's the smartest girl in our class.
examples.ko: 그 애는 우리 반에서 가장 똑똑한 여자애야.

senses.note: classmate = 같은 반 친구. 한국의 '3학년 2반'은 class 2 처럼 표현.

senses.meaningEn: a person who is in the same class as you at school

examples.en: My classmate helped me with my homework.
We were classmates in high school.

senses.note: 친한 사이가 아니어도 같은 반이면 classmate. '동창'은 old classmate, 학교 전체 동기는 schoolmate.

senses.meaningEn: a room in a school where lessons happen

examples.en: Please be quiet in the classroom.
Our classroom is on the second floor.

senses.note: in the classroom = 교실 안에서. 한 단어로 붙여 씀(class room ✗).

senses.meaningEn: not dirty

examples.en: Your room looks really clean today.
examples.ko: 오늘 네 방 정말 깨끗해 보인다.

examples.en: Is this cup clean?

senses.note: clean clothes = 깨끗한(세탁한) 옷. clean water = 깨끗한 물.

senses.meaningEn: to remove dirt from something

examples.en: I clean my room every Sunday.
Can you help me clean the kitchen?

senses.note: clean up = 치우다, 정리하다 (Clean up your mess!). do the cleaning = 청소를 하다.

senses.meaningEn: a person who helps customers and sells things in a store

examples.en: The clerk helped me find the right size.
Ask the clerk if they have more in the back.
examples.ko: 뒤에 재고가 더 있는지 점원에게 물어봐.

senses.note: 미국식 발음 /klɜːrk/, 영국식은 /klɑːk/. sales clerk, store clerk 라고도 함. 호텔 프런트 직원은 front desk clerk.

senses.meaningEn: a person whose job is to keep records and do office work

examples.en: She works as a clerk at the city office.
The clerk asked me to fill out a form.

senses.note: bank clerk(은행 직원), office clerk(사무원). 미국에서는 cashier 와 clerk 를 섞어 쓰는 경우도 많음.

senses.meaningEn: quick to learn and understand things

examples.en: She's a clever student and learns fast.
My dog is clever. He opens doors by himself.
examples.ko: 우리 개는 영리해서 혼자 문을 열어.

senses.note: 영국식에서 흔하고 미국식은 smart 를 더 씀. 미국에서 clever 는 '재치 있는, 머리를 잘 쓴'의 느낌이 강함.

senses.meaningEn: showing a smart or unusual way of doing something

examples.en: What a clever idea!
That's a clever way to save money.

senses.note: too clever = 지나치게 머리를 쓰는(약간 부정적). Don't be too clever. = 너무 잘난 척하지 마.

senses.meaningEn: to press a button on a mouse or touch a link on a screen

examples.en: Click the blue button to start.
Don't click on links from strangers.
examples.ko: 모르는 사람이 보낸 링크는 누르지 마.

senses.note: click (on) + 대상. 더블 클릭은 double-click, 길게 누르기는 press and hold. 휴대폰 화면은 tap 을 더 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to go up something using your hands and feet

examples.en: We climbed the mountain in four hours.
examples.ko: 우리는 네 시간 만에 산에 올랐어.

examples.en: The cat climbed up the tree quickly.

senses.note: climb 의 b 는 묵음 — /klaɪm/. climb a mountain(산을 오르다)에는 전치사가 없고, climb up/down(올라가다/내려가다)은 방향을 강조.

senses.meaningEn: to move up or into something, often slowly or with effort

examples.en: I climbed the stairs to the fifth floor.
Grandpa climbed into the car slowly.

senses.note: climb the stairs = go up the stairs. climb into/out of a car 는 몸을 움직여 타고 내리는 느낌. 명사 climbing(등산·클라이밍)도 자주 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a device on a wall or table that shows the time

examples.en: The clock on the wall is five minutes fast.
Look at the clock. We're going to be late!

senses.note: 손목시계는 watch, 벽·탁상시계는 clock. 알람시계 = alarm clock. '시계 방향'은 clockwise. 한국어 '시계'를 전부 clock 으로 옮기지 않도록 주의.

senses.meaningEn: to shut something such as a door, window, or book

examples.en: Please close the window, it's getting cold.
examples.ko: 창문 좀 닫아 줘, 추워지고 있어.

examples.en: Close your eyes and make a wish.

senses.note: 동사는 /kloʊz/(즈). close the door/window/book/eyes. shut 보다 부드럽고 정중한 느낌.

senses.meaningEn: to stop being open for business for the day or for good

examples.en: The store closes at nine on weekdays.
The bank is closed on Sundays.

senses.note: What time do you close? = 몇 시에 닫아요? 간판: CLOSED / OPEN. 폐업하다 = close down.

senses.meaningEn: near in distance or time

examples.en: The station is close to my house.
Is the hotel close to the beach?

senses.note: 형용사는 /kloʊs/(스) 로 발음이 다름. close to + 장소. 비슷하게 near 도 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: knowing someone very well and liking them a lot

examples.en: We've been close friends since high school.
I'm very close to my older sister.

senses.note: a close friend = 친한 친구, be close to 사람 = ~와 친하다. 발음 /kloʊs/.

senses.meaningEn: a small room or a space in a wall where you keep clothes or other things

examples.en: Hang your coat in the closet.
My closet is full, but I have nothing to wear.
examples.ko: 옷장은 꽉 찼는데 입을 게 없어.

senses.note: 미국식. 영국에서는 wardrobe. 서서 들어가는 큰 옷방은 walk-in closet. 가구형 옷장은 wardrobe.

senses.meaningEn: things such as shirts, pants, and dresses that you wear on your body

examples.en: I need to buy some new clothes for winter.
examples.ko: 겨울 옷을 몇 벌 새로 사야 해.

examples.en: Put your dirty clothes in the basket.

senses.note: 항상 복수형(a clothes 는 틀림). 한 점은 a piece of clothing, 셀 때는 some clothes. 발음은 close(닫다)와 같은 /kloʊz/. cloth 는 '천'.

senses.meaningEn: a white or gray shape in the sky made of tiny drops of water

examples.en: Look at that big white cloud!
Dark clouds mean rain is coming.

senses.note: 셀 수 있는 명사: a cloud, clouds. 비구름 = rain cloud. on cloud nine = 너무 행복해서 구름 위에 떠 있는 기분.

senses.meaningEn: a service that stores your files on the internet

examples.en: I save all my photos to the cloud.
Your files are backed up in the cloud.

senses.note: 항상 the cloud. in the cloud(클라우드에), cloud storage(클라우드 저장 공간).

senses.meaningEn: with many clouds in the sky

examples.en: It's cloudy, but I don't think it will rain.
examples.ko: 흐리긴 한데 비는 안 올 것 같아.

examples.en: The sky was cloudy all afternoon.

senses.note: 흐림 정도: partly cloudy(구름 조금) < cloudy(흐림) < overcast(잔뜩 흐림).

senses.meaningEn: not clear; hard to see through

examples.en: The water looks a little cloudy.
Don't drink it if the juice is cloudy.

senses.meaningEn: a group of people who meet regularly to share an interest or activity

examples.en: I'm in the art club at school.
Do you want to join our book club?

senses.note: 한국어 '클럽'은 주로 나이트클럽을 떠올리지만, 영어 club 의 기본 뜻은 '동호회'. join a club = 동아리에 들다.

senses.meaningEn: a stick used to hit the ball in golf, or a sports team and its organization

examples.en: He hit the ball with a golf club.
Which football club do you support?

senses.meaningEn: a place where people go at night to dance and drink

examples.en: They went dancing at a club last night.
examples.ko: 그 사람들 어젯밤에 클럽 가서 춤췄어.

examples.en: The club opens at ten.

senses.note: go clubbing = 클럽에 가다(놀러). nightclub 이라고 풀어 쓰면 뜻이 더 분명함.

senses.meaningEn: a person who trains a sports team or player

examples.en: Our coach makes us run every morning.
examples.ko: 우리 코치는 매일 아침 우리를 뛰게 해.

examples.en: The coach was happy with the win.

senses.note: 미국 스포츠에서 '감독'은 coach(head coach). 야구 감독만 manager 라고 함. 호칭으로 Coach Kim 처럼 쓰기도.

senses.meaningEn: to teach and train a person or team, especially in a sport

examples.en: My dad coaches my little brother's soccer team.
She coached me before the big test.
examples.ko: 그녀가 큰 시험 전에 나를 지도해 줬어.

senses.note: 스포츠 외에도 life coach, speaking coach 처럼 개인 지도에 씀. teach 보다 '실전 훈련'의 느낌.

senses.meaningEn: in the UK a long-distance bus; in the US the cheapest seats on a plane or train

examples.en: We took a coach from London to Oxford.
I always fly coach to save money.
examples.ko: 나는 돈을 아끼려고 늘 일반석을 타.

senses.note: 영국의 coach 는 시외버스, 미국의 fly coach 는 '이코노미석으로 가다'. 유명 가방 브랜드 이름도 같음.

senses.meaningEn: a long warm piece of clothing worn over other clothes when you go outside

examples.en: Put on your coat before you go out.
I lost a button on my winter coat.

senses.note: raincoat(비옷), winter coat. 짧은 겉옷은 jacket.

senses.meaningEn: a layer of paint or another liquid spread over a surface

examples.en: The wall needs another coat of paint.
examples.ko: 벽에 페인트를 한 번 더 칠해야 해.

examples.en: Give the door two coats of white paint.
examples.ko: 문에 흰 페인트를 두 번 칠해.

senses.note: a coat of paint = 페인트 한 겹. 동물의 '털'도 coat 라고 함(a dog's coat).

senses.meaningEn: a hot, dark brown drink made from roasted beans

examples.en: I can't start my day without coffee.
examples.ko: 커피 없이는 하루를 시작할 수 없어.

examples.en: How do you take your coffee?

senses.note: How do you take your coffee? = 커피에 뭐 넣어 드세요?(설탕·우유 여부). black coffee = 아무것도 안 넣은 커피.

senses.meaningEn: a cup of coffee, or a short meeting where people drink coffee together

examples.en: Two coffees, please.
Let's grab a coffee sometime this week.

senses.note: grab a coffee / get a coffee = 가볍게 커피 마시며 만나자는 표현. 잔 단위로는 a coffee, two coffees 처럼 셀 수 있음.

senses.meaningEn: a small, flat, round piece of metal used as money

examples.en: Do you have any coins for the parking meter?
I keep my coins in a small jar.

senses.note: 미국 동전: penny(1센트), nickel(5), dime(10), quarter(25). 지폐는 bill. 잔돈 전체는 change.

senses.meaningEn: a sweet, brown, bubbly drink

examples.en: I'll have a cola, no ice.
Cola has a lot of sugar in it.

senses.note: 일상에서는 cola 보다 Coke(코카콜라) 나 Pepsi 같은 상표명을 더 자주 말함. 미국 남부에서는 모든 탄산음료를 coke 라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: having a low temperature

examples.en: It's so cold outside today.
Can I have a glass of cold water?

senses.note: '춥다'는 I'm cold, 날씨는 It's cold.

senses.meaningEn: a common illness that makes you sneeze and cough

examples.en: I think I'm catching a cold.
She has a bad cold and stayed home.

senses.note: catch a cold / have a cold. 관사 a 를 꼭 붙임.

senses.meaningEn: unfriendly and showing no emotion

examples.en: Why are you being so cold to me?
He gave me a cold look and walked away.
examples.ko: 그는 나를 차갑게 쳐다보고 가 버렸어.

senses.meaningEn: to get and keep things of one kind because you like them

examples.en: My son collects stamps from different countries.
I've collected over fifty coins so far.

senses.note: 취미로 모으는 것은 collect, 돈을 저축하듯 모으는 것은 save. 명사 collection(수집품), 사람은 collector.

senses.meaningEn: to bring things together from several people or places

examples.en: The teacher collected our homework after class.
We're collecting money for a birthday gift.
examples.ko: 생일 선물 사려고 돈을 모으고 있어.

senses.note: collect the papers/homework = 걷다. 영국식으로 '사람·물건을 데리러·가지러 가다'(collect the kids)도 되나 미국식은 pick up.

senses.meaningEn: the quality of something that makes it red, blue, green, etc.

examples.en: What's your favorite color?
This shirt comes in three colors.
examples.ko: 이 셔츠는 세 가지 색으로 나와.

senses.note: color(미) / colour(영). 색을 물을 때 What color is it? (What color does it have? ✗).

senses.meaningEn: to put color on a picture with crayons or pencils

examples.en: Color the apple red and the leaf green.
My daughter loves coloring books.
examples.ko: 우리 딸은 색칠 공부 책을 좋아해.

senses.note: color in = (선 안을) 색칠하다. coloring book = 색칠 공부 책. 머리를 염색하다는 dye 또는 color one's hair.

senses.meaningEn: a flat tool with thin teeth used for making your hair tidy

examples.en: Do you have a comb I can borrow?
I keep a small comb in my bag.

senses.note: b 는 발음하지 않는다 [코움]. 솔 형태의 빗은 brush, 납작한 빗은 comb.

senses.meaningEn: to make your hair tidy using a comb

examples.en: Comb your hair before we go out.
He combed his hair back neatly.

senses.meaningEn: to move toward the speaker or a place

examples.en: Can you come here for a second?
The bus is coming. Hurry up!

senses.meaningEn: to go somewhere together with the listener

examples.en: We're going to lunch. Do you want to come?
examples.ko: 우리 점심 먹으러 가는데, 같이 갈래?

examples.en: Come with me, I'll show you the way.

senses.note: 듣는 사람 쪽으로 가는 건 go 가 아니라 come. I'm coming! = 지금 가요!

senses.meaningEn: to be available in a particular form, size, or color

examples.en: Does this shirt come in a smaller size?
examples.ko: 이 셔츠 더 작은 사이즈도 나와요?

examples.en: The phone comes in three colors.
examples.ko: 이 폰은 세 가지 색상으로 나와.

senses.note: come in + 사이즈/색상. 쇼핑할 때 매우 유용한 표현.

senses.meaningEn: used to tell someone to hurry or to encourage them

examples.en: Come on, we're going to be late!
Come on, you can do it!

senses.meaningEn: used to show you do not believe or agree with someone

examples.en: Come on, that's not true.
Oh, come on. Don't be like that.

senses.note: 말투에 따라 '설마', '왜 이래', '제발' 등으로 뜻이 달라짐.

senses.meaningEn: to start working, especially a light or machine

examples.en: The lights come on at seven every evening.
The heater comes on when it gets cold.

senses.meaningEn: a magazine or book that tells a story with pictures and short text

examples.en: I read comic books every weekend.
He has over two hundred comic books.
examples.ko: 그는 만화책이 이백 권 넘게 있어.

senses.note: 한국·일본식 만화책은 manhwa / manga 라고도 함. '만화책'을 cartoon book 이라고 하면 틀림. 짧게 comics 라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: to look at two or more things to see how they are different or similar

examples.en: Compare the prices before you buy.
We compared the two phones in the store.
examples.ko: 우리는 매장에서 두 폰을 비교해 봤어.

senses.note: compare A with/to B. compared to/with ... = ~와 비교하면. 명사는 comparison.

senses.meaningEn: to say that one person or thing is like another

examples.en: Don't compare me to my brother.
People often compare her voice to a bird.
examples.ko: 사람들은 자주 그녀의 목소리를 새에 비유해.

senses.note: 부모가 자녀를 다른 아이와 비교할 때 compare 사용. 비교당하는 사람 입장에선 기분 나쁜 뉘앙스.

senses.meaningEn: an electronic machine that stores information and runs programs

examples.en: I use my computer for work every day.
My computer is really slow today.

senses.note: on the computer = 컴퓨터로. 데스크톱은 desktop, PC 라고도 함. computer game, computer science.

senses.meaningEn: a live performance of music in front of an audience

examples.en: We're going to a concert on Saturday.
The concert tickets sold out in ten minutes.

senses.note: go to a concert(콘서트에 가다), give/play a concert(공연하다). 발음은 '콘서트'가 아니라 첫 음절 강세 /ˈkɑːn-/. 콘서트홀은 concert hall.

senses.meaningEn: to have something inside

examples.en: Does this dish contain nuts?
The box contains twelve eggs.
examples.ko: 그 상자에는 달걀 열두 개가 들어 있어.

senses.note: 알레르기 질문에 필수. 주어는 그릇/문서 등 '담는 것'. 명사 container = 용기, 통.

senses.meaningEn: to prepare food by heating it

examples.en: I usually cook dinner for my family.
Can you cook Korean food?

senses.note: cook 은 불을 써서 조리할 때. 샐러드처럼 불 없이 '만들다'는 make 를 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to become ready to eat by being heated

examples.en: The rice is still cooking.
Cook the eggs for about five minutes.

senses.meaningEn: a person who cooks food

examples.en: My dad is a really good cook.
She works as a cook at a school.

senses.note: '요리사'를 cooker 라고 하면 틀림. cooker 는 영국식으로 '조리 기구(가스레인지)'. 사람은 cook 또는 chef.

senses.meaningEn: a small, flat, sweet cake that is baked until crisp

examples.en: Grandma baked chocolate chip cookies.
Can I have one more cookie?

senses.note: 미국식 cookie = 영국식 biscuit. 미국에서 biscuit 은 부드러운 빵 종류.

senses.meaningEn: a small file a website saves on your computer to remember you

examples.en: This website asks me to accept cookies.
Try clearing your cookies and logging in again.

senses.note: accept/clear cookies. 거의 항상 복수형 cookies 로 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a little cold, in a pleasant way

examples.en: It's nice and cool in the morning.
Keep the juice in a cool place.

senses.note: cold(추운)보다 약하고 긍정적인 느낌. 날씨·음료·방 온도에 두루 씀.

senses.meaningEn: very good, fashionable, or impressive

examples.en: Your new bike is really cool!
Is it okay if I come late? — Yeah, that's cool.

senses.note: 구어에서 가장 많이 쓰는 뜻. 대답으로 Cool! 하면 '좋아, 알겠어'. 어른이 격식 있는 자리에서는 great 가 더 안전.

senses.meaningEn: to become or make something less hot

examples.en: Let the soup cool for a few minutes.
Cool the cake before you cut it.

senses.note: cool down = (몸·화가) 가라앉다, 식다. cool off = 더위를 식히다.

senses.meaningEn: to make something exactly the same as the original

examples.en: Copy the link and send it to me.
Can you copy this page for me?
examples.ko: 이 페이지 복사해 줄 수 있어?

senses.note: 컴퓨터의 copy and paste(복붙), 복사기는 copier/copy machine. 명사 a copy = 복사본, 책 한 부.

senses.meaningEn: to do the same as someone else, often in a way that is not allowed

examples.en: Don't copy your friend's homework.
The baby copies everything her brother does.
examples.ko: 아기가 오빠가 하는 걸 다 따라 해.

senses.note: 시험에서 베끼는 건 cheat, 글을 베끼는 건 plagiarize(고급). copy 는 가장 일반적이고 쉬운 말.

senses.meaningEn: a tall plant with yellow seeds that are eaten as a vegetable

examples.en: We grilled some corn at the picnic.
Do you want butter on your corn?

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사. 옥수수 한 개는 an ear of corn. 팝콘은 popcorn.

senses.meaningEn: the place where two streets meet

examples.en: There's a coffee shop on the corner.
Turn left at the next corner.

senses.note: 길모퉁이는 on/at the corner. around the corner = 모퉁이를 돌면 바로 → '아주 가까이, 코앞'이라는 뜻으로도 씀(Spring is just around the corner).

senses.meaningEn: the point where two sides or edges of something meet

examples.en: Put the chair in the corner of the room.
I hit my knee on the corner of the table.

senses.note: 방 안의 구석은 in the corner, 책상·종이의 모서리는 the corner of ~. 길모퉁이(on the corner)와 전치사가 다름.

senses.meaningEn: to have a particular price

examples.en: How much does this bag cost?
The tickets cost twenty dollars each.

senses.note: 주어는 물건: It costs 5 dollars. 사람 주어로는 쓰지 않음(I cost... ✗). 과거형도 cost. cost a lot = 돈이 많이 들다.

senses.meaningEn: the amount of money needed to buy, do, or make something

examples.en: The cost of living here is very high.
We need to cut costs this year.

senses.note: price 는 '판매 가격', cost 는 '들어가는 비용' 느낌. the cost of ~ = ~의 비용. at no cost = 무료로.

senses.meaningEn: to push air out of your throat with a sudden loud sound

examples.en: He coughed all night and couldn't sleep.
examples.ko: 그는 밤새 기침해서 잠을 못 잤어.

examples.en: Please cover your mouth when you cough.

senses.note: 발음 주의 /kɔːf/ (코프). -gh 가 /f/ 소리.

senses.meaningEn: an illness or an act of coughing

examples.en: I've had a bad cough for a week.
This syrup is good for a dry cough.

senses.note: have a cough(기침이 있다). cough syrup / cough drops(기침약·목캔디).

senses.meaningEn: to say numbers in order or find out how many there are

examples.en: My son can count to one hundred.
examples.ko: 우리 아들은 백까지 셀 수 있어.

examples.en: Let's count how many chairs we need.
examples.ko: 의자가 몇 개 필요한지 세어 보자.

senses.note: count to 10 = 10까지 세다. count on one's fingers = 손가락으로 세다. 셀 수 있는 명사는 countable noun.

senses.meaningEn: to be important, or to be included

examples.en: Every vote counts.
That doesn't count. You were cheating!
examples.ko: 그건 인정 안 돼. 너 반칙했잖아!

senses.note: It doesn't count. = 그건 무효야/셈에 안 들어가. count on someone = ~를 믿다, 의지하다.

senses.meaningEn: a long flat surface in a store or bank where customers are served

examples.en: Please take your items to the counter.
I left my bag on the counter at the bank.

senses.note: check-in counter(공항 체크인 카운터), ticket counter(매표소). '카운터에서 계산하세요'는 Pay at the counter.

senses.meaningEn: a flat surface in a kitchen where you prepare food

examples.en: The keys are on the kitchen counter.
Don't leave the milk on the counter.

senses.note: 미국식. 영국에서는 worktop 이라고 함. countertop 도 같은 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: an area of land with its own government, such as Korea or France

examples.en: What country are you from?
I want to visit many countries someday.
examples.ko: 언젠가 여러 나라를 가 보고 싶어.

senses.note: 복수형은 countries. 'Which country?' 보다 'Where are you from?' 이 더 자연스러운 질문.

senses.meaningEn: land away from towns and cities, with farms and fields

examples.en: We spent the weekend in the country.
Life in the country is slow and quiet.

senses.note: 이 뜻은 항상 the country. countryside 도 같은 뜻. 반대는 the city. 음악 장르 country(컨트리)도 여기서 나옴.

senses.meaningEn: a child of your aunt or uncle

examples.en: My cousin and I are the same age.
All my cousins came to the party.

senses.note: 남녀 구분 없음. 'u' 발음에 주의: /ˈkʌzn/ (커즌).

senses.meaningEn: to put something over or on top of something else

examples.en: Cover the pot and let it boil for ten minutes.
She covered her face with her hands.

senses.note: cover A with B = A 를 B 로 덮다. be covered in/with = ~로 덮여 있다: The car is covered in snow.

senses.meaningEn: to include or deal with a subject

examples.en: We covered chapter three in class today.
The test covers everything we learned this month.
examples.ko: 시험은 이번 달에 배운 내용 전체가 범위야.

senses.note: 수업·책·시험 범위에 자주 씀. 보험·비용이 '보장하다'도 cover: Insurance covers it.

senses.meaningEn: to do someone's work while they are away

examples.en: Can you cover for me on Friday?
examples.ko: 금요일에 나 대신 근무해 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: I covered her shift yesterday.

senses.note: cover for 사람 / cover sb's shift. 아르바이트·교대 근무에서 매우 흔한 표현.

senses.meaningEn: something that goes over or on top of something to protect or hide it

examples.en: Don't judge a book by its cover.
examples.ko: 겉만 보고 판단하지 마(책 표지로 책을 판단하지 마).

examples.en: Put a cover on the sofa so it stays clean.

senses.note: book cover = 책 표지, phone cover = 폰 케이스, the covers = 이불(침구).

senses.meaningEn: a large farm animal kept for its milk or meat

examples.en: The cows are eating grass in the field.
This milk comes from cows on a local farm.
examples.ko: 이 우유는 근처 농장의 소에서 나온 거야.

senses.note: 엄밀히는 암소. 수소는 bull, 송아지는 calf, 소고기는 beef. 소 울음소리는 moo.

senses.meaningEn: a sea animal with a hard shell, eight legs, and two large claws, often eaten as food

examples.en: We caught a crab on the beach today.
examples.ko: 오늘 해변에서 게를 한 마리 잡았어.

examples.en: I'd like the crab soup, please.

senses.note: 게의 집게발은 claw. crab meat(게살), crab cake(게살 완자). 게는 옆으로 걷는다 = walk sideways. 비격식으로 crabby = 짜증 난, 까칠한.

senses.meaningEn: to hit something violently, usually in a vehicle

examples.en: The car crashed into a tree.
He crashed his bike and hurt his knee.
examples.ko: 그는 자전거로 사고를 내서 무릎을 다쳤어.

senses.note: crash into + 대상. 명사도 가능: a car crash(자동차 사고), a plane crash(비행기 추락).

senses.meaningEn: (of a computer or program) to suddenly stop working

examples.en: My laptop crashed and I lost my homework.
The app crashes every time I open it.

senses.note: 앱이 "튕긴다" = The app crashes/keeps crashing. 화면이 멈춘 것은 freeze.

senses.meaningEn: a sudden loud noise made by something falling or breaking

examples.en: I heard a loud crash from the kitchen.
examples.ko: 부엌에서 쾅 하는 큰 소리가 났어.

examples.en: The plate fell with a crash.

senses.meaningEn: to move on your hands and knees

examples.en: The baby started to crawl last week.
A spider crawled across the wall.

senses.note: 아기 성장 단계: crawl(기다) → walk(걷다). 벌레가 기어가는 것도 crawl.

senses.meaningEn: to move very slowly, especially in traffic

examples.en: Traffic crawled along the highway all morning.
The bus crawled through the busy streets.

senses.note: move at a crawl = 거북이걸음으로 가다.

senses.meaningEn: a colored stick of wax that children draw with

examples.en: My son loves drawing with crayons.
examples.ko: 우리 아들은 크레용으로 그리는 걸 좋아해.

examples.en: Pass me the red crayon, please.

senses.note: 한국어 '크레파스'는 일본식 상표명. 영어로는 crayon. 색연필은 colored pencil.

senses.meaningEn: to make something new that did not exist before

examples.en: The students created a poster about recycling.
She creates beautiful pictures with just a pencil.
examples.ko: 그녀는 연필 하나로 아름다운 그림을 만들어 내.

senses.note: make 보다 "새롭게·창의적으로" 만든다는 느낌. create an account(계정 만들기)처럼 IT 에서도 매우 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: to cause a situation or feeling to happen

examples.en: The heavy rain created problems for drivers.
Candles create a warm mood in the room.

senses.note: create problems/jobs/a mood 같은 콜로케이션으로 익히기.

senses.meaningEn: a small plastic card that lets you buy things and pay for them later

examples.en: Can I pay with a credit card?
I lost my credit card at the airport.

senses.note: pay by credit card / pay with a credit card 둘 다 가능. 체크카드는 debit card. 가게에서 '카드 되나요?'는 Do you take cards? 가 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: to go from one side of a road, river, or place to the other

examples.en: Be careful when you cross the street.
We crossed the bridge on foot.

senses.note: cross the road/street/river. 전치사 없이 바로 목적어. 횡단보도 = crosswalk(미). 'Cross the border' = 국경을 넘다.

senses.meaningEn: to put one arm or leg over the other

examples.en: He crossed his arms and said no.
Don't cross your legs in the photo.
examples.ko: 사진 찍을 때 다리 꼬지 마.

senses.note: cross your arms(팔짱 끼다), cross your legs(다리 꼬다). 'Fingers crossed!' = 행운을 빌어!

senses.meaningEn: a mark or shape made of two lines that go across each other

examples.en: Put a cross next to the wrong answers.
examples.ko: 틀린 답 옆에 X 표시를 해.

examples.en: She wears a small gold cross.
examples.ko: 그녀는 작은 금 십자가를 걸고 다녀.

senses.note: 영국식에서 X 표시를 cross, 체크를 tick 이라고 함. 미국식에선 X 를 그냥 'an X' 라고 말하는 경우가 더 많음.

senses.meaningEn: a marked place on a road where people can cross safely

examples.en: Always use the crosswalk to cross the street.
examples.ko: 길을 건널 때는 항상 횡단보도를 이용해.

examples.en: Cars have to stop at the crosswalk.

senses.note: 미국식 crosswalk, 영국식 zebra crossing / pedestrian crossing. 횡단보도를 '건너다'는 cross at the crosswalk.

senses.meaningEn: to have tears coming from your eyes because you are sad or hurt

examples.en: The baby cried all night.
Don't cry, everything will be okay.

senses.note: 과거형 cried. 울음을 터뜨리다 burst into tears, 펑펑 울다 cry my eyes out.

senses.meaningEn: to shout something loudly

examples.en: "Help!" she cried.
He cried out in pain when he fell.

senses.note: 주로 이야기·소설에서 쓰는 용법. 일상 대화에서는 shout 이 더 흔하다. cry out = 큰 소리로 외치다.

senses.meaningEn: a long green vegetable with a cool, watery taste, often eaten raw

examples.en: Slice the cucumber for the salad.
I like cucumber in my sandwich.
examples.ko: 나는 샌드위치에 오이 들어간 게 좋아.

senses.note: as cool as a cucumber = 아주 침착한.

senses.meaningEn: a small round container with a handle, used for hot drinks

examples.en: Can I have a cup of coffee, please?
She put the cups in the sink.

senses.note: 뜨거운 음료는 cup, 찬 음료나 유리잔은 glass. a cup of tea / coffee.

senses.meaningEn: a unit for measuring food in cooking

examples.en: Add two cups of water to the pot.
The recipe needs one cup of sugar.
examples.ko: 이 레시피에는 설탕 한 컵이 필요해.

senses.note: 미국 요리 레시피의 1 cup 은 약 240ml.

senses.meaningEn: a prize shaped like a large cup, or the competition for it

examples.en: Our team won the cup this year.
Are you watching the World Cup tonight?

senses.meaningEn: an amount of coffee served in a cup

examples.en: I need a cup of coffee before work.
examples.ko: 출근 전에 커피 한 잔 마셔야 해.

examples.en: Do you want to grab a cup of coffee with me?

senses.note: grab/get a cup of coffee = 가볍게 커피 마시러 가다(만남 제안으로 자주 씀). 카페에서 주문할 때는 보통 A coffee, please. 또는 사이즈만 말한다. 홍차는 a cup of tea.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of cloth that hangs over a window

examples.en: Close the curtains. The sun is too bright.
I open the curtains as soon as I wake up.

senses.note: 보통 복수형 curtains. 커튼을 '치다'는 close/draw the curtains, '걷다'는 open the curtains. 블라인드는 blinds.

senses.meaningEn: a person who buys things or services from a store or business

examples.en: The store was full of customers on Saturday.
She is one of our regular customers.
examples.ko: 그분은 우리 단골 손님 중 한 분이에요.

senses.note: 가게·회사의 손님은 customer, 집에 온 손님은 guest, 변호사·의사의 고객은 client, 식당·호텔 손님도 guest/customer. customer service = 고객 서비스.

senses.meaningEn: to divide something into pieces using a knife or scissors

examples.en: Cut the onion into small pieces.
Can you cut the cake for everyone?
examples.ko: 모두에게 줄 케이크 좀 잘라 줄래?

senses.note: 과거·과거분사도 cut (불규칙). cut into pieces(조각으로 자르다). 얇게 썰면 slice, 다지면 chop.

senses.meaningEn: to injure your skin with something sharp

examples.en: I cut my finger while cooking.
Be careful not to cut yourself.

senses.note: cut oneself = 베이다. 다친 상처(명사)도 cut: I have a cut on my hand.

senses.meaningEn: to make something shorter by cutting

examples.en: I need to get my hair cut.
He cuts the grass every weekend.

senses.note: '머리 잘랐어'는 I got a haircut. / I got my hair cut. (남이 잘라 줌). I cut my hair. 는 내가 직접 자른 것.

senses.meaningEn: pretty and pleasing in a small or young way

examples.en: Your puppy is so cute!
The baby made a cute little sound.

senses.note: 아기·동물·작은 물건에 가장 많이 씀. 미국 구어에서는 성인에게 '매력 있고 잘생긴/예쁜'이라는 뜻으로도 쓴다(He's cute.).

senses.meaningEn: attractive in a friendly, charming way

examples.en: I think the new teacher is kind of cute.
examples.ko: 새로 온 선생님 좀 괜찮은 것 같아.

examples.en: He's cute, but he talks too much.
examples.ko: 그 사람 매력은 있는데 말이 너무 많아.

senses.note: handsome(남성, 격식)·pretty(여성)보다 가볍고 친근한 느낌. 한국어 '귀엽다'와 달리 이성적 매력도 포함할 수 있다.

senses.meaningEn: the sport or activity of riding a bicycle

examples.en: Cycling along the Han River is really nice.
examples.ko: 한강을 따라 자전거 타는 거 정말 좋아.

examples.en: I go cycling with my friends on weekends.

senses.note: 일상 미국 영어에서는 go cycling 보다 ride a bike / go for a bike ride 가 더 흔함. cycling 은 운동·스포츠 느낌.

senses.meaningEn: an informal word for father

examples.en: Dad, can you help me with my homework?
My dad drives me to school every day.
examples.ko: 우리 아빠가 매일 학교에 차로 데려다 주셔.

senses.note: 직접 부를 때는 대문자 Dad. 어린아이는 daddy. 미국 구어로 pops 도 있음.

senses.meaningEn: happening or done every day

examples.en: Walking the dog is part of my daily routine.
examples.ko: 강아지 산책은 내 하루 일과 중 하나야.

examples.en: I read the daily news on my phone.

senses.note: daily routine(하루 일과), daily life(일상생활), daily newspaper(일간지)처럼 명사 앞에 붙여 씀.

senses.meaningEn: every day

examples.en: Take this medicine twice daily.
examples.ko: 이 약을 하루에 두 번 복용하세요.

examples.en: The store is open daily from nine to six.

senses.note: every day 와 같은 뜻이지만 약 설명서·안내문 같은 글에 더 자주 보임. everyday(한 단어)는 형용사 "일상의"라는 뜻이니 띄어쓰기에 주의.

senses.meaningEn: to harm something so that it is broken or does not work well

examples.en: The rain damaged the roof of our house.
examples.ko: 비 때문에 우리 집 지붕이 상했어.

examples.en: Be careful not to damage the screen.

senses.note: damage 는 물건·건강·명성에 쓰고, 사람 몸이 다치면 injure/hurt. 완전히 못 쓰게 되면 destroy.

senses.meaningEn: physical harm done to something

examples.en: The flood caused a lot of damage to the town.
Luckily, there was no damage to the car.

senses.note: 불가산명사: a damage(X), damages(X). cause/do damage to ~ 로 쓴다. damages(복수)는 법률 용어 "손해배상금".

senses.meaningEn: to move your body to music

examples.en: Do you want to dance with me?
The kids danced all night at the party.

senses.note: dance to the music(음악에 맞춰 춤추다), dance with someone(~와 춤추다). 춤추는 사람은 dancer, 춤 공연은 dance show.

senses.meaningEn: a set of movements you do to music, or a party where people dance

examples.en: She's learning a new dance for the show.
examples.ko: 그녀는 공연에 쓸 새 춤을 배우고 있어.

examples.en: Are you going to the school dance on Friday?

senses.note: a dance 는 '춤 한 가지' 또는 '댄스파티'. 춤이라는 활동 전체는 dancing(I love dancing). dance class(무용 수업)도 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: a person who dances, especially as a job

examples.en: The dancers moved together to the music.
You're a great dancer! Where did you learn?
examples.ko: 춤 정말 잘 추네! 어디서 배웠어?

senses.note: a good/great dancer = 춤 잘 추는 사람. ballet dancer(발레리나·발레리노), backup dancer(백댄서).

senses.meaningEn: a particular day of the month or year

examples.en: What's the date today?
Please write the date at the top.

senses.note: 요일을 물을 때는 What day is it?, 날짜는 What's the date? 미국식 날짜 표기는 월/일/년(10/27/2026) 순서. due date = 마감일, expiration date = 유효기간.

senses.meaningEn: a romantic meeting, or the person you meet

examples.en: I have a date with Mina tonight.
How was your first date?

senses.note: go on a date = 데이트하러 가다. 동사로도 쓴다: They're dating(사귀는 중이야). 한국어 '데이트'보다 뜻이 넓어 사귀는 사람 자체를 가리킬 수도 있음.

senses.meaningEn: a sweet, sticky brown fruit that grows on a palm tree

examples.en: These dates are very sweet.
She put dates in the cake instead of sugar.
examples.ko: 그녀는 설탕 대신 케이크에 대추야자를 넣었어.

senses.note: 한국 대추(jujube)와는 다른 과일. 중동 음식점이나 건강식 이야기에서 등장.

senses.meaningEn: a person's female child

examples.en: Our daughter is studying in Canada.
She has two daughters and one son.
examples.ko: 그녀는 딸 둘에 아들 하나가 있어.

senses.note: 철자에 gh 가 있지만 소리 나지 않음: /ˈdɔːtər/ (도-터).

senses.meaningEn: a period of twenty-four hours

examples.en: There are seven days in a week.
I'll see you in a few days.

senses.note: every day(매일, 두 단어) vs everyday(일상의, 형용사). all day = 하루 종일, the other day = 며칠 전에, day off = 휴일. 날짜를 말할 때는 What day is it today?(요일) vs What's the date today?(날짜).

senses.meaningEn: the time when it is light, between morning and evening

examples.en: It was a hot day, so we stayed inside.
Cats sleep during the day and play at night.

senses.note: during the day = 낮 동안. Have a nice day! 는 헤어질 때 인사(특히 점원이 손님에게). 24시간 '하루'와 밝은 '낮' 둘 다 day 라서 문맥으로 구분한다.

senses.meaningEn: the twelfth and last month of the year

examples.en: Christmas is on December 25th.
We have a family party every December.

senses.note: 줄임말 Dec. 연말(the end of the year)과 겨울 휴가(the holidays) 이야기와 자주 나온다. 가운데 음절 강세.

senses.meaningEn: to choose what you will do after thinking about it

examples.en: Have you decided what to eat for lunch?
We decided to go to the beach on Sunday.

senses.note: decide to + 동사 / decide on + 명사(decide on a name). 명사는 decision(make a decision). 'I can't decide.' = 못 고르겠어.

senses.meaningEn: a large wild animal with long thin legs that runs fast; the male has horns called antlers

examples.en: We saw three deer near the camping site.
examples.ko: 캠핑장 근처에서 사슴 세 마리를 봤어.

examples.en: Be careful, deer often cross this road at night.
examples.ko: 조심해, 밤에 이 길로 사슴이 자주 건너다녀.

senses.note: 단수·복수 모두 deer(deers 는 틀림). 수컷은 buck/stag, 암컷은 doe, 새끼는 fawn. 발음이 dear(사랑하는) /dɪr/ 와 같음.

senses.meaningEn: a unit for measuring temperature or angles

examples.en: It's thirty degrees today. So hot!
Turn the oven to 180 degrees.

senses.note: 숫자 뒤에 복수형: 20 degrees(1도만 one degree). 영하 5도 = minus five degrees / five below zero. 섭씨 = Celsius, 화씨 = Fahrenheit. 기호 ° 는 degree sign.

senses.meaningEn: a qualification you get when you finish university

examples.en: She has a degree in English.
He got his degree last year.

senses.note: a bachelor's degree(학사), a master's degree(석사), a PhD(박사). 학위를 받다 = get/earn a degree, 전공 = a degree in + 분야.

senses.meaningEn: to remove a file, message, or text from a computer or phone

examples.en: I deleted the photo by mistake.
Delete the old messages to save space.

senses.note: 디지털 자료를 '지우다'는 delete, 연필 글씨는 erase, 목록에서 빼는 건 remove. 키보드의 Delete 키.

senses.meaningEn: having a very pleasant taste or smell

examples.en: This soup is delicious!
Thank you, the dinner was delicious.

senses.note: 이미 '아주' 의 뜻이 들어 있어 very delicious 는 어색함. really / absolutely delicious 는 가능.

senses.meaningEn: a doctor who takes care of your teeth

examples.en: I go to the dentist twice a year.
The dentist said I have two cavities.
examples.ko: 치과 의사가 충치가 두 개 있다고 했어.

senses.note: '치과에 간다'는 go to the dentist(사람으로 표현). dental clinic 도 가능. 충치 = cavity.

senses.meaningEn: a large store that sells many different kinds of things in separate sections

examples.en: I bought this bag at a department store.
The department store has a big sale this weekend.
examples.ko: 그 백화점에서 이번 주말에 큰 세일을 해.

senses.note: department = 매장 구역·부서. 백화점 안의 '층별 매장'은 the shoe department 처럼 말함. 줄여서 그냥 store 라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: to say what someone or something is like

examples.en: Can you describe the man you saw?
examples.ko: 네가 본 남자가 어떻게 생겼는지 말해 줄래?

examples.en: She described her trip as the best week ever.
examples.ko: 그녀는 그 여행을 최고의 한 주였다고 했어.

senses.note: explain 은 '왜·어떻게'를 설명, describe 는 '어떤 모습·어떤 것인지'를 묘사. describe A as B. 명사는 description.

senses.meaningEn: a large, dry area of land with very little rain and few plants

examples.en: It gets very cold in the desert at night.
Camels can live in the desert for a long time.
examples.ko: 낙타는 사막에서 오래 살 수 있어.

senses.note: desert(사막, /ˈdezərt/)와 dessert(디저트, /dɪˈzɜːrt/)를 혼동하지 말 것. 철자 s 가 하나면 사막, 둘이면 디저트.

senses.meaningEn: to plan and draw how something will look or work

examples.en: She designed her own wedding dress.
Who designed this building?

senses.note: be designed for/to = ~를 위해 만들어지다(This app is designed for kids).

senses.meaningEn: the way something looks, or a pattern on it

examples.en: I like the design of this chair.
The cup has a flower design on it.

senses.note: 사람(디자이너)은 designer. 한국어 "디자인이 예쁘다"는 I like the design. 또는 It looks nice.

senses.meaningEn: a table that you sit at to write, study, or work

examples.en: I do my homework at my desk.
Your keys are on the desk by the window.
examples.ko: 네 열쇠는 창가 책상 위에 있어.

senses.note: 책상'에서' 일하다는 at the desk(on 은 책상 '위에' 물건이 있을 때). 사무실 책상도 desk.

senses.meaningEn: a place in a hotel, airport, or office where you can get information or help

examples.en: Please leave your key at the front desk.
Ask at the information desk over there.

senses.note: front desk = 호텔 프런트(한국식 '프런트'는 영어로 front desk / reception). check-in desk = 공항 탑승 수속 카운터.

senses.meaningEn: sweet food eaten at the end of a meal

examples.en: What's for dessert tonight?
I'm too full for dessert, thanks.

senses.note: desert(사막, /ˈdezərt/)와 철자·강세가 다름. dessert 는 뒤에 강세. for dessert = 후식으로.

senses.meaningEn: to damage something so badly that it no longer exists or cannot be used

examples.en: The fire destroyed three houses on our street.
examples.ko: 화재로 우리 동네 집 세 채가 완전히 타 버렸어.

examples.en: The storm destroyed the old bridge.

senses.note: destroy 는 "못 쓰게 완전히" 망가뜨리는 것. 일부만 손상이면 damage. 명사는 destruction.

senses.meaningEn: to ruin something such as a relationship, plan, or feeling

examples.en: One lie can destroy a friendship.
examples.ko: 거짓말 하나가 우정을 망칠 수 있어.

examples.en: The bad news destroyed his good mood.
examples.ko: 나쁜 소식이 그의 좋은 기분을 다 망쳐 버렸어.

senses.meaningEn: a book or app that lists words and explains their meanings

examples.en: Look it up in the dictionary.
I use an online dictionary on my phone.

senses.note: look up a word in a dictionary = 사전에서 단어를 찾다. 영한사전은 English-Korean dictionary.

senses.meaningEn: to stop living

examples.en: My grandfather died ten years ago.
The plant died because I forgot to water it.
examples.ko: 물 주는 걸 잊어서 식물이 죽었어.

senses.note: die of/from + 원인: die of cancer. 직접 말하기 조심스러울 땐 pass away. 명사 death, 형용사 dead(죽은). is dead ≠ died(동사).

senses.meaningEn: to stop working, especially because of no power

examples.en: My phone died in the middle of the call.
The car battery died this morning.

senses.note: My phone is dying. = 배터리가 거의 다 됐어. 아주 흔한 구어.

senses.meaningEn: to want something very much

examples.en: I'm dying for a cup of coffee.
examples.ko: 커피 한 잔이 너무 마시고 싶어.

examples.en: She's dying to see the new movie.
examples.ko: 그녀는 새 영화를 정말 보고 싶어 해.

senses.note: be dying to 동사 / be dying for 명사. 과장 표현으로 가볍게 씀.

senses.meaningEn: not easy to do or understand

examples.en: This question is too difficult for me.
It's difficult to wake up early in winter.

senses.note: 구어에서는 hard 를 더 자주 쓰고, difficult 는 조금 더 격식적. 비교급은 more difficult(difficulter 는 틀림). 명사는 difficulty.

senses.meaningEn: not easy to please or to deal with

examples.en: My boss is a difficult person.
Don't be difficult. Just pick one.

senses.note: a difficult child/customer = 다루기 힘든 아이/손님. 사람 성격에 hard 를 쓰면 '냉정한'의 뜻이 되므로 difficult 가 맞음.

senses.meaningEn: to make a hole in the ground by moving earth away

examples.en: The dog dug a big hole in the garden.
examples.ko: 개가 마당에 큰 구멍을 파 놨어.

examples.en: Let's dig here and plant the tree.

senses.note: dig a hole = 구멍을 파다. 과거형은 digged 가 아니라 dug.

senses.meaningEn: to search for something by moving things around with your hand

examples.en: She dug in her bag for her keys.
I'm digging through the drawer for a pen.

senses.note: dig in/through + 장소. dig in! 은 '어서 먹어!'라는 구어 표현도 됨.

senses.meaningEn: a room in a home where people eat meals

examples.en: Dinner is ready. Everyone to the dining room!
The dining room table seats six people.
examples.ko: 식당 테이블에는 여섯 명이 앉을 수 있어.

senses.note: 밖의 '식당(음식점)'은 restaurant. dining room 은 집·호텔 안의 식사 공간.

senses.meaningEn: the main meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening

examples.en: Dinner is ready, come and sit down.
We're having chicken for dinner.

senses.note: have dinner(관사 없음). 하루 중 가장 큰 식사라는 뜻이라 일부 지역에선 점심을 dinner 라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: a formal evening meal or social event with food

examples.en: They invited us to dinner on Saturday.
examples.ko: 그들이 토요일 저녁 식사에 우리를 초대했어.

examples.en: We had a nice dinner with my parents.
examples.ko: 부모님과 좋은 저녁 식사 자리를 가졌어.

senses.note: dinner party = 저녁 파티. go out for dinner = 저녁 외식하다. 사람을 초대할 때 invite someone to dinner.

senses.meaningEn: a very large animal that lived millions of years ago and no longer exists

examples.en: My son loves dinosaurs and knows all their names.
examples.ko: 아들이 공룡을 좋아해서 이름을 다 알아.

examples.en: Dinosaurs lived a long, long time ago.

senses.note: 줄여서 dino 라고도 함. 시대에 뒤떨어진 사람이나 물건을 비유해 'a dinosaur' 라고도 부름.

senses.meaningEn: the way that someone or something is going or facing

examples.en: Which direction is the beach?
We walked in the wrong direction for an hour.
examples.ko: 우리는 한 시간 동안 반대 방향으로 걸었어.

senses.note: in the direction of(…방향으로), in the opposite direction(반대 방향으로). 전치사는 to 가 아니라 in.

senses.meaningEn: instructions that tell you how to get somewhere or how to do something

examples.en: Could you give me directions to the hotel?
examples.ko: 호텔까지 가는 길 좀 알려 주시겠어요?

examples.en: Read the directions before you start.

senses.note: 길 안내는 항상 복수 directions. ask for directions(길을 묻다), give directions(길을 알려 주다).

senses.meaningEn: covered with dirt or marks; not clean

examples.en: My shoes got dirty in the rain.
Don't put dirty dishes on the table.
examples.ko: 더러운 접시를 식탁에 올려 두지 마.

senses.note: get dirty = 더러워지다. dirty clothes = 빨랫감. 비교급 dirtier, 최상급 dirtiest.

senses.meaningEn: an amount of money taken off the usual price

examples.en: Can I get a discount if I buy two?
Students get a ten percent discount here.

senses.note: get/give a discount, a 20% discount on + 물건. 한국어 '디씨'는 영어로 통하지 않음. '깎아 주세요'는 Can you give me a discount? 가 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: to find something that nobody knew about before

examples.en: Scientists discovered a new kind of fish.
Columbus discovered America in 1492.

senses.note: discover(원래 있던 것) vs invent(새로 만든 것). 발견 = discovery.

senses.meaningEn: to find out information that you did not know

examples.en: I discovered that the cafe closes at eight.
examples.ko: 그 카페가 8시에 닫는다는 걸 알게 됐어.

examples.en: We discovered a great little restaurant near the hotel.
examples.ko: 호텔 근처에서 괜찮은 작은 식당을 발견했어.

senses.note: 일상 대화에서는 find out 이 더 자연스러운 경우가 많음. discover 는 "우연히·새롭게" 알게 되는 느낌.

senses.meaningEn: food prepared in a particular way as part of a meal

examples.en: Bibimbap is my favorite Korean dish.
examples.ko: 비빔밥은 내가 가장 좋아하는 한국 요리야.

examples.en: What's the most popular dish here?
examples.ko: 여기서 가장 인기 있는 요리가 뭐예요?

senses.note: a Korean dish = 한국 요리 한 가지. main dish(메인 요리), side dish(반찬).

senses.meaningEn: the plates, bowls, and cups that need to be washed after a meal

examples.en: Can you wash the dishes tonight?
examples.ko: 오늘 밤 설거지 좀 해 줄래?

examples.en: I'll do the dishes after dinner.

senses.note: 설거지하다 = wash the dishes / do the dishes (항상 복수). dishwasher = 식기세척기.

senses.meaningEn: to find how many times one number fits into another

examples.en: Divide twenty by four, and you get five.
Ten divided by two is five.

senses.note: divide A by B = A 를 B 로 나누다. 명사 division(나눗셈).

senses.meaningEn: to separate something into parts or share it

examples.en: Let's divide the pizza into eight pieces.
We divided the work between us.

senses.note: divide into + 조각 수, divide between/among + 사람. 구어로는 split 을 더 많이 씀(split the bill).

senses.meaningEn: feeling as if everything is spinning and you might fall

examples.en: I feel dizzy when I stand up too fast.
She got dizzy after the roller coaster.

senses.note: feel dizzy / get dizzy. 병원에서 '어지러워요'는 I feel dizzy. 머리가 아픈 건 headache 로 따로 말한다.

senses.meaningEn: to perform an action, job, or activity

examples.en: What do you usually do on weekends?
I did my homework before dinner.

senses.note: do homework(숙제하다), do the dishes(설거지하다), do exercise(운동하다). '만들다·창조하다'는 make(make a cake). '하다'를 모두 do 로 옮기면 안 됨.

senses.meaningEn: used to make questions and negatives with other verbs

examples.en: Do you like spicy food?
She doesn't eat meat.

senses.note: 3인칭 단수는 does, 과거는 did — 뒤 동사는 원형: She doesn't eats (×) → doesn't eat. 짧은 대답 Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

senses.meaningEn: used to ask or say how well someone is or how something is going

examples.en: How are you doing these days?
He did well on the test.

senses.note: How are you doing? = How are you? 보다 조금 캐주얼. do well/badly(잘/못 하다). 'How do you do?' 는 아주 격식 있는 첫인사로 요즘은 드묾.

senses.meaningEn: a person whose job is to treat people who are sick or hurt

examples.en: You should see a doctor about that cough.
examples.ko: 그 기침은 의사한테 진찰받아 봐야 해.

examples.en: The doctor told me to rest for a few days.

senses.note: 병원에 가다 = go to the doctor / see a doctor(큰 병원이 아니면 hospital 보다 이렇게 말함). 호칭은 Dr. Kim. 박사 학위도 doctor.

senses.meaningEn: a common animal with four legs that people keep as a pet or to guard a house

examples.en: I walk my dog every morning before work.
examples.ko: 출근 전에 매일 아침 개를 산책시켜.

examples.en: Is your dog friendly with kids?

senses.note: 강아지는 puppy. walk the dog = 개를 산책시키다. hot dog 는 음식! 사람에게 dog 라고 하면 비속어가 되니 주의.

senses.meaningEn: a toy that looks like a small person or baby

examples.en: My daughter sleeps with her doll every night.
examples.ko: 우리 딸은 매일 밤 인형을 안고 자.

examples.en: She has a doll with long yellow hair.
examples.ko: 그 아이는 노란 긴 머리 인형을 갖고 있어.

senses.note: doll 은 사람 모양 인형. 곰 같은 동물 봉제 인형은 stuffed animal(미) / teddy bear. 한국어 '인형'을 모두 doll 로 옮기지 않도록 주의.

senses.meaningEn: the unit of money used in the US, Canada, Australia, and some other countries

examples.en: This T-shirt is only five dollars.
Can you lend me a few dollars for lunch?
examples.ko: 점심 먹을 몇 달러만 빌려줄 수 있어?

senses.note: 기호 $ 는 숫자 앞에 씀($5), 읽을 때는 five dollars. 구어로 bucks(a few bucks)도 매우 흔함. 1달러 = 100 cents.

senses.meaningEn: a smart sea animal that looks like a large fish and breathes air

examples.en: We saw dolphins jumping next to our boat!
examples.ko: 우리 배 옆에서 돌고래들이 점프하는 걸 봤어!

examples.en: Dolphins are very smart and friendly animals.

senses.note: 돌고래는 물고기(fish)가 아니라 포유류(mammal). 발음은 '달핀'(/ˈdɑːlfɪn/)에 가깝고 '돌핀'이 아님. dolphin watching = 돌고래 관찰 투어.

senses.meaningEn: a small round sweet cake, often with a hole in the middle, fried in oil

examples.en: I grabbed a donut and coffee on the way.
examples.ko: 오는 길에 도넛이랑 커피를 하나 샀어.

examples.en: These donuts are still warm!

senses.note: doughnut 으로도 씀(원래 철자). 미국에서는 donut 이 더 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: a flat piece of wood or metal that you open to go into or out of a room or building

examples.en: Can you close the door, please?
Someone is knocking at the door.

senses.note: open/close/shut the door. 문을 '잠그다'는 lock the door. 옆집은 next door. answer the door = (초인종 소리에) 문을 열어 주다.

senses.meaningEn: to copy a file from the internet to your device

examples.en: You can download the app for free.
examples.ko: 그 앱은 무료로 다운로드할 수 있어.

examples.en: I downloaded some songs for the trip.
examples.ko: 여행 가려고 노래 몇 곡 받아 놨어.

senses.note: download A from B. 한국어 '다운받다'와 같음. 명사: The download is finished.

senses.meaningEn: to or on a lower floor of a building

examples.en: Come downstairs, dinner is ready!
The kitchen is downstairs on the first floor.

senses.note: go/come downstairs 에 to 를 붙이지 않음. 미국식 first floor = 1층(한국과 같음), 영국식은 ground floor.

senses.meaningEn: a group of twelve

examples.en: Can you buy a dozen eggs on your way home?
examples.ko: 집에 오는 길에 달걀 한 판(12개) 사 올 수 있어?

examples.en: The donuts are five dollars a dozen.

senses.note: a dozen eggs(of 없이 씀). half a dozen = 6개. 미국 마트에서 달걀·도넛·베이글은 12개 단위로 자주 판다.

senses.meaningEn: a lot of people or things

examples.en: I've told you a dozen times to clean your room.
There were dozens of people waiting outside.

senses.note: dozens of = 수십 개의(정확히 12의 배수는 아님). a dozen times = 여러 번(과장).

senses.meaningEn: a large imaginary animal with wings that can breathe fire

examples.en: In the story, a dragon lives in the cave.
The dragon flew over the castle, breathing fire.
examples.ko: 용이 불을 뿜으며 성 위를 날았어.

senses.note: 서양의 dragon 은 날개 달린 괴물 이미지가 강하고, 동양의 용과는 느낌이 다름. 잠자리는 dragonfly, 띠는 the Year of the Dragon.

senses.meaningEn: to make a picture with a pencil or pen

examples.en: I like to draw cats and dogs.
examples.ko: 나는 고양이랑 강아지 그리는 걸 좋아해.

examples.en: She drew a map to her house for me.
examples.ko: 그녀가 나한테 자기 집까지 가는 지도를 그려 줬어.

senses.note: draw 는 선으로, paint 는 물감으로 그림. 그림(명사)은 drawing. 과거형 drew, 과거분사 drawn.

senses.meaningEn: to pull something such as curtains open or closed

examples.en: Can you draw the curtains? It's too bright.
examples.ko: 커튼 좀 쳐 줄래? 너무 밝아.

examples.en: She drew the blinds and went to bed.

senses.note: draw the curtains 는 열다·닫다 둘 다 가능하므로 open/close 로 분명히 말해도 좋음.

senses.meaningEn: to finish a game with the same score as the other team

examples.en: The two teams drew 1–1.
We drew with the best team in the league!

senses.note: 미국에서는 tie 를 더 많이 씀. 명사로도 a draw = 무승부.

senses.meaningEn: a box-shaped part of a desk or cupboard that you pull out to open

examples.en: The scissors are in the top drawer.
Open the drawer and take out a spoon.

senses.note: 발음 주의: /drɔːr/ 한 음절처럼 읽음. 서랍장은 chest of drawers / dresser.

senses.meaningEn: pictures and events you see in your mind while you sleep

examples.en: I had a strange dream last night.
Sweet dreams! See you tomorrow.

senses.note: 꿈을 꾸다 have a dream. 악몽은 nightmare, bad dream.

senses.meaningEn: something you want very much to happen in the future

examples.en: My dream is to travel around the world.
examples.ko: 내 꿈은 세계 여행을 하는 거야.

examples.en: Her dream came true last year.

senses.note: a dream come true = 꿈이 이루어진 것. dream job, dream house 처럼 형용사처럼도 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: to see things in your sleep, or to hope for something

examples.en: I dreamed about my old school last night.
I've always dreamed of living by the sea.
examples.ko: 나는 항상 바닷가에 사는 걸 꿈꿔 왔어.

senses.note: dream about(꿈에 나오다) / dream of(소망하다). 과거형은 dreamed 와 dreamt 둘 다 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of clothing for women that covers the body and part of the legs in one piece

examples.en: She bought a red dress for the wedding.
examples.ko: 그녀는 결혼식에 입을 빨간 드레스를 샀어.

examples.en: That dress looks great on you.
examples.ko: 그 원피스 너한테 정말 잘 어울려.

senses.note: 한국어 '원피스'는 영어로 dress. one-piece 는 영어에서 주로 수영복을 말함. wedding dress, summer dress.

senses.meaningEn: to put clothes on yourself or someone else

examples.en: Get dressed, we're leaving in ten minutes.
She dresses her little son every morning.
examples.ko: 그녀는 매일 아침 어린 아들에게 옷을 입혀.

senses.note: get dressed = 옷을 입다, dress up = 차려입다·변장하다, dress warmly = 따뜻하게 입다. 일상에서 '입다'는 put on/wear 가 더 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: to take liquid into your mouth and swallow it

examples.en: Drink lots of water when it's hot.
I drank two cups of coffee this morning.
examples.ko: 오늘 아침에 커피 두 잔 마셨어.

senses.note: 과거형 drank, 과거분사 drunk. 약을 먹는 것은 take medicine(drink 가 아님). 국을 먹는 것도 eat soup.

senses.meaningEn: a liquid that you drink

examples.en: Would you like a drink with your meal?
Can I get you a cold drink?

senses.note: soft drink = 탄산음료·청량음료.

senses.meaningEn: an alcoholic drink

examples.en: Let's go for a drink after work.
He had a few drinks at the party.
examples.ko: 그는 파티에서 술을 몇 잔 마셨어.

senses.note: go for a drink / have a drink 는 보통 술을 뜻한다. 술에 취하다 get drunk.

senses.meaningEn: to control a car or other vehicle and make it move

examples.en: Can you drive?
I drove to work this morning.

senses.note: 자전거·오토바이는 drive 가 아니라 ride. 탑승자로 가는 건 go by car. 과거형 drove, 과거분사 driven.

senses.meaningEn: to take someone somewhere in a car

examples.en: Can you drive me to the station?
Mom drives us to school every day.

senses.note: drive + 사람 + to 장소. give someone a ride(태워 주다)도 같은 뜻으로 자주 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a trip in a car

examples.en: It's a two-hour drive to the beach.
Let's go for a drive this weekend.

senses.note: go for a drive(드라이브 가다). 'a 30-minute drive' 처럼 차로 걸리는 거리를 말할 때 매우 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: a person who drives a car, bus, taxi, or other vehicle

examples.en: The bus driver was very kind to us.
My dad is a careful driver.

senses.note: taxi driver, truck driver 처럼 복합어로 자주 씀. driver's license = 운전면허증. 운전 잘하는 사람 = a good driver.

senses.meaningEn: to let something fall, or to fall

examples.en: Oops, I dropped my phone again.
The glass dropped and broke into pieces.

senses.note: 실수로 떨어뜨리는 것이 drop. 일부러 던지는 건 throw. Drop it! = 그 얘기 그만해(구어).

senses.meaningEn: to become lower in amount or level

examples.en: The temperature dropped to five degrees last night.
Prices usually drop after the holidays.

senses.meaningEn: to take someone or something to a place and leave them there

examples.en: Can you drop me at the bus stop?
examples.ko: 버스 정류장에 내려 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: I'll drop the kids at school on my way.
examples.ko: 가는 길에 아이들 학교에 내려 줄게.

senses.note: drop (sb) off 로도 씀. 반대로 태우러 가는 건 pick up.

senses.meaningEn: a very small amount of liquid

examples.en: I felt a few drops of rain on my face.
Add a drop of oil to the pan.

senses.note: a drop of water/oil. 안약 = eye drops.

senses.meaningEn: a shop that sells medicine and also everyday things like soap and snacks

examples.en: I need to stop by the drugstore for some aspirin.
examples.ko: 아스피린 사러 드러그스토어에 잠깐 들러야 해.

examples.en: The drugstore on the corner is open all night.

senses.note: 미국의 drugstore 는 약뿐 아니라 화장품·음료·과자까지 파는 잡화점(CVS, Walgreens). 처방약 창구만을 가리킬 때는 pharmacy. 'drug'가 들어 있지만 마약 가게가 아님.

senses.meaningEn: a musical instrument that you hit with your hands or sticks

examples.en: My brother plays the drums in a rock band.
examples.ko: 내 형은 록 밴드에서 드럼을 쳐.

examples.en: The drums were too loud for the neighbors.

senses.note: 드럼 세트는 보통 복수형 the drums 로 말함(play the drums). 드럼 연주자는 drummer, 드럼 스틱은 drumsticks(닭다리도 같은 말).

senses.meaningEn: to hit a surface again and again, making a sound

examples.en: Stop drumming on the table, please.
He drummed his fingers while he waited.

senses.note: drum one's fingers = 지루하거나 초조해서 손가락을 두드리다. 과거형 drummed(m 두 개).

senses.meaningEn: a bird with short legs and a wide flat beak that lives near water

examples.en: Let's feed the ducks at the pond.
A duck is swimming with her five babies.
examples.ko: 오리 한 마리가 새끼 다섯 마리와 헤엄치고 있어.

senses.note: 새끼 오리는 duckling. 오리 소리는 quack. 식당 메뉴의 duck 은 오리고기(roast duck).

senses.meaningEn: to lower your head or body quickly so you are not hit or seen

examples.en: Duck! The ball is coming this way!
He ducked just before the door hit him.
examples.ko: 문에 부딪히기 직전에 그가 몸을 숙였어.

senses.note: 오리가 물속에 머리를 쏙 넣는 모습에서 나온 동사. duck out (of) = 슬쩍 빠져나가다(비격식).

senses.meaningEn: through the whole of a period, or at some point in it

examples.en: Please turn off your phone during class.
It rained a lot during our trip.
examples.ko: 우리 여행 중에 비가 많이 왔어.

senses.note: during 뒤에는 명사(during the movie), for 뒤에는 기간 길이(for two hours). 한국어 '~동안' 을 둘 다로 옮기므로 가장 흔한 실수: during two hours(X) → for two hours(O). while 은 뒤에 절(주어+동사)이 온다.

senses.meaningEn: very small dry pieces of dirt that cover surfaces

examples.en: There is a lot of dust on the shelf.
The dust made me sneeze.

senses.note: 불가산(a dust ✗). 미세먼지 = fine dust, 황사 = yellow dust. 먼지 많은 = dusty.

senses.meaningEn: to clean the dust off something

examples.en: I dust the furniture once a week.
examples.ko: 나는 일주일에 한 번 가구 먼지를 닦아.

examples.en: Can you dust the shelves before the guests come?
examples.ko: 손님 오기 전에 선반 먼지 좀 닦아 줄래?

senses.meaningEn: a very large strong bird with a curved beak that hunts small animals

examples.en: An eagle was flying high above the mountains.
examples.ko: 독수리 한 마리가 산 위로 높이 날고 있었어.

examples.en: Eagles have very strong eyes and can see far away.
examples.ko: 독수리는 눈이 아주 좋아서 멀리까지 볼 수 있어.

senses.note: 미국의 상징 새는 bald eagle(흰머리수리). 한국어 '독수리'는 영어로 vulture(죽은 동물을 먹는 새)인 경우가 많으니 주의 — eagle 은 살아 있는 먹이를 잡는 '수리'. eagle eye = 날카로운 관찰력.

senses.meaningEn: one of the two parts of your head that you hear with

examples.en: My ears hurt on the plane.
She whispered something in my ear.

senses.note: 귀앓이 = earache, 이어폰 = earphones, 귀걸이 = earrings. 귀 기울여 듣다 = listen carefully(ear 를 쓰지 않음).

senses.meaningEn: before the usual or expected time

examples.en: You're early! The movie starts at seven.
I have an early class tomorrow.

senses.note: 형용사·부사 모두 early. 비교급 earlier(더 일찍, 조금 전에). early bird = 아침형 인간. Is it too early? = 너무 이른가요?

senses.meaningEn: before the usual time, or near the beginning of a period

examples.en: I get up early every morning.
We left early to avoid the traffic.

senses.note: early in the morning = 아침 일찍, early next week = 다음 주 초에. fast(빠른 속도)와 혼동 금지 — 시간상 '일찍'은 early.

senses.meaningEn: to get money by working

examples.en: How much do you earn a month?
She earns a good salary as a nurse.
examples.ko: 그녀는 간호사로 꽤 괜찮은 월급을 받아.

senses.note: 구어에서는 make money 를 더 많이 씀. 월급 earn, 대회 상금 win, 주식 수익은 make 로 구분.

senses.meaningEn: to get something good because you worked for it

examples.en: He earned an A in math this term.
examples.ko: 그는 이번 학기 수학에서 A 를 받았어.

examples.en: You earned a break. Go rest.
examples.ko: 너 쉴 자격 있어. 가서 쉬어.

senses.note: earn a degree/점수/신뢰(trust) 처럼 '노력해서 얻다'의 뉘앙스. You've earned it = 그럴 만해.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of jewelry that you wear on your ear

examples.en: I lost one earring at the party.
These earrings match your necklace.
examples.ko: 이 귀걸이는 네 목걸이랑 잘 어울려.

senses.note: 보통 복수 earrings, 한 쌍은 a pair of earrings. 한국어 '피어싱'은 영어로 piercing(뚫은 구멍) 또는 그냥 earring.

senses.meaningEn: the planet we live on

examples.en: The Earth goes around the Sun.
There are eight billion people on Earth.

senses.note: 행성 이름일 때는 보통 대문자 Earth, 앞에 the 를 붙이기도 하고 빼기도 함. on earth 는 '도대체'라는 강조 표현(What on earth?).

senses.meaningEn: the soil that plants grow in

examples.en: Cover the seeds with a little earth.
The earth was wet after the rain.
examples.ko: 비가 온 뒤 땅이 젖어 있었어.

senses.note: 흙은 일상적으로 soil, dirt(미)를 더 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: the direction where the sun rises

examples.en: The sun rises in the east.
Gangneung is on the east coast.

senses.note: the East Sea(동해), the East Coast(미국 동부 해안). 형용사·부사로도 쓰임(the east side, head east). eastern = 동부의.

senses.meaningEn: not hard to do or understand

examples.en: The test was easy for me.
English is easier than math for her.

senses.note: It's easy to do = ~하기 쉽다. 부사는 easily(쉽게). 비교급 easier, 최상급 easiest (y → i).

senses.meaningEn: relaxed and not worried

examples.en: Take it easy and get some rest.
We had an easy weekend at home.

senses.note: Take it easy. = 진정해/쉬어 가면서 해/잘 가(헤어질 때). easy-going = 성격이 느긋한. Easy! = 조심해, 살살!

senses.meaningEn: to put food in your mouth, chew it, and swallow it

examples.en: What do you want to eat for lunch?
I ate too much at dinner.

senses.note: 과거 ate /eɪt/, 과거분사 eaten. 한국어 '먹다'와 달리 약은 take medicine, 음료는 drink. 국은 eat soup(숟가락으로 먹으므로).

senses.meaningEn: to have a meal

examples.en: Have you eaten yet?
Let's eat out tonight.

senses.note: eat out = 외식하다, eat in = 집에서 먹다. 인사말 '밥 먹었어?'는 Have you eaten? 으로 번역되지만 영어권에선 인사로 잘 쓰지 않음.

senses.meaningEn: a chicken's egg used as food

examples.en: How do you want your eggs, fried or boiled?
examples.ko: 계란 어떻게 해 줄까, 프라이 아니면 삶은 거?

examples.en: I eat two eggs every morning.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 아침 계란 두 개를 먹어.

senses.note: 조리법 표현: fried egg(계란 프라이), boiled egg(삶은 계란), scrambled eggs(스크램블), sunny-side up(한쪽만 익힌 프라이). 한 판은 a dozen eggs(12개) 또는 a carton of eggs.

senses.meaningEn: a round object with a shell that a baby bird or animal grows inside

examples.en: The bird laid three eggs in the nest.
examples.ko: 새가 둥지에 알을 세 개 낳았어.

examples.en: Look, the eggs are starting to hatch!

senses.note: lay an egg = 알을 낳다, hatch = 부화하다.

senses.meaningEn: the number 8

examples.en: My daughter is eight years old.
I usually sleep about eight hours.
examples.ko: 나는 보통 여덟 시간 정도 자.

senses.note: ate(먹었다)와 발음이 같음(/eɪt/). gh 는 소리 나지 않음. 서수는 eighth(8th, /eɪtθ/). eighteen(18), eighty(80).

senses.meaningEn: the number 18

examples.en: You can vote when you turn eighteen.
examples.ko: 열여덟 살이 되면 투표할 수 있어.

examples.en: The ticket costs eighteen dollars.

senses.note: eight + teen 에서 t 가 하나로 합쳐짐(eighteen). 미국·영국에서 18세는 법적 성인이 되는 나이.

senses.meaningEn: the number 80

examples.en: This phone was about eighty dollars.
My grandpa is eighty and very healthy.

senses.note: eight + y 에서 t 가 하나(eighty). 서수는 eightieth(80th). in his eighties = 80대에.

senses.meaningEn: the joint in the middle of your arm where it bends

examples.en: I bumped my elbow on the table.
Don't put your elbows on the table while eating.
examples.ko: 먹을 때 탁자에 팔꿈치 올리지 마.

senses.note: 다리의 무릎(knee)에 대응하는 팔의 관절. 식탁 예절: no elbows on the table.

senses.meaningEn: a very large gray animal with big ears and a long nose called a trunk

examples.en: An elephant can drink with its long nose.
examples.ko: 코끼리는 긴 코로 물을 마실 수 있어.

examples.en: The baby elephant stayed close to its mother.
examples.ko: 새끼 코끼리가 어미 곁에 바짝 붙어 있었어.

senses.note: 코끼리의 코는 trunk, 긴 이빨은 tusk. 강세는 첫 음절(/ˈel-/). 중급에서 배우는 the elephant in the room 은 '모두 알지만 말하지 않는 문제'.

senses.meaningEn: a machine that carries people up and down inside a building

examples.en: Take the elevator to the tenth floor.
The elevator is out of order again.

senses.note: 미국식. 영국에서는 lift. 엘리베이터를 '타다'는 take/get in the elevator. 에스컬레이터는 escalator.

senses.meaningEn: the number 11

examples.en: The meeting starts at eleven.
A soccer team has eleven players.

senses.note: 11, 12는 -teen 이 붙지 않는 예외. 강세는 두 번째 음절(e-LEV-en). 서수는 eleventh(11th).

senses.meaningEn: a message sent from one computer or phone to another

examples.en: I'll send you an email with the details.
What's your email address?

senses.note: 한 통은 an email, 전체 시스템은 by email(관사 없음). 'Check your email' = 메일함 확인해.

senses.meaningEn: to send someone an email

examples.en: Email me the photos, please.
I emailed the teacher about the homework.

senses.note: email + 사람 + 물건. text 처럼 동사로 바로 씀. '메일하다'보다 email/send an email 이 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: having nothing or no one inside

examples.en: The fridge is empty again.
Excuse me, is this seat empty?

senses.note: an empty box/room/street. 빈자리 묻기: Is this seat taken? 도 흔함. 공복에 = on an empty stomach.

senses.meaningEn: to take everything out of something

examples.en: Can you empty the trash, please?
I emptied my bag onto the bed to find my keys.
examples.ko: 열쇠를 찾으려고 가방을 침대에 다 쏟아 냈어.

senses.note: empty the trash/dishwasher/pockets. 과거형 emptied.

senses.meaningEn: the part of a car, plane, or machine that makes it move

examples.en: Turn off the engine while you wait.
The engine is making a strange noise.

senses.note: start the engine(시동을 걸다), turn off the engine(시동을 끄다). 검색 엔진은 search engine, 소방차는 fire engine.

senses.meaningEn: a person who designs or builds machines, roads, bridges, or software

examples.en: My father is an engineer at a car company.
The engineers fixed the problem in an hour.
examples.ko: 엔지니어들이 한 시간 만에 문제를 고쳤어.

senses.note: software engineer(소프트웨어 개발자), civil engineer(토목 기술자). 강세는 마지막 음절 -neer 에.

senses.meaningEn: a person who drives a train

examples.en: The engineer stopped the train at the station.
The engineer waved to the kids on the platform.

senses.note: 기차 기관사를 미국에서는 engineer, 영국에서는 train driver 라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: the language spoken in the UK, the US, and many other countries

examples.en: I study English for an hour every day.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 한 시간씩 영어를 공부해.

examples.en: How do you say this in English?

senses.note: 항상 대문자 E(English). speak English(관사 없음). in English = 영어로. 영어 수업은 English class.

senses.meaningEn: from or relating to England

examples.en: We had a traditional English breakfast.
My new friend is English, from London.
examples.ko: 내 새 친구는 런던 출신의 영국 사람이야.

senses.note: English 는 '잉글랜드'의. 영국 전체(UK)는 British. 스코틀랜드 사람에게 English 라고 하면 실례.

senses.meaningEn: to get pleasure from something

examples.en: I really enjoyed the concert last night.
Do you enjoy cooking on weekends?

senses.note: enjoy + 명사/-ing(enjoy to cook ✗). 'Enjoy your meal!' = 맛있게 드세요. 'Enjoy!' 한 단어로도 씀. enjoy yourself = 즐겁게 보내다.

senses.meaningEn: to go or come into a place

examples.en: Please knock before you enter the room.
Only staff can enter this area.
examples.ko: 이 구역은 직원만 들어갈 수 있어요.

senses.note: enter + 장소(enter into the room 은 X). 일상 대화에서는 go in/come in 이 더 자연스럽고, enter 는 안내문·격식체에 많음. 명사 entrance(입구).

senses.meaningEn: to type information into a computer or phone

examples.en: Enter your password and press OK.
I entered the wrong phone number.

senses.note: 키보드의 Enter 키도 여기서 옴. enter a code/password/number. 대회에 참가하다(enter a contest)라는 뜻도 있음.

senses.meaningEn: a door or gate where you go into a building or place

examples.en: I'll wait for you at the main entrance.
The entrance to the park is over there.

senses.note: the entrance to + 장소(of 보다 to 가 자연스러움). main entrance(정문), entrance fee(입장료). 지하철역 입구도 entrance 지만 번호를 말할 때는 보통 exit(Exit 2)으로 통일함.

senses.meaningEn: a small piece of rubber used to remove pencil marks

examples.en: I need an eraser to fix this mistake.
Can I use your eraser for a second?

senses.note: 미국식 eraser, 영국식 rubber. 미국에서 rubber 는 전혀 다른 뜻이 되므로 주의. 칠판 지우개도 eraser.

senses.meaningEn: to get away from a place or a dangerous situation

examples.en: Two monkeys escaped from the zoo yesterday.
examples.ko: 어제 원숭이 두 마리가 동물원에서 탈출했어.

examples.en: Everyone escaped from the burning building safely.

senses.note: escape from + 장소. 위험을 "피하다"는 escape (전치사 없이): escape danger. 키보드 Esc 키가 바로 이 단어.

senses.meaningEn: the act of getting away, or a short break from daily life

examples.en: The thief made his escape through the window.
A weekend at the beach is a nice escape.

senses.note: escape room = 방 탈출 게임. fire escape = 화재 비상 계단.

senses.meaningEn: the part of the day from the end of the afternoon until you go to bed

examples.en: We usually eat dinner at seven in the evening.
What are you doing this evening?

senses.note: evening 은 대략 6시~취침 전, night 은 어두운 밤 전체(혹은 잠자는 시간). 만났을 때 인사는 Good evening, 헤어질 때·잘 때 인사는 Good night. 한국인이 자주 틀리는 것: 저녁 7시 약속을 at night 이라고 하면 어색함 → in the evening.

senses.meaningEn: every person in a group

examples.en: Hi, everybody! How are you today?
Everybody loves this song.

senses.note: everyone 과 뜻이 같고 조금 더 구어적. 글에서는 everyone 이 약간 더 흔함. 단수 동사(loves)와 함께 씀.

senses.meaningEn: every person in a group

examples.en: Everyone is here, so let's start.
Thank you, everyone, for coming today.
examples.ko: 오늘 와 주신 모든 분들, 감사합니다.

senses.note: 뜻은 복수지만 문법은 단수: Everyone is(○) Everyone are(×). every one(띄어쓰기)은 '하나하나 전부'로 다른 말.

senses.meaningEn: an important test at the end of a course or school year

examples.en: My final exams start next week.
Did you pass your driving exam?

senses.note: examination 의 줄임말. take an exam(시험을 보다), pass/fail an exam. 수능처럼 큰 시험은 exam, 쪽지시험은 quiz.

senses.meaningEn: something that shows what a kind of thing is like

examples.en: Can you give me an example?
examples.ko: 예를 하나 들어 줄 수 있어요?

examples.en: For example, apples and pears are fruit.

senses.note: give an example(예를 들다), for example = 예를 들어(e.g. 로 축약). 'give me a sample' 은 물건의 견본을 달라는 뜻이니 구분.

senses.meaningEn: a person or action that is good and that others should copy

examples.en: Parents should set a good example.
She's a good example for her little brother.

senses.note: set an example = 본보기를 보이다. follow someone's example = ~를 본받다.

senses.meaningEn: used to politely get attention, apologize, or ask to pass

examples.en: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
Excuse me, could I get past?

senses.note: Excuse me 는 말 걸기·지나가기·재채기 뒤 등 다양하게 씀. 잘못을 사과할 때는 I'm sorry.

senses.meaningEn: a reason you give to explain why you did something wrong

examples.en: That's a bad excuse for being late.
Stop making excuses and do your homework.

senses.note: 명사는 발음이 /ɪkˈskjuːs/ 로 끝소리가 달라짐. make an excuse = 핑계를 대다.

senses.meaningEn: physical activity you do to stay healthy

examples.en: I need more exercise. I sit all day.
examples.ko: 운동이 더 필요해. 하루 종일 앉아 있거든.

examples.en: Walking is good exercise for everyone.

senses.note: '운동하다'는 do exercise 또는 exercise(동사). play exercise 는 틀림. 특정 스포츠는 play soccer 처럼 play 를 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: to do physical activity to stay healthy

examples.en: I try to exercise every morning.
Do you exercise at the gym or at home?

senses.meaningEn: a short piece of work you do to practice something

examples.en: Do exercises one to five for homework.
This grammar exercise is really hard.
examples.ko: 이 문법 연습 문제 정말 어렵다.

senses.note: 교과서의 '연습 문제'는 exercise. 시험 문제는 question.

senses.meaningEn: a door or way out of a building, a road, or a place

examples.en: Where is the exit?
Meet me at exit three of the subway station.

senses.note: emergency exit(비상구), 지하철 출구 번호는 Exit 3 처럼 말함. 고속도로의 나가는 길도 exit(Take the next exit).

senses.meaningEn: to leave a place, or to close a program on a computer

examples.en: Please exit through the back door.
Click here to exit the app.

senses.note: 동사 exit 은 안내문·컴퓨터 화면에서 주로 보임. 일상 대화에서 '나가다'는 leave/go out 이 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: to think that something will probably happen

examples.en: I expect the bus will be late again.
We didn't expect so many people to come.
examples.ko: 이렇게 많은 사람이 올 줄은 몰랐어.

senses.note: expect + to 동사 / expect + 목적어 + to 동사 / expect (that) 문장. 좋은 일만 뜻하는 hope 와 달리 중립적.

senses.meaningEn: to be waiting for someone or something to arrive

examples.en: I'm expecting a package this afternoon.
Are you expecting someone? The doorbell rang.
examples.ko: 누구 올 사람 있어? 초인종이 울렸어.

senses.note: She's expecting (a baby). = 임신 중이다. 이 뜻도 아주 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: to believe that someone should do something

examples.en: The teacher expects us to be on time.
My parents expect too much from me.
examples.ko: 부모님은 나한테 너무 많은 걸 기대하셔.

senses.note: expect a lot of/from 사람 = ~에게 많이 기대하다.

senses.meaningEn: costing a lot of money

examples.en: That restaurant is too expensive for us.
Why are these headphones so expensive?

senses.note: '가격이 비싸다'는 The price is high. 라고 해야 함(expensive price 는 어색). 구어로는 pricey 도 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to make something clear by giving details about it

examples.en: Can you explain this word to me again?
examples.ko: 이 단어 다시 한 번 설명해 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: The teacher explained how to use the past tense.
examples.ko: 선생님이 과거형 쓰는 법을 설명해 주셨어.

senses.note: explain 뒤에 사람을 바로 쓰지 않음 — explain me X(✗) → explain X to me(○). 명사는 explanation. 'That explains it.' = 그래서 그랬구나.

senses.meaningEn: one of the two parts of your face that you see with

examples.en: Close your eyes and count to ten.
My eyes are tired from the screen.

senses.note: She has brown eyes. 눈 색을 말할 때는 복수. eye doctor(안과 의사), eye drops(안약).

senses.meaningEn: used in phrases about watching something carefully

examples.en: Can you keep an eye on my bag?
Keep an eye on the kids, please.

senses.note: keep an eye on ~ = ~를 지켜보다, 신경 써서 보다. catch my eye = 눈에 띄다.

senses.meaningEn: the front of your head with your eyes, nose, and mouth

examples.en: Go wash your face before breakfast.
She had a big smile on her face.

senses.note: make a face = 얼굴을 찡그리다. face to face = 얼굴을 마주 보고, 직접.

senses.meaningEn: to have the front toward something

examples.en: My room faces the park.
examples.ko: 내 방은 공원 쪽을 향해 있어.

examples.en: Please face the camera and smile.

senses.note: face the window / face south(남향). 뒤에 to 를 붙이지 않음.

senses.meaningEn: to deal with a difficult situation

examples.en: We have to face the problem now.
I can't face another exam this week.
examples.ko: 이번 주에 시험 하나 더는 못 견디겠어.

senses.note: Let's face it. = 인정하자, 현실을 보자.

senses.meaningEn: a building where things are made in large numbers with machines

examples.en: My uncle works at a car factory.
The factory makes about a thousand shoes a day.
examples.ko: 그 공장은 하루에 신발 천 켤레 정도를 만들어.

senses.note: 공장에서 '일하다'는 work at/in a factory. 공장 노동자는 factory worker. 큰 제조 시설은 plant 라고도 함(power plant 발전소).

senses.meaningEn: to drop down to the ground, often by accident

examples.en: Be careful, don't fall on the ice!
He fell off his bike and hurt his knee.

senses.note: fall down(넘어지다), fall off(~에서 떨어지다), fall asleep(잠들다), fall in love(사랑에 빠지다). 불규칙 변화 fall-fell-fallen.

senses.meaningEn: to become lower in number, price, or level

examples.en: Prices usually fall after the holidays.
The temperature fell below zero last night.

senses.meaningEn: the season between summer and winter, when leaves change color

examples.en: I love the colors of fall.
Classes start again in the fall.

senses.note: 미국에서는 fall, 영국에서는 autumn 을 주로 쓴다. 미국에서도 autumn 은 알아듣지만 조금 문어적으로 들림. fall semester = 가을 학기.

senses.meaningEn: a group of people who are related, such as parents and their children

examples.en: I have a big family with three brothers.
We eat dinner together as a family.
examples.ko: 우리는 가족이 다 함께 저녁을 먹어.

senses.note: family 는 집합명사. 미국식은 My family is..., 영국식은 My family are... 둘 다 가능.

senses.meaningEn: made for or shared by a whole family

examples.en: It's a family movie, so the kids can watch.
examples.ko: 가족 영화라서 아이들도 볼 수 있어.

examples.en: We're going on a family trip this weekend.

senses.note: family dinner, family car, family name(성) 처럼 명사 앞에서 형용사처럼 쓰임.

senses.meaningEn: a machine with blades that turn to move air and keep you cool

examples.en: Turn on the fan, it's so hot in here.
The fan is making a strange noise.

senses.note: electric fan(선풍기), ceiling fan(천장 선풍기). 부채(손으로 흔드는 것)도 fan.

senses.meaningEn: someone who likes a team, singer, or thing very much

examples.en: I'm a big fan of this band.
The fans cheered when the team scored.

senses.note: I'm a big fan of ~ = ~를 정말 좋아해 (사람뿐 아니라 음식·영화에도 씀). I'm not a fan of ~ = ~는 별로 안 좋아해.

senses.meaningEn: a long distance away

examples.en: How far is the airport from here?
Don't go too far from the house.

senses.note: 긍정문에서 'It's far.' 보다 'It's a long way.' 가 더 자연스러움. far 는 주로 의문문·부정문(How far…? / not far)에 씀. 비교급 farther/further, 최상급 farthest/furthest.

senses.meaningEn: very much, used to make a comparison stronger

examples.en: This one is far better than the old one.
The test was far more difficult than I thought.

senses.note: far + 비교급(far better, far more). 'so far' 는 '지금까지', 'by far' 는 '단연코'.

senses.meaningEn: an area of land and buildings where people grow food and keep animals

examples.en: My grandparents live on a farm.
We saw pigs and chickens at the farm.

senses.note: 농장에 산다는 on a farm (in ✗). 농부 = farmer, 농사 = farming.

senses.meaningEn: to grow crops or keep animals on land to make money

examples.en: His family has farmed this land for 100 years.
examples.ko: 그의 가족은 100년 동안 이 땅에서 농사를 지어 왔어.

examples.en: They farm rice and vegetables.

senses.meaningEn: a person who owns or works on a farm

examples.en: My grandfather was a rice farmer.
The farmer feeds the cows every morning.
examples.ko: 농부는 매일 아침 소에게 먹이를 줘.

senses.note: farm(농장) + -er. farmers' market = 농산물 직거래 장터. '농사짓다'는 farm(v.) 또는 grow rice/vegetables.

senses.meaningEn: a style of clothes or hair that is popular at a certain time

examples.en: My sister loves fashion and reads about it every day.
examples.ko: 내 여동생은 패션을 좋아해서 매일 관련 글을 읽어.

examples.en: Short hair is in fashion again this year.

senses.note: in fashion = 유행하는, out of fashion = 유행이 지난. fashion show(패션쇼), fashion model(패션모델). 한국어 '패션 감각'은 a sense of style 또는 fashion sense.

senses.meaningEn: hot food like burgers and fries that is served quickly

examples.en: I eat fast food maybe once a week.
examples.ko: 패스트푸드는 일주일에 한 번 정도 먹어.

examples.en: Let's grab some fast food on the way home.
examples.ko: 집에 가는 길에 패스트푸드 좀 사 가자.

senses.note: 불가산명사. a fast food 라고 하지 않음. '패스트푸드점'은 fast food restaurant.

senses.meaningEn: having too much flesh on the body

examples.en: My cat is getting fat because he eats too much.
examples.ko: 우리 고양이는 너무 많이 먹어서 살이 찌고 있어.

examples.en: I feel fat after the holidays.

senses.note: 사람에게 직접 fat 이라고 하면 매우 무례하다. 완곡하게는 overweight, heavy, big 을 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: the oily substance in food or under the skin

examples.en: This milk has no fat in it.
Cut the fat off the meat before cooking.
examples.ko: 요리하기 전에 고기에서 기름을 떼어 내.

senses.note: low-fat(저지방), fat-free(무지방). 요리용 기름은 oil.

senses.meaningEn: a male parent

examples.en: My father likes to fish on weekends.
examples.ko: 우리 아버지는 주말에 낚시하는 걸 좋아하셔.

examples.en: His father is a teacher at my school.

senses.note: 격식적·중립적 표현. 직접 부를 때는 Dad. Father's Day = 아버지의 날.

senses.meaningEn: one of the soft, light things that cover a bird's body

examples.en: I found a white feather on the beach.
This pillow is filled with soft feathers.
examples.ko: 이 베개는 부드러운 깃털로 채워져 있어.

senses.note: 'as light as a feather' = 깃털처럼 가볍다. 'birds of a feather flock together' = 유유상종. th 는 /ð/ 로 발음.

senses.meaningEn: the second month of the year, with 28 or 29 days

examples.en: February is the shortest month.
We're going skiing in February.

senses.note: 첫 r 을 발음하지 않는 사람이 많아 /ˈfebjueri/ 처럼 들리기도 한다. 철자 Feb-ru-ary 의 r 을 빼먹기 쉬움. 줄임말 Feb.

senses.meaningEn: to give food to an animal

examples.en: Did you feed the cat this morning?
Please don't feed the animals at the zoo.

senses.note: 불규칙 변화: feed – fed – fed. 먹이 자체도 feed(명사)라고 함. 'Give the cat food' 보다 feed the cat 이 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: to give food to a person, especially someone who cannot eat alone

examples.en: I need to feed the baby now.
She fed the kids and put them to bed.

senses.note: 가족을 먹여 살리다 = feed a family. 모유 수유는 breastfeed. 자기가 먹는 건 eat, 남을 먹이는 건 feed.

senses.meaningEn: to experience a particular physical or emotional state

examples.en: I feel sick, so I'm staying home today.
examples.ko: 몸이 안 좋아서 오늘은 집에 있을래.

examples.en: Are you feeling better now?

senses.note: feel + 형용사: feel tired / happy / cold. How do you feel? = 기분·몸 상태 묻기. feel well = 몸이 괜찮다.

senses.meaningEn: to touch something to find out what it is like

examples.en: Feel this blanket, it's so soft.
examples.ko: 이 담요 만져 봐, 정말 부드러워.

examples.en: I felt something move under the bed.
examples.ko: 침대 밑에서 뭔가 움직이는 게 느껴졌어.

senses.meaningEn: to have an opinion about something

examples.en: I feel we should leave a little early.
examples.ko: 조금 일찍 출발해야 할 것 같아.

examples.en: Do you feel this is a good idea?

senses.note: think 보다 부드럽고 개인적인 느낌. I feel like + 절 로도 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to want to do or have something

examples.en: I feel like eating pizza tonight.
I don't feel like going out today.

senses.note: feel like + -ing / 명사: I feel like a coffee. 직역 '~처럼 느끼다'가 아니라 '~하고 싶다'.

senses.meaningEn: the plural of foot: the parts of your body at the ends of your legs

examples.en: My feet hurt after walking all day.
Please take off your shoes; your feet must be tired.

senses.note: 항상 복수 취급: My feet are cold. (is 아님). 발 하나는 foot.

senses.meaningEn: a big event with music, food, or art that happens for several days

examples.en: There's a food festival downtown this weekend.
examples.ko: 이번 주말에 시내에서 음식 축제가 있어.

examples.en: We danced all night at the music festival.

senses.note: film festival(영화제), music festival, cherry blossom festival(벚꽃 축제). 한국의 '축제'는 거의 다 festival 로 옮김.

senses.meaningEn: a special day or time when people celebrate something, often religious

examples.en: Chuseok is a big festival in Korea.
Families come together for the festival.

senses.note: 설·추석 같은 명절은 festival 또는 holiday. 일상에서는 holiday 가 더 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: a body temperature that is higher than normal because you are sick

examples.en: The baby has a high fever.
Her fever went down after she took the medicine.
examples.ko: 약을 먹고 나서 그녀의 열이 내렸어.

senses.note: have / run a fever(열이 나다). 열이 내리다 = the fever goes down / breaks. 한국어 '열' 그대로 heat 라고 하지 않도록 주의.

senses.meaningEn: an open area of land, often used for growing crops or keeping animals

examples.en: Cows are eating grass in the field.
The farmer works in the rice field every day.
