senses.meaningEn: two people who are together or do something together

examples.en: Work in pairs and talk about your weekend.
examples.ko: 둘씩 짝을 지어 주말에 대해 이야기해 보세요.

examples.en: The two of them make a nice pair.

senses.note: in pairs = 둘씩. 교실에서 pair work(짝 활동)라는 표현을 자주 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a very large, grand house where a king, queen, or president lives

examples.en: We visited an old palace in Seoul.
examples.ko: 우리는 서울에 있는 옛 궁궐을 방문했어.

examples.en: The king lived in this palace for forty years.

senses.note: 경복궁은 Gyeongbokgung Palace. palace 는 왕이 '사는' 호화로운 집, castle 은 적을 막기 위한 성(방어용). 발음은 /ˈpæləs/ 로 '팰리스'.

senses.meaningEn: a large black and white animal like a bear that lives in China and eats bamboo

examples.en: The pandas at the zoo were eating bamboo.
My daughter has a panda on her backpack.
examples.ko: 우리 딸 가방에 판다 그림이 있어.

senses.note: giant panda(자이언트 판다)가 정식 이름. 대나무는 bamboo. 한국의 '푸바오'처럼 판다는 아이들 대화에 자주 등장.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of clothing that covers the legs, with a separate part for each leg

examples.en: These pants are a little long for me.
He put on his pants and a sweater.

senses.note: 항상 복수형. 한 벌은 a pair of pants. 영국에서 pants 는 '속옷'이고 바지는 trousers 이니 주의.

senses.meaningEn: thin material that you write or draw on

examples.en: Can I have a piece of paper?
examples.ko: 종이 한 장 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: Write your name at the top of the paper.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사. '종이 한 장'은 a paper ✗ → a piece of paper / a sheet of paper.

senses.meaningEn: a test, or a piece of writing done for school

examples.en: I have to write a paper for history class.
The teacher handed back our papers today.

senses.note: 이 뜻일 때는 셀 수 있는 명사(a paper, papers).

senses.meaningEn: a newspaper

examples.en: My dad reads the paper every morning.
examples.ko: 우리 아빠는 매일 아침 신문을 읽으셔.

examples.en: Did you see the story in today's paper?

senses.note: 구어에서 newspaper 를 줄여 the paper 라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: a person's mother or father

examples.en: My parents live in a small town.
Every parent wants the best for their child.
examples.ko: 모든 부모는 자식에게 가장 좋은 걸 바라지.

senses.note: 한 명이면 parent, 두 분이면 parents. 한국어 '부모님'을 말할 때 대부분 복수 parents 를 써야 함.

senses.meaningEn: the mother or father of a student, in relation to the school

examples.en: Parents are invited to the school meeting on Friday.
The teacher called my parents last night.

senses.note: parent-teacher meeting = 학부모 상담.

senses.meaningEn: a large open area with grass and trees where people can walk and relax

examples.en: Let's have lunch in the park.
The kids are playing at the park.

senses.note: 놀이공원은 amusement park / theme park, 국립공원은 national park. 주차장은 parking lot(미국).

senses.meaningEn: to stop a car and leave it somewhere for a while

examples.en: Where did you park the car?
You can't park here. It's a bus stop.
examples.ko: 여기 주차하면 안 돼. 버스 정류장이야.

senses.note: 주차 = parking(명사). '파킹하다'를 do parking 이라고 하지 않고 동사 park 로 말함. 'No parking' = 주차 금지.

senses.meaningEn: an open area where people can leave their cars

examples.en: The parking lot was full, so we parked on the street.
I'll meet you in the parking lot behind the mall.

senses.note: 미국식 parking lot, 영국식 car park. 건물형 주차장은 parking garage. 한국식 '파킹'만 말하면 안 통함. 주차 공간 하나는 parking space/spot.

senses.meaningEn: a colorful bird that can copy human speech

examples.en: My uncle has a parrot that says hello.
The parrot has green and red feathers.
examples.ko: 그 앵무새는 초록색과 빨간색 깃털이 있어.

senses.note: 동사로 쓰면 '뜻도 모르고 따라 말하다'(parrot what someone says). 발음은 /ˈpærət/ — 'carrot'과 라임.

senses.meaningEn: the person you do an activity or game with

examples.en: Find a partner and practice the dialogue.
My partner and I won the game.

senses.meaningEn: the person you are married to or in a long relationship with

examples.en: She came to the party with her partner.
You can bring your partner to the dinner.
examples.ko: 저녁 식사에 배우자나 연인을 데려와도 돼.

senses.note: 결혼 여부·성별을 밝히지 않고 연인/배우자를 말할 때 두루 쓰는 중립적인 단어. husband/wife/boyfriend/girlfriend 를 모를 때 안전함.

senses.meaningEn: a person who owns a business together with someone else

examples.en: He and his business partner opened a café.
The two partners share the work.

senses.meaningEn: a social event where people meet to eat, drink, talk, and have fun

examples.en: Are you coming to my birthday party?
We had a small party at home last night.

senses.note: have/throw a party(파티를 열다), go to a party. 한국어 '회식'은 party 가 아니라 company dinner / team dinner.

senses.meaningEn: a political group that tries to win elections

examples.en: Which party won the election?
My uncle works for a political party.

senses.note: political party. 뉴스에서 자주 들리는 뜻. 파티와 전혀 다른 의미이니 문맥으로 구분.

senses.meaningEn: to give something to someone by handing it over

examples.en: Could you pass the salt, please?
Pass me my phone, will you?

senses.note: 식탁에서 가장 많이 쓰는 표현. pass + 사람 + 물건 순서.

senses.meaningEn: to succeed in a test or exam

examples.en: I passed my driving test!
Did everyone pass the exam?

senses.note: pass the exam = 합격. '시험을 보다'는 take the exam.

senses.meaningEn: to go past something or someone

examples.en: We passed a small lake on the way.
The bus passes right by my house.
examples.ko: 그 버스는 우리 집 바로 앞을 지나가.

senses.note: pass by = 지나가다. 시간이 '지나다'도 pass(Time passes quickly).

senses.meaningEn: a person who is traveling in a vehicle but is not driving it

examples.en: All passengers must wear a seat belt.
The bus was full of passengers.

senses.note: 운전하지 않고 타는 사람 전부. passenger seat = (차의) 조수석. 비행기 안내 방송에서 'Attention, passengers.' 로 시작하는 경우가 많음.

senses.meaningEn: an official document with your photo that you need to enter other countries

examples.en: Don't forget your passport!
May I see your passport, please?

senses.note: 공항에서 passport control(출입국 심사). 여권을 만들다 = get a passport, 갱신하다 = renew. 비자(visa)와 구분.

senses.meaningEn: after a particular hour on the clock

examples.en: It's ten past eight.
The kids went to bed at half past nine.

senses.note: 분이 30 이하일 때 '분 past 시' 로 말한다(twenty past six = 6:20). 30 이 넘으면 to 를 쓴다(twenty to seven = 6:40). 미국식은 after 도 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: moving by or beyond a place

examples.en: Walk past the bank and turn left.
A bus just drove past us.
examples.ko: 버스 한 대가 방금 우리 옆을 지나갔어.

senses.note: go past / walk past / drive past 처럼 이동 동사와 짝을 이룬다. 동사 pass 의 과거형 passed 와 발음이 같아 글에서 헷갈리기 쉬움.

senses.meaningEn: the time before now

examples.en: In the past, people wrote letters by hand.
Let's forget the past and start again.

senses.note: the past(과거), the present(현재), the future(미래). 형용사로도 쓴다: the past week(지난 한 주), past tense(과거 시제).

senses.meaningEn: an Italian food made from flour and water, such as spaghetti

examples.en: I'm making pasta for dinner tonight.
This pasta needs more sauce.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: pastas (×), a pasta (×) → a plate of pasta, some pasta. spaghetti, penne, macaroni 가 모두 pasta 의 종류.

senses.meaningEn: a person who is getting medical care from a doctor

examples.en: The doctor sees about thirty patients a day.
examples.ko: 그 의사는 하루에 환자 30명 정도를 봐.

examples.en: Patients must wait here until their name is called.
examples.ko: 환자는 이름이 불릴 때까지 여기서 기다려야 해요.

senses.meaningEn: able to wait calmly without getting angry

examples.en: Please be patient. The bus will come soon.
examples.ko: 조금만 참아. 버스 곧 올 거야.

examples.en: My teacher is very patient with us.
examples.ko: 우리 선생님은 우리에게 아주 참을성이 많으셔.

senses.note: 명사 '환자'와 형용사 '참을성 있는'이 같은 철자. be patient with + 사람. 명사형 patience(인내).

senses.meaningEn: the foot of an animal such as a dog, cat, or bear

examples.en: The puppy put its paw on my knee.
Wipe the dog's paws before he comes in.
examples.ko: 개 들어오기 전에 발 닦아 줘.

senses.note: 개·고양이·곰처럼 발톱 있는 동물의 발. 말·소의 발은 hoof. 강아지에게 '손!' 하는 명령은 Shake! 또는 Paw!.

senses.meaningEn: to give money for something you buy or use

examples.en: I'll pay for the coffee.
Did you pay the rent yet?

senses.note: pay for + 물건·서비스(pay for dinner), pay + 돈·요금(pay 10 dollars, pay the bill). 'pay the coffee' 는 틀림. 결제 수단: pay by card / in cash.

senses.meaningEn: the money you get for doing your job

examples.en: The pay is good, but the hours are long.
She got a pay raise last month.

senses.note: 불가산 명사. payday(월급날), pay raise(임금 인상), paycheck(급여, 급여 수표).

senses.meaningEn: physical education; the school subject where you do sports and exercise

examples.en: We played basketball in PE today.
Don't forget your PE uniform tomorrow.

senses.note: physical education 의 약자, 대문자 PE 로 쓰고 글자 하나씩 /피이/로 읽음. PE class = 체육 수업, PE teacher = 체육 선생님. 미국에서는 gym (class) 라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: a soft round fruit with a fuzzy skin and a large seed inside

examples.en: I bought some peaches at the market.
Peaches are in season in the summer.

senses.note: 복수형은 peaches. 색을 말할 때도 peach(살구색·복숭아색)라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: a small nut with a soft brown shell that grows under the ground

examples.en: I'm allergic to peanuts.
Do you want peanut butter on your toast?

senses.note: peanut butter(땅콩버터)는 미국 가정의 기본 식품. 알레르기 표시에서 자주 보는 단어.

senses.meaningEn: a sweet fruit that is narrow at the top and wide at the bottom

examples.en: Would you like an apple or a pear?
Korean pears are big and very juicy.
examples.ko: 한국 배는 크고 아주 물이 많아.

senses.note: pair(한 쌍)와 발음이 같음. 한국 배는 Asian pear 또는 Korean pear 라고 구분해 부름.

senses.meaningEn: a tool with ink inside that you use to write

examples.en: Do you have a pen I can use?
examples.ko: 내가 쓸 수 있는 펜 있어?

examples.en: Please sign here with a black pen.

senses.note: 볼펜은 ballpoint pen 또는 그냥 pen. '볼펜' 그대로 ball pen 은 잘 안 씀. in pen = 펜으로. 사인펜은 marker.

senses.meaningEn: a thin wooden stick with a dark center used for writing or drawing

examples.en: Can I borrow a pencil, please?
Write your answers in pencil, not pen.

senses.note: in pencil = 연필로(관사 없음). pencil case = 필통, pencil sharpener = 연필깎이. 샤프펜슬은 mechanical pencil.

senses.meaningEn: a black and white sea bird that cannot fly but swims very well and lives in cold places

examples.en: Penguins can't fly, but they swim really well.
examples.ko: 펭귄은 날지 못하지만 수영은 정말 잘해.

examples.en: The penguins at the aquarium were so cute.

senses.note: 펭귄은 날지 못하는 새(bird). 발음은 '펭귄'보다 '펭그윈'(/ˈpeŋɡwɪn/)에 가까움. 펭귄은 뒤뚱뒤뚱 걷다 = waddle.

senses.meaningEn: persons in general; more than one person

examples.en: There were so many people at the mall.
Most people like to sleep in on Sundays.
examples.ko: 대부분의 사람들은 일요일에 늦잠 자는 걸 좋아해.

senses.note: people 은 이미 복수이므로 peoples, many peoples 라고 쓰지 않음. People are... (is 아님).

senses.meaningEn: all the persons who live in a country or belong to one group

examples.en: The Korean people love their food.
The president spoke to the people on TV.

senses.note: 이 뜻에서는 the people 로 쓰며, 여러 민족을 말할 때만 peoples 복수가 가능.

senses.meaningEn: a hot-tasting black or white powder used to add flavor to food

examples.en: Would you like some pepper on your salad?
Add salt and pepper to taste.

senses.note: 후추는 셀 수 없음: black pepper(검은 후추). 후추통은 pepper shaker, 후추 그라인더는 pepper mill.

senses.meaningEn: a hollow green, red, or yellow vegetable, or a small hot one used in spicy food

examples.en: I bought red and green peppers for the salad.
examples.ko: 샐러드용으로 빨간 피망과 초록 피망을 샀어.

examples.en: These little peppers are really spicy!

senses.note: 채소일 때는 셀 수 있음. 피망·파프리카는 bell pepper, 매운 고추는 chili pepper 또는 hot pepper. 한국어 '파프리카'는 영어로 bell pepper 라고 해야 통함.

senses.meaningEn: to sing, dance, act, or play music for an audience

examples.en: The band will perform at the school festival.
examples.ko: 그 밴드가 학교 축제에서 공연할 거야.

examples.en: She performed a song for her grandmother.
examples.ko: 그녀는 할머니를 위해 노래 한 곡을 불렀어.

senses.note: perform a song/dance/play. 공연 = performance, 공연자 = performer.

senses.meaningEn: to do a task or job

examples.en: The students performed well on the test.
The doctor performed the operation this morning.

senses.note: perform well/badly 로 "잘하다/못하다"를 격식 있게 표현. do 보다 조금 격식적.

senses.meaningEn: one human being

examples.en: She is a very kind person.
Only one person can sit here.
examples.ko: 여기엔 한 사람만 앉을 수 있어.

senses.note: 복수는 보통 people. persons 는 법률·공식 안내문에서만 (예: Maximum 4 persons).

senses.meaningEn: used in 'in person': by being there yourself, not by phone or online

examples.en: Let's meet in person next week.
You have to sign the paper in person.
examples.ko: 서류는 본인이 직접 와서 서명해야 해.

senses.note: in person = 직접, 대면으로. 온라인 회의와 대비할 때 자주 씀.

senses.meaningEn: an animal that you keep at home for company

examples.en: Do you have any pets at home?
My pet is a small white dog.

senses.note: pet shop(펫숍), pet food. 반려동물 주인은 pet owner.

senses.meaningEn: to touch an animal gently with your hand

examples.en: Can I pet your dog?
She petted the cat softly.

senses.note: 과거형은 t 를 겹쳐 petted. 사람을 쓰다듬을 때는 stroke 나 pat 을 더 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a shop or a counter in a shop where you can get medicine

examples.en: Take this to the pharmacy to get your medicine.
The pharmacy closes at nine on weekdays.

senses.note: 처방약을 받는 곳. 약사는 pharmacist. 미국에서 일상적으로는 drugstore 라고도 하고, 영국은 chemist's 라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: a device you use to call people, send messages, and go online

examples.en: I left my phone at home today.
Can I borrow your phone for a second?
examples.ko: 잠깐 네 폰 좀 빌려도 돼?

senses.note: cell phone(미) / mobile phone(영). 요즘은 phone 만 해도 스마트폰을 뜻함. on the phone = 통화 중. 한국어 "핸드폰(hand phone)"은 안 통함.

senses.meaningEn: to call someone on the phone

examples.en: Phone me when you get home.
I'll phone the restaurant and book a table.

senses.note: 미국에서는 call 이 더 흔함. phone to me (X) → phone me.

senses.meaningEn: a large musical instrument with black and white keys that you press

examples.en: My daughter plays the piano every evening.
Can you play this song on the piano?
examples.ko: 이 노래 피아노로 칠 수 있어?

senses.note: 악기 앞에는 the — play the piano. '피아노 레슨'은 piano lesson, 피아노 연주자는 pianist. 한국어 '피아노를 치다'를 hit 으로 옮기면 안 되고 play.

senses.meaningEn: to choose something from a group

examples.en: Pick any color you like.
Who picked this restaurant? It's great!
examples.ko: 이 식당 누가 골랐어? 정말 좋다!

senses.note: choose 보다 가볍고 구어적. 명사로도: Take your pick. = 골라 봐. pick out = 골라내다.

senses.meaningEn: to take a flower or fruit from a plant with your fingers

examples.en: We picked apples at a farm last weekend.
Don't pick the flowers in the park.

senses.note: pick strawberries/apples. 과일 따기 체험 = fruit picking.

senses.meaningEn: to lift something from a surface, or to go and get someone in a car

examples.en: Pick up your toys before dinner.
I'll pick you up at seven in front of the station.

senses.note: pick up 은 '집어 들다·치우다', '태우러 가다', '(전화를) 받다', '(물건을) 사 오다' 등 뜻이 많음. 내려 주다는 drop off.

senses.meaningEn: to lift something from a surface

examples.en: Please pick up your toys from the floor.
He picked up the phone and said hello.
examples.ko: 그는 전화기를 들고 여보세요 라고 했어.

senses.meaningEn: to go and get someone in a car

examples.en: Can you pick me up at the station?
examples.ko: 역에서 나 좀 태워 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: I pick up my kids from school at three.

senses.note: pick + 사람 + up 순서로도 씀: pick me up. 반대는 drop off(내려 주다).

senses.meaningEn: to buy or collect something, often casually

examples.en: Could you pick up some bread on your way?
examples.ko: 오는 길에 빵 좀 사 올 수 있어?

examples.en: I need to pick up my package at the post office.

senses.meaningEn: to learn something easily without much effort

examples.en: Kids pick up new words very quickly.
examples.ko: 아이들은 새 단어를 아주 빨리 익혀.

examples.en: I picked up some Spanish while traveling.

senses.meaningEn: a meal that you eat outside, such as in a park

examples.en: Let's have a picnic in the park this Saturday.
We packed sandwiches for the picnic.

senses.note: have a picnic / go on a picnic. 한국어 '소풍'이 학교 행사면 school trip / field trip 이 더 맞음. picnic 은 야외에서 먹는 식사가 핵심.

senses.meaningEn: a drawing or painting

examples.en: My daughter drew a picture of our dog.
There's a big picture on the living room wall.
examples.ko: 거실 벽에 큰 그림이 걸려 있어.

senses.note: draw a picture = 그림을 그리다(색칠하는 그림은 paint). 그림 '속의' = in the picture.

senses.meaningEn: a photograph

examples.en: Can you take a picture of us, please?
examples.ko: 저희 사진 한 장 찍어 주실래요?

examples.en: I took a lot of pictures on my trip.

senses.note: take a picture = 사진을 찍다(make ✗). photo 와 거의 같은 뜻으로 일상에서 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a baked dish with a pastry crust and a sweet or savory filling

examples.en: My mom makes the best apple pie.
Would you like a slice of pie?

senses.note: a slice of pie = 파이 한 조각. 단 것(apple pie)뿐 아니라 고기 파이(meat pie)도 있음. as easy as pie = 아주 쉬운.

senses.meaningEn: a part that is cut or broken from something bigger

examples.en: Would you like another piece of cake?
Cut the apple into small pieces.

senses.note: slice 는 얇게 '썬' 조각(피자·빵), piece 는 모양과 상관없는 조각 전체를 가리킨다. in pieces = 산산조각 난.

senses.meaningKo: (셀 수 없는 명사를 세는) 하나, 한 장
senses.meaningEn: one item of something you cannot count directly

examples.en: Can I have a piece of paper?
examples.ko: 종이 한 장 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: Let me give you a piece of advice.

senses.note: a piece of paper/furniture/advice/news/information 처럼 셀 수 없는 명사를 셀 때 쓴다. 한국인이 자주 틀리는 것: an advice (X) → a piece of advice (O). 발음은 peace(평화)와 같다.

senses.meaningKo: 아주 쉬운 일, 식은 죽 먹기
senses.meaningEn: something that is very easy to do

examples.en: The test was a piece of cake.
Don't worry, fixing this is a piece of cake.
examples.ko: 걱정 마, 이거 고치는 건 아주 쉬워.

senses.note: 항상 a piece of cake 로 씀. 실제 케이크 한 조각이라는 뜻과 구별은 문맥으로.

senses.meaningEn: a farm animal with a fat body, short legs, and a curly tail

examples.en: The pigs are rolling in the mud.
My uncle keeps pigs and chickens on his farm.

senses.note: 돼지고기는 pork, 새끼 돼지는 piglet. 돼지 소리는 oink.

senses.meaningEn: a person who eats too much or is dirty and messy

examples.en: Don't be a pig and share the pizza.
I ate like a pig at the party last night.

senses.note: eat like a pig = 게걸스럽게 먹다. 친구 사이에 장난으로는 쓰지만 남에게 쓰면 무례함.

senses.meaningEn: a small round piece of medicine that you swallow

examples.en: Take one pill with a glass of water.
examples.ko: 알약 하나를 물 한 잔과 함께 먹어요.

examples.en: These pills are too big for me to swallow.
examples.ko: 이 알약은 너무 커서 삼키기 힘들어.

senses.note: take a pill(알약을 먹다). sleeping pill(수면제), vitamin pill. 비슷한 말 tablet(정제), capsule(캡슐).

senses.meaningEn: a soft object that you rest your head on in bed

examples.en: This pillow is too soft for me.
Can I get an extra pillow, please?
examples.ko: 베개 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

senses.note: 베갯잇은 pillowcase. 소파의 장식 쿠션은 cushion 또는 throw pillow.

senses.meaningEn: a person who flies a plane

examples.en: The pilot said we will land in twenty minutes.
She trained for years to become a pilot.
examples.ko: 그녀는 조종사가 되려고 몇 년을 훈련했어.

senses.note: 기내 방송의 '기장'은 captain 이라고도 부름. 부조종사는 co-pilot.

senses.meaningEn: a large tropical fruit with a rough skin and sweet yellow flesh

examples.en: Do you like pineapple on pizza?
Fresh pineapple is hard to cut.

senses.note: 음식 재료로 말할 때는 셀 수 없는 명사처럼 pineapple 로 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a flat, round bread baked with tomato sauce, cheese, and other food on top

examples.en: Let's order a pizza tonight.
Can I have one more slice of pizza?
examples.ko: 피자 한 조각 더 먹어도 돼?

senses.note: 피자 한 판은 a pizza, 한 조각은 a slice of pizza. '피자 한 조각' 을 a piece 라고 해도 되지만 slice 가 더 자연스러움. 발음은 [핏자]에 가까움.

senses.meaningEn: an idea about what you are going to do

examples.en: Do you have any plans for the weekend?
Our plan is to leave at eight.

senses.note: '주말 계획 있어?'는 보통 복수 plans 로 물음. make a plan / change of plans(계획 변경).

senses.meaningEn: to decide in detail what you will do, or intend to do something

examples.en: We're planning a trip to Busan next month.
examples.ko: 다음 달에 부산 여행을 계획하고 있어.

examples.en: I plan to study English every morning.
examples.ko: 매일 아침 영어 공부를 할 예정이야.

senses.note: plan to + 동사. 과거형·진행형은 n 을 겹쳐 planned / planning.

senses.meaningEn: an airplane

examples.en: What time does your plane leave?
I slept on the plane the whole time.

senses.note: airplane 의 줄임말로, 구어에서는 plane 이 기본. 비행기를 타다 = get on/board a plane, 놓치다 = miss the plane. 발음이 같은 plain(평범한, 무늬 없는)과 혼동 주의.

senses.meaningEn: a living thing that grows in the ground and has leaves and roots

examples.en: I water my plants every morning.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 아침 화초에 물을 줘.

examples.en: This plant needs a lot of sun.

senses.note: 집 안의 화분 식물은 houseplant. 식물에 '물을 주다'는 water a plant.

senses.meaningEn: to put a seed or young plant in the ground so it grows

examples.en: We planted a tree in the garden.
When do you plant tomatoes?

senses.meaningEn: a factory or a building where power is made

examples.en: My uncle works at a car plant.
There is a power plant near the river.

senses.note: power plant = 발전소. '식물'과 전혀 다른 뜻이니 문맥으로 구별.

senses.meaningEn: a flat round dish that you eat food from

examples.en: Can you put the plates on the table?
Be careful, that plate is hot.

senses.meaningEn: the food on a plate

examples.en: I'd like a plate of pasta, please.
He finished his whole plate in five minutes.
examples.ko: 그는 한 접시를 5분 만에 다 먹었어.

senses.note: a plate of pasta / fries. 평평한 접시에 담는 음식. 깊은 그릇은 bowl.

senses.meaningEn: the raised area next to the train tracks where you wait for a train

examples.en: The train to Boston leaves from platform three.
Stand back from the edge of the platform.

senses.note: 미국에서는 track 3 처럼 track 으로 안내하는 경우도 많음. 영국은 platform 이 일반적.

senses.meaningEn: a website or app system that people use to share things or do business

examples.en: Which platform do you use to watch movies?
examples.ko: 영화 볼 때 어떤 플랫폼 써?

examples.en: This game works on every platform, even phones.
examples.ko: 이 게임은 휴대폰까지 모든 플랫폼에서 돌아가.

senses.note: social media platform(소셜 미디어 플랫폼) 처럼 쓰임. 한국어 '플랫폼'과 거의 같은 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: to take part in a game or sport, or to have fun

examples.en: The kids are playing in the yard.
Do you want to play soccer after school?

senses.note: play soccer / play games. 구기 종목은 play, 수영·달리기는 go swimming / go running.

senses.meaningEn: to make music with an instrument

examples.en: She plays the piano really well.
I'm learning to play the guitar.

senses.note: 악기 앞에는 the: play the piano. 운동 앞에는 the 없음: play tennis.

senses.meaningEn: to make a song or video start

examples.en: Can you play that song again?
Press here to play the video.

senses.meaningEn: a story performed by actors in a theater

examples.en: We saw a play at the theater last night.
My daughter is in the school play.

senses.meaningEn: a person who plays a sport or a game

examples.en: He's the best player on the team.
This game needs at least four players.
examples.ko: 이 게임은 최소 네 명이 필요해.

senses.note: soccer player, tennis player, basketball player. 한국어 '운동선수' 일반은 athlete. 게임 참가자도 player.

senses.meaningEn: a person who plays a musical instrument

examples.en: My sister is a great piano player.
examples.ko: 내 여동생은 피아노를 아주 잘 쳐.

examples.en: The guitar player in that band is amazing.

senses.note: piano player = pianist, guitar player = guitarist. 일상에서는 -player 가 더 쉽고 자연스러움. 재생 기기(music player, DVD player)도 player.

senses.meaningEn: an outdoor area where children can play

examples.en: The kids are on the playground.
We played tag in the school playground.

senses.note: on the playground(미) / in the playground(영). 미끄럼틀·그네가 있는 놀이터와 학교 운동장 둘 다 가리킴.

senses.meaningEn: a small bag sewn into clothes for keeping small things

examples.en: I put my keys in my pocket.
This jacket has four pockets.

senses.note: pocket money = 용돈(영국식). 가방 주머니도 pocket. 한국어 '포켓'처럼 발음하지 말고 /ˈpɑːkɪt/ 로.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of writing in short lines that uses rhythm, sounds, and feelings

examples.en: We read a poem about spring in class.
examples.ko: 수업 시간에 봄에 관한 시를 읽었어.

examples.en: She wrote a poem for her mother.

senses.note: poem = 시 한 편(셀 수 있음), poetry = 시 장르 전체(셀 수 없음), poet = 시인. write/read/recite a poem.

senses.meaningEn: a unit used to count the score in a game or sport

examples.en: We won the game by two points.
You get ten points for each correct answer.

senses.note: score a point(점수를 내다), lose points(점수를 잃다). 시험 점수는 보통 score 나 grade 를 쓰고, points 는 게임·퀴즈 느낌.

senses.meaningEn: the main idea or purpose of something

examples.en: What's your point? Just tell me.
There's no point in waiting any longer.

senses.note: Good point!(좋은 지적이야), That's the point.(바로 그거야), There's no point in -ing(~해도 소용없다). 회화에서 매우 자주 등장.

senses.meaningEn: to show where something is using your finger

examples.en: She pointed at the big red house.
Don't point at people, it's rude.
examples.ko: 사람을 손가락으로 가리키지 마, 예의 없어.

senses.note: point at/to + 대상. point out(지적하다, 알려주다)은 자주 쓰는 구동사: Thanks for pointing that out.

senses.meaningEn: the small dot in a decimal number, or the sharp end of something

examples.en: Three point five means 3.5.
The point of the pencil broke again.

senses.note: 소수점은 point 로 읽음(2.75 = two point seven five). 연필심 끝도 point, 뾰족하다는 pointed/sharp.

senses.meaningEn: a person whose job is to keep people safe and make sure they follow the law

examples.en: A police officer helped me find my way.
My aunt is a police officer in Seoul.

senses.note: policeman/policewoman 보다 성 중립적인 police officer 가 요즘 표준. the police(경찰 조직)는 복수 취급: The police are here.

senses.meaningEn: the office building where police officers work

examples.en: The police station is next to the bank.
I lost my wallet, so I went to the police station.

senses.note: police 는 항상 복수 취급(The police are coming). 경찰관 한 명은 a police officer. 긴급 전화는 미국 911.

senses.meaningEn: a small area of still water, smaller than a lake

examples.en: There are ducks in the pond.
My grandfather has a small fish pond.
examples.ko: 우리 할아버지는 작은 물고기 연못이 있어.

senses.note: lake 보다 훨씬 작은 물. 정원 연못 = garden pond, 물고기 연못 = fish pond.

senses.meaningEn: a large area of water made for people to swim in

examples.en: The kids are playing in the pool.
Our hotel has a pool on the roof.

senses.note: swimming pool 의 줄임말로 일상에서는 pool 만 많이 씀. 수영장에서 '수영하다'는 swim in the pool, 수영장 '가다'는 go to the pool.

senses.meaningEn: a small area of liquid on a surface

examples.en: There was a pool of water on the kitchen floor.
After the rain, little pools formed on the road.
examples.ko: 비가 온 뒤 길에 작은 물웅덩이들이 생겼어.

senses.note: a pool of water/blood 처럼 '~이 고인 것'. 빗물 웅덩이는 puddle 이 더 흔함. 당구(포켓볼)도 pool 이라고 함(play pool).

senses.meaningEn: the meat from a pig

examples.en: Does this soup have pork in it?
We're grilling pork belly tonight.

senses.note: 동물은 pig, 고기는 pork. 셀 수 없는 명사. pork belly(삼겹살), pork cutlet(돈가스), pork chop(뼈 있는 등심).

senses.meaningEn: to put a message, photo, or video on a website or social media

examples.en: She posted a photo of her cat.
Don't post anything personal online.

senses.note: SNS 에서 가장 많이 쓰는 동사. 명사 a post = 게시물.

senses.meaningEn: the system of sending letters and packages

examples.en: I'll send the gift by post.
Did any post come today?

senses.note: 영국식. 미국에서는 mail 을 씀(by mail). 우체국은 post office 로 양쪽 모두 통함.

senses.meaningEn: a place where you can send letters and packages and buy stamps

examples.en: Is there a post office near here?
I'm going to the post office to mail this box.

senses.note: 미국에서는 우편물을 mail, 영국에서는 post 라고 함. 우편번호는 미국 zip code, 영국 postcode. 우체통은 mailbox.

senses.meaningEn: a round vegetable with brown or yellow skin that grows underground

examples.en: We're having potatoes with dinner tonight.
examples.ko: 오늘 저녁엔 감자를 같이 먹을 거야.

examples.en: Can you peel the potatoes for me?

senses.note: 복수형은 potatoes. sweet potato = 고구마. couch potato = 소파에서 TV만 보는 사람.

senses.meaningEn: to make a liquid flow out of a container

examples.en: Can you pour me some water?
Pour the milk into the cup slowly.

senses.note: pour A into B(A를 B에 붓다). pour someone a drink = 술/음료를 따라 주다. 발음은 /pɔːr/, poor(가난한)와 같은 소리.

senses.meaningEn: to rain very heavily

examples.en: It's pouring outside. Take an umbrella.
It poured all day yesterday.

senses.note: It's pouring. = 비가 퍼붓는다. 구어로 It's pouring down. 도 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: to do something again and again so you get better at it

examples.en: I practice the piano for an hour a day.
examples.ko: 나는 하루에 한 시간씩 피아노를 연습해.

examples.en: Let's practice speaking English together.

senses.note: practice + 명사/동사-ing (practice to speak ✗ → practice speaking). 미국은 동사·명사 모두 practice, 영국은 동사 practise.

senses.meaningEn: time spent doing an activity in order to get better

examples.en: I have soccer practice after school.
Practice makes perfect!

senses.note: soccer practice / piano practice = 축구 연습 / 피아노 연습. out of practice = 오래 안 해서 녹슨.

senses.meaningEn: to speak to God or a god

examples.en: We pray before every meal.
She prayed for her sick grandmother.

senses.note: pray for + 사람/일. '~하기를 바란다'는 뜻으로 가볍게도 씀: I'm praying it doesn't rain. 명사는 prayer.

senses.meaningEn: to like one thing more than another

examples.en: I prefer tea to coffee in the morning.
Would you prefer a window seat?

senses.note: prefer A to B(than ✗). prefer to + 동사 / prefer -ing. 'I'd prefer ~' 는 정중한 희망 표현. 과거형은 r 을 겹침(preferred).

senses.meaningEn: something you give to someone on a special day

examples.en: I got a lot of presents for my birthday.
What should I buy her for a present?
examples.ko: 그녀에게 선물로 뭘 사 주면 좋을까?

senses.note: present 와 gift 는 거의 같음. gift 가 조금 더 격식적이고 gift card/gift shop 처럼 복합어에 많이 쓰임.

senses.meaningEn: in a particular place

examples.en: Everyone is present today. Great!
All the family members were present at dinner.

senses.note: 출석 부를 때 Present! 또는 Here! 로 대답. be present at + 행사.

senses.meaningEn: the time that is happening now

examples.en: Let's forget the past and live in the present.
At present, I'm living with my parents.

senses.note: at present = 현재는(약간 격식). 문법의 '현재 시제' = present tense. 동사 present(발표하다)는 강세가 뒤로 감 /prɪˈzent/.

senses.meaningEn: to behave as if something is true when it is not

examples.en: Don't pretend you didn't hear me.
examples.ko: 내 말 못 들은 척하지 마.

examples.en: He pretended to be sick to skip school.
examples.ko: 그는 학교 안 가려고 아픈 척했어.

senses.note: pretend to + 동사 / pretend (that) + 문장. 한국어 "~척하다"에 딱 맞는 동사.

senses.meaningEn: to imagine something as a game, especially as children do

examples.en: Let's pretend we're pirates on a ship.
The kids pretended the sofa was a boat.

senses.note: Let's pretend ... 은 아이들 역할놀이 시작 표현.

senses.meaningEn: pleasant to look at

examples.en: What a pretty dress you're wearing!
The flowers in the garden are so pretty.

senses.meaningEn: quite, fairly

examples.en: The test was pretty easy.
I'm pretty sure he's coming.

senses.note: pretty good = 꽤 좋다. 미국 구어에서 매우 자주 쓰임.

senses.meaningEn: the amount of money you have to pay for something

examples.en: What's the price of this watch?
Prices are going up every year.

senses.note: 가격을 물을 때는 How much is it? 이 더 자연스러움. 가격이 '높다/낮다'는 high/low price (expensive/cheap price 는 어색). 가격표 = price tag.

senses.meaningEn: the son of a king or queen

examples.en: The prince rode a white horse.
The little prince lives on a tiny planet.
examples.ko: 어린 왕자는 아주 작은 행성에 살아.

senses.note: 동화의 '왕자'. Prince William 처럼 이름 앞에서는 대문자. 여성형은 princess.

senses.meaningEn: the daughter of a king or queen

examples.en: The princess lived in a tall tower.
My daughter wants to be a princess for Halloween.
examples.ko: 우리 딸은 핼러윈에 공주 분장을 하고 싶어 해.

senses.note: a Disney princess(디즈니 공주). 어른에게 '공주처럼 군다'고 할 때도 쓰지만 비꼬는 느낌이 있으니 주의.

senses.meaningEn: the person in charge of a school

examples.en: The principal gave a speech this morning.
examples.ko: 오늘 아침 교장 선생님이 연설을 하셨어.

examples.en: You have to go to the principal's office.

senses.note: 영국식은 headteacher / headmaster. 철자 혼동: principle(원칙)과 다름 — 교장은 '사람(pal)'이 들어간 principal.

senses.meaningEn: to put words or pictures on paper using a printer

examples.en: Can you print this file for me?
examples.ko: 이 파일 좀 출력해 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: I printed out the map before the trip.

senses.note: print out = 출력하다(구어). 기계는 printer. '프린트해 주세요'의 한국식 '프린트' 그대로 통함.

senses.meaningEn: to write letters separately, not joined together

examples.en: Please print your name clearly here.
Print it in capital letters.

senses.note: 서식에 PRINT NAME 이라고 있으면 '정자로 쓰라'는 뜻이지 인쇄하라는 뜻이 아님. 흘려 쓰는 건 sign/signature.

senses.meaningEn: something you win in a competition or game

examples.en: First prize is a trip to Jeju!
She won a prize for her science project.

senses.note: win a prize(상을 타다), first/second prize(1등/2등 상), prize money(상금). 학교 상장은 award 나 certificate 가 더 자연스러움. price(가격)와 철자 혼동 주의.

senses.meaningEn: to tell someone that you will certainly do something

examples.en: I promise I'll call you tonight.
Dad promised to take us to the zoo.

senses.note: promise to + 동사 / promise (that) + 문장. '시간 약속'(appointment, plans)이 아니라 '꼭 하겠다는 다짐'. 'I promise.' 한 마디로 '진짜야'.

senses.meaningEn: a statement that you will certainly do something

examples.en: You made a promise, so keep it.
He always breaks his promises.

senses.note: make a promise(약속하다) / keep a promise(지키다) / break a promise(어기다). 친구와 만날 약속은 promise 가 아니라 plans.

senses.meaningEn: to keep someone or something safe from harm

examples.en: Wear a hat to protect your skin from the sun.
A mother bird protects her babies.

senses.note: protect A from B = B 로부터 A 를 보호하다. 명사 protection, 형용사 protective.

senses.meaningEn: to move something toward you or drag it behind you

examples.en: Pull the door to open it.
The kids pulled the sled up the hill.

senses.note: 문 표지 PULL(당기세요)/PUSH(미세요). pull over = 차를 길가에 세우다, pull up a chair = 의자를 끌어와 앉다.

senses.meaningEn: to remove something by pulling it out

examples.en: The dentist pulled my tooth today.
I spent an hour pulling weeds in the yard.
examples.ko: 마당에서 한 시간 동안 잡초를 뽑았어.

senses.note: pull a tooth / pull weeds / pull out a plug(플러그를 빼다). 근육을 다치다 = pull a muscle.

senses.meaningEn: a large round orange vegetable with a thick skin

examples.en: We made pumpkin soup for dinner.
Kids carve pumpkins on Halloween.

senses.note: 한국의 애호박은 zucchini(미국식) 또는 Korean zucchini 라고 함. pumpkin pie 는 미국 추수감사절 대표 음식.

senses.meaningEn: a child who is being taught at school

examples.en: The pupils lined up outside the classroom.
She was the best pupil in her piano class.

senses.note: 영국식에서 어린 학생을 가리킴. 미국식에서는 거의 student 를 씀. '눈동자(pupil)'와 같은 철자.

senses.meaningEn: a young dog

examples.en: We got a new puppy last weekend.
The puppies are only six weeks old.

senses.note: 줄여서 pup 이라고도 함. 복수형은 puppies(y→ies). 한국어 '강아지'는 다 큰 개에게도 쓰지만 영어 puppy 는 어린 개에게만 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a bag that a woman carries for her money, keys, and small things

examples.en: She put her phone in her purse.
Don't leave your purse on the chair.

senses.note: 미국: purse = 핸드백(handbag 과 같음). 영국: purse = 여성용 지갑, 핸드백은 handbag. 한국어 '지갑'을 미국인에게 말할 땐 wallet 이 안전함.

senses.meaningEn: to move something away from you using your hands or body

examples.en: Push the door, don't pull it.
He pushed me into the pool!
examples.ko: 그 애가 나를 수영장에 밀어 넣었어!

senses.note: push a cart = 카트를 밀다. 사람 많은 곳에서 Don't push! = 밀지 마세요.

senses.meaningEn: to press a button or switch

examples.en: Push the button to call the elevator.
Just push play and the music starts.

senses.note: press 와 같은 뜻으로 구어에서 자주 씀. 벨은 ring the bell.

senses.meaningEn: to try hard to make someone do something

examples.en: My parents pushed me to study harder.
Don't push him, he'll decide when he's ready.

senses.note: push 사람 to 동사. pushy = 너무 밀어붙이는(성격). push yourself = 스스로를 채찍질하다.

senses.meaningEn: to move something to a place or position

examples.en: Put the milk back in the fridge, please.
Where did you put my bag?

senses.note: put-put-put 변하지 않음, 진행형은 putting(t 두 개). 항상 '어디에'가 따라옴: put it here / on the table / in the box. 발음은 /pʊt/ — 'but' 과 다름.

senses.meaningEn: put on: to start wearing clothes or turn something on; put off: to delay something

examples.en: Put on your coat, it's cold outside.
Don't put off your homework until Sunday.

senses.note: put on(입다·켜다) ↔ take off(벗다·끄다). put off(미루다), put away(치우다), put down(내려놓다) 등 구동사가 아주 많음. 옷은 wear(입고 있는 상태)와 put on(입는 동작)을 구분.

senses.meaningEn: to write or type something in a place

examples.en: Put your name at the top of the page.
I put the wrong date on the form.

senses.note: put + 내용 + 위치 = ~에 적다. 회화에서 write 대신 자주 씀. '어떻게 표현할지'를 How can I put it? 라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: to place clothes or glasses on your body

examples.en: Put on your coat, it's cold outside.
Let me put my shoes on first.

senses.note: 입는 동작은 put on, 입고 있는 상태는 wear. I'm putting on a hat (동작) vs I'm wearing a hat (상태).

senses.meaningEn: to spread cream or makeup on your skin

examples.en: Don't forget to put on sunscreen.
She puts on makeup every morning.

senses.meaningEn: to gain weight

examples.en: I put on three kilos over the holidays.
He's putting on weight since he stopped running.
examples.ko: 그는 달리기를 그만둔 뒤로 살이 찌고 있어.

senses.note: put on weight = gain weight. 반대는 lose weight.

senses.meaningEn: a game with many small pieces that you fit together to make a picture

examples.en: This puzzle has one thousand pieces.
We finished the puzzle in two hours.
examples.ko: 우리는 두 시간 만에 퍼즐을 다 맞췄어.

senses.note: 조각 그림은 jigsaw puzzle, 낱말 퍼즐은 crossword (puzzle). do/finish a puzzle 로 씀.

senses.meaningEn: something that is hard to understand or explain

examples.en: Why she left early is a puzzle to me.
examples.ko: 그녀가 왜 일찍 갔는지 나한테는 수수께끼야.

examples.en: The missing keys are still a puzzle.

senses.note: 형용사 puzzled 는 '어리둥절한'(I'm puzzled.). 동사 puzzle 은 '어리둥절하게 하다'.

senses.meaningEn: one of four equal parts; fifteen minutes

examples.en: It's a quarter past nine.
I ate a quarter of the pizza.

senses.note: 시간 표현: a quarter past seven(7:15), a quarter to seven(6:45). 미국에서는 past 대신 after 도 많이 쓴다(a quarter after seven).

senses.meaningEn: a US coin worth twenty-five cents

examples.en: Do you have a quarter for the machine?
The gum costs two quarters.

senses.note: 미국 동전: penny(1¢), nickel(5¢), dime(10¢), quarter(25¢). 세탁소·자판기·주차 미터기에 자주 필요.

senses.meaningEn: a woman who rules a country, or the wife of a king

examples.en: The queen waved to the people from the balcony.
In the story, the queen has a magic mirror.
examples.ko: 이야기에서 여왕은 마법 거울을 갖고 있어.

senses.note: 스스로 다스리는 '여왕'과 왕의 아내 '왕비' 둘 다 queen. 이름 앞에서는 Queen Elizabeth 처럼 대문자.

senses.meaningEn: the most powerful piece in chess, or the card with the letter Q

examples.en: The queen can move in any direction.
examples.ko: 퀸은 어느 방향으로든 움직일 수 있어.

examples.en: I played the queen of hearts.

senses.note: 체스에서 가장 강한 말. 카드에서는 Q 로 표시, queen of hearts/spades 처럼 무늬와 함께 말함.

senses.meaningEn: a sentence that asks for information

examples.en: Can I ask you a question?
Raise your hand if you have a question.

senses.note: ask a question(질문하다) — question 자체를 동사로 쓰면 '의심하다·심문하다'. make a question ✗.

senses.meaningEn: a problem in a test that you must answer

examples.en: Question five was really hard.
Answer all the questions on this page.

senses.note: 시험 '문제'는 problem 보다 question 이 자연스러움(수학 계산 문제는 problem 도 씀).

senses.meaningEn: a short, simple test

examples.en: We have a short quiz every Monday.
I got nine out of ten on the quiz.

senses.note: 복수는 quizzes(z 두 개). pop quiz = 예고 없는 쪽지시험.

senses.meaningEn: a game where people answer questions for fun

examples.en: Let's do a quiz about animals!
My family loves TV quiz shows.
examples.ko: 우리 가족은 TV 퀴즈 쇼를 좋아해.

senses.note: quiz show = 퀴즈 프로그램. 한국어 '퀴즈'와 같은 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: a small animal with long ears and a short tail that jumps and lives in holes

examples.en: A rabbit is eating the carrots in our garden.
examples.ko: 토끼가 우리 텃밭에서 당근을 먹고 있어.

examples.en: My little sister wants a pet rabbit.
examples.ko: 내 여동생은 애완 토끼를 갖고 싶어 해.

senses.note: bunny 는 아이들 말투의 '토끼'. 새끼 토끼는 kit 또는 bunny. 토끼는 hop(깡충 뛰다).

senses.meaningEn: a competition to see who can run, drive, or swim the fastest

examples.en: She won the hundred-meter race.
The car race starts at noon.

senses.note: win/lose a race. 마라톤 등 '대회'는 race 또는 run. 경마는 horse race.

senses.meaningEn: to compete in a race, or to move very fast

examples.en: I'll race you to the car!
We raced to the bus stop in the rain.

senses.note: race + 사람 = ~와 경주하다. 아이들끼리 'Race you!' 는 '누가 먼저 가는지 내기!'.

senses.meaningEn: a group of people with the same skin color and physical features

examples.en: People of every race live in this city.
examples.ko: 이 도시에는 모든 인종의 사람들이 살아.

examples.en: We should treat everyone equally, whatever their race.
examples.ko: 인종이 무엇이든 모두를 평등하게 대해야 해.

senses.note: 민감한 주제이므로 조심해서 사용. 형용사 racial, 인종차별은 racism. 뉴스에서 자주 나옴.

senses.meaningEn: a machine or broadcast that you listen to for music, news, and talk

examples.en: I listen to the radio in the car.
Turn on the radio, I love this song.
examples.ko: 라디오 켜 봐, 이 노래 정말 좋아.

senses.note: listen to the radio 처럼 the 를 붙임 (TV 와 다름). on the radio = 라디오에서.

senses.meaningEn: water that falls from the clouds in drops

examples.en: We got a lot of rain last night.
Don't go out in the rain without a coat.
examples.ko: 비 오는데 코트 없이 나가지 마.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: a rain ✗ → heavy rain(폭우), light rain(가벼운 비). in the rain = 비를 맞으며. rain check = 다음 기회에 하자는 약속.

senses.meaningEn: to fall from the sky as rain

examples.en: It's raining, so take an umbrella.
Is it going to rain tomorrow?

senses.note: 주어는 항상 it: It rains / It's raining / It rained. 한국식으로 Rain is coming 보다 It's going to rain 이 자연스러움. It's raining cats and dogs. = 비가 억수같이 온다.

senses.meaningEn: a curve of different colors in the sky after rain

examples.en: Look, there's a rainbow over the river!
We saw a beautiful rainbow after the rain.
examples.ko: 비 온 뒤에 예쁜 무지개를 봤어.

senses.note: 무지개가 뜨다 = a rainbow appears/comes out. 무지개 색 = the colors of the rainbow. 미국에서는 무지개가 7색이 아니라 ROYGBIV 로 외움.

senses.meaningEn: having a lot of rain

examples.en: It's a rainy day, so bring your umbrella.
July is the rainy season in Korea.

senses.note: rainy day(비 오는 날)는 형용사, It's raining(지금 비가 온다)은 동사. the rainy season = 장마철. save for a rainy day = 어려울 때를 위해 저축하다.

senses.meaningEn: to lift something to a higher position

examples.en: Raise your hand if you know the answer.
He raised the cup and took a sip.
examples.ko: 그는 컵을 들어 한 모금 마셨어.

senses.note: raise 는 '무엇을' 올리는 타동사(raise your hand). rise 는 '스스로' 오르는 자동사(The sun rises). 한국인이 가장 많이 혼동하는 짝.

senses.meaningEn: to take care of children or animals until they are grown

examples.en: My grandparents raised me.
They raise chickens on their farm.

senses.note: 미국식에서 아이를 '키우다'는 raise, 영국식은 bring up 을 더 씀. born and raised in Seoul = 서울에서 나고 자란.

senses.meaningEn: an increase in the money you are paid for your job

examples.en: I got a raise last month!
She asked her boss for a raise.
examples.ko: 그녀는 사장님에게 월급을 올려 달라고 했어.

senses.note: get a raise = 월급이 오르다(미국식). 영국식은 pay rise. 가격 인상은 price increase.

senses.meaningEn: an animal like a large mouse with a long tail, often found in dirty places

examples.en: I saw a huge rat near the trash cans.
examples.ko: 쓰레기통 근처에서 엄청 큰 쥐를 봤어.

examples.en: Rats can carry diseases, so be careful.
examples.ko: 쥐는 병을 옮길 수 있으니 조심해.

senses.note: mouse(생쥐)보다 크고 더 지저분한 인상. 비격식으로 '배신자, 밀고자'를 rat 이라고도 함. 발음 주의: rat /ræt/ 과 rot /rɑːt/ 구별.

senses.meaningEn: to arrive at a place

examples.en: We reached the hotel at midnight.
Call me when you reach the station.

senses.note: reach 뒤에는 전치사 없이 바로 장소. reach to the hotel 은 틀림.

senses.meaningEn: to stretch out your arm to touch or take something

examples.en: I can't reach the top shelf.
examples.ko: 맨 위 선반에 손이 안 닿아.

examples.en: He reached for his glasses.

senses.note: reach for = ~을 잡으려고 손을 뻗다. out of reach = 손이 닿지 않는.

senses.meaningEn: to contact someone, usually by phone

examples.en: You can reach me on this number.
I couldn't reach her all day.
examples.ko: 하루 종일 그녀와 연락이 안 됐어.

senses.note: reach + 사람 = 연락이 닿다. 음성사서함의 You've reached... 도 이 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: to look at words and understand what they mean

examples.en: I read a book before bed every night.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 밤 자기 전에 책을 읽어.

examples.en: Can you read this word for me?

senses.note: 과거형도 read 로 쓰지만 발음은 /red/(빨간색 red 와 같음). I read it yesterday /red/.

senses.meaningEn: to say written words aloud for someone else

examples.en: Dad reads to me every night.
examples.ko: 아빠는 매일 밤 나한테 책을 읽어 주셔.

examples.en: Read the sign out loud, please.

senses.note: read to someone = ~에게 읽어 주다. read aloud / read out loud = 소리 내어 읽다.

senses.meaningEn: to understand signs, numbers, or a map

examples.en: I can't read a map at all.
The thermometer reads 38 degrees.

senses.note: read a map = 지도를 보다, read music = 악보를 읽다. 기계가 주어이면 '~라고 표시하다'.

senses.meaningEn: to understand or become aware of something you did not know before

examples.en: I just realized I left my keys at home.
examples.ko: 집에 열쇠를 두고 왔다는 걸 방금 알았어.

examples.en: She didn't realize how late it was.

senses.note: realize (that) + 문장. 영국식은 realise. 한국어 "알다"를 know 로만 옮기지 말고, "순간 깨닫다"면 realize.

senses.meaningEn: to make a dream or plan actually happen

examples.en: He finally realized his dream of opening a cafe.
examples.ko: 그는 드디어 카페를 여는 꿈을 이뤘어.

examples.en: She worked hard to realize her goal.
examples.ko: 그녀는 목표를 이루기 위해 열심히 노력했어.

senses.note: realize a dream/goal 은 조금 격식 있는 표현. 일상에서는 make a dream come true 가 더 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of paper that shows you have paid for something

examples.en: Would you like a receipt?
Keep the receipt in case you want to return it.
examples.ko: 반품할 수도 있으니 영수증 챙겨 둬.

senses.note: p 는 발음하지 않음 /rɪˈsiːt/. 환불·교환 시 꼭 필요. 영수증 '필요 없어요'는 No receipt, thanks.

senses.meaningEn: to get something that someone gives or sends to you

examples.en: Did you receive my message?
She received a lot of birthday gifts.

senses.note: get 보다 격식 있음. 구어에서는 get 을 훨씬 많이 씀. 철자 -ei- 주의(recieve X).

senses.meaningEn: to store sound or pictures so that you can hear or see them later

examples.en: Can you record the show for me tonight?
examples.ko: 오늘 밤 그 프로그램 녹화해 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: I recorded my voice on my phone.

senses.note: 동사일 때는 두 번째 음절에 강세 /rɪˈkɔːrd/. 명사 /ˈrekərd/ 와 발음이 다르니 주의.

senses.meaningEn: to write down information so that it is not forgotten

examples.en: Please record your answers on this sheet.
The nurse recorded my weight and height.

senses.meaningEn: the best result ever achieved in a sport or activity

examples.en: She broke the school record for the 100 meters.
He set a new world record last year.

senses.note: break a record(기록을 깨다), set a record(기록을 세우다) 로 외우기.

senses.meaningEn: a large machine that keeps food and drinks cold

examples.en: Put the milk back in the refrigerator.
We need a bigger refrigerator for our new kitchen.
examples.ko: 새 주방에는 더 큰 냉장고가 필요해.

senses.note: 일상 대화에서는 거의 fridge 를 씀. refrigerator 는 매장·설명서 등 약간 격식 있는 말. 냉동실은 freezer.

senses.meaningEn: to say that you will not do or accept something

examples.en: He refused to help me.
She refused the money politely.

senses.note: refuse to + 동사. 정중한 거절은 decline, 구어로는 turn down 을 많이 씀. 명사 refuse(/ˈrefjuːs/, 쓰레기)는 발음이 다름.

senses.meaningEn: to rest and feel calm, without worry or stress

examples.en: I just want to relax at home this weekend.
examples.ko: 이번 주말엔 그냥 집에서 쉬고 싶어.

examples.en: Relax, the test isn't until next week.

senses.note: relax 는 목적어 없이 씀(relax myself ✗). 명사 relaxation, 형용사 relaxed(편안한)/relaxing(편안하게 해 주는). 'Just relax.' = 긴장 풀어.

senses.meaningEn: to keep something in your mind or bring it back to your mind

examples.en: Do you remember my name?
I can't remember where I put my keys.
examples.ko: 열쇠를 어디 뒀는지 기억이 안 나.

senses.note: remember + 동사-ing = ~했던 것을 기억하다(I remember meeting him.). 한국어 '기억이 나다'는 I remember 로 충분(It remembers ✗).

senses.meaningEn: to not forget to do something

examples.en: Remember to lock the door.
Did you remember to bring your homework?
examples.ko: 숙제 챙겨 오는 거 잊지 않았지?

senses.note: remember to + 동사 = 앞으로 할 일을 잊지 않다. remember + 동사-ing 와 뜻이 다르니 주의.

senses.meaningEn: to fix something that is broken or damaged

examples.en: My dad repaired the broken chair.
How much will it cost to repair my phone?
examples.ko: 내 폰 수리하는 데 얼마나 들까요?

senses.note: 회화에서는 fix 가 더 흔하고, repair 는 조금 격식적. 수리점 = repair shop.

senses.meaningEn: the act of fixing something

examples.en: The road is closed for repairs this week.
examples.ko: 이번 주에는 도로가 보수 공사로 폐쇄돼.

examples.en: The car is in the shop for repair.

senses.note: under repair = 수리 중. be beyond repair = 고칠 수 없을 정도다.

senses.meaningEn: to say or do something again

examples.en: Repeat after me: 'Nice to meet you.'
Could you repeat that, please?

senses.note: Could you repeat that? 는 못 들었을 때 가장 예의 바른 표현. repeat again 은 중복이므로 그냥 repeat. 영어 수업의 Repeat after me = 따라 하세요.

senses.meaningEn: to tell someone what another person said

examples.en: Don't repeat this to anyone.
I'm only repeating what she told me.
examples.ko: 나는 그냥 그녀가 한 말을 전하는 것뿐이야.

senses.note: repeat something to someone. 재방송은 a repeat(영) / a rerun(미).

senses.meaningEn: to stop working and relax or sleep for a while

examples.en: You should rest at home for a few days.
Let's rest here for a minute.

senses.meaningEn: a period of relaxing or sleeping

examples.en: Get some rest, you look tired.
The doctor said I need plenty of rest.

senses.note: get some rest / take a rest. 짧게 쉬는 '휴식 시간'은 break 가 더 자연스럽다.

senses.meaningEn: the other people or things that are left

examples.en: I'll eat the rest of the pizza later.
You go first, and the rest of us will follow.

senses.note: the rest of + 명사. 항상 the 를 붙인다.

senses.meaningEn: a place where you can buy and eat a meal

examples.en: There's a new Italian restaurant near my house.
examples.ko: 우리 집 근처에 새 이탈리안 식당이 생겼어.

examples.en: Let's eat at a restaurant tonight.

senses.note: 철자 주의: restaurant(u 와 a 의 순서). 한국어 '레스토랑'보다 뜻이 넓어서 분식집·백반집도 모두 restaurant.

senses.meaningEn: to come or go back to a place

examples.en: When do you return from your trip?
She returned home at midnight.

senses.note: return to + 장소(return home 은 to 없음). 구어에서는 come back/go back/get back 이 훨씬 자연스럽고, return 은 약간 격식체. 'return back' 은 중복이라 틀림.

senses.meaningEn: to give something back to the place or person it came from

examples.en: I need to return these books to the library.
Can I return this shirt without a receipt?
examples.ko: 영수증 없이 이 셔츠 반품할 수 있어요?

senses.note: return + 물건 + to + 장소/사람. 쇼핑에서 환불은 refund, 교환은 exchange. 전화를 다시 걸다 = return a call.

senses.meaningEn: cooked rice grains eaten as a meal

examples.en: Would you like some more rice?
We eat rice with almost every meal.
examples.ko: 우리는 거의 매 끼니 밥을 먹어.

senses.note: 한국어는 '쌀'과 '밥'을 구분하지만 영어는 둘 다 rice. 익힌 밥을 강조하려면 cooked rice, steamed rice, a bowl of rice.

senses.meaningEn: the small white or brown grains that are cooked and eaten

examples.en: We need to buy a bag of rice.
Brown rice is healthier than white rice.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: rices (×). 단위로 셀 때는 a bag of rice, a cup of rice.

senses.meaningEn: to sit on a bicycle, motorcycle, or horse and control it as it moves

examples.en: I ride my bike to school.
Have you ever ridden a horse?

senses.note: 자전거·오토바이·말은 ride, 자동차는 drive. 과거 rode, 과거분사 ridden.

senses.meaningEn: to travel in a bus, train, or other vehicle as a passenger

examples.en: We rode the subway downtown.
I like riding the bus at night.

senses.note: 미국식에서 ride the bus/subway 는 매우 자연스러움. take the bus 도 같은 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: a trip in a vehicle, especially when someone takes you somewhere

examples.en: Can I get a ride home?
examples.ko: 집까지 좀 태워 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: Thanks for the ride!

senses.note: give someone a ride = 태워 주다, get a ride = 태워 받다. 영국식은 lift. 놀이기구도 ride(roller coaster ride).

senses.meaningEn: correct or true

examples.en: That's the right answer. Good job!
You're right, we should leave early.

senses.meaningEn: on the side of your body that is toward the east when you face north

examples.en: The bank is on your right.
I hurt my right hand yesterday.

senses.meaningEn: exactly or immediately

examples.en: Wait here. I'll be right back.
The store is right next to the station.
examples.ko: 그 가게는 역 바로 옆에 있어.

senses.note: right now = 지금 당장, right here = 바로 여기, right away = 즉시.

senses.meaningEn: to make the sound of a bell, or to press a doorbell

examples.en: The phone is ringing. Can you get it?
Someone rang the doorbell a minute ago.

senses.note: ring the doorbell = 초인종을 누르다. 영국에서는 ring = 전화하다(call)로도 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a small circle of metal worn on a finger

examples.en: She wears a gold ring on her left hand.
I lost my ring somewhere in the house.

senses.note: wedding ring = 결혼반지. 반지는 wear(끼다), 손가락에 put on.

senses.meaningEn: a large natural stream of water that flows to the sea

examples.en: The Han River runs through Seoul.
Let's have a picnic by the river.

senses.note: 강 이름은 the Han River 처럼 the + 이름 + River. 강가는 by the river / riverside.

senses.meaningEn: a long, hard surface that cars and buses travel on

examples.en: Be careful when you cross the road.
This road goes all the way to the beach.

senses.note: road 는 차가 다니는 도로 전반, street 은 건물이 늘어선 시내 거리. 주소에는 Rd.(Road), St.(Street) 로 줄여 씀. on the road = 이동 중/여행 중.

senses.meaningEn: a machine that can move and do work like a person

examples.en: A robot cleans the floor in our house.
Robots build cars in this factory.

senses.note: 미국식 발음은 '로우밧'에 가까움. robot vacuum(로봇 청소기). 장난감 로봇은 toy robot.

senses.meaningEn: a large piece of stone, or the hard material of the earth

examples.en: Be careful, the rocks are wet and slippery.
We sat on a big rock and had lunch.
examples.ko: 우리는 큰 바위에 앉아서 점심을 먹었어.

senses.note: 미국에서는 작은 돌도 흔히 rock 이라고 함(영국은 stone). 암석 재료는 불가산.

senses.meaningEn: a kind of loud popular music with guitars and drums

examples.en: My brother listens to rock all the time.
examples.ko: 우리 형은 항상 록 음악을 들어.

examples.en: They play in a rock band on weekends.

senses.note: rock music / rock band / rock star. 동사 rock 은 '흔들다'(rock the baby).

senses.meaningEn: a long vehicle that is shot into space

examples.en: The rocket went up into space.
My son wants to build a rocket someday.
examples.ko: 아들은 언젠가 로켓을 만들고 싶어 해.

senses.note: launch a rocket(로켓을 발사하다). 'It's not rocket science.' 는 '어려운 일 아니야'라는 뜻의 흔한 표현.

senses.meaningEn: to move by turning over and over, or to make something do this

examples.en: The ball rolled under the car.
Roll the dice and move your piece.

senses.note: roll the dice = 주사위를 굴리다. 눈을 굴리다(어이없음) = roll your eyes.

senses.meaningEn: to fold or wrap something into the shape of a tube or ball

examples.en: Roll up your sleeves before washing the dishes.
She rolled the paper into a tube.

senses.note: roll up = 말아 올리다, 걷다. 김밥을 만다 = roll kimbap.

senses.meaningEn: a small round piece of bread, or something wrapped into a tube shape

examples.en: I had a warm bread roll with my soup.
We need a new roll of toilet paper.

senses.note: a roll of paper/tape/toilet paper = 한 통(둥글게 감긴 단위). 식당의 roll 은 롤빵, 초밥의 roll 은 롤.

senses.meaningEn: the top part of a building or a car that covers it

examples.en: The roof is leaking when it rains.
There's a cat sitting on the roof.

senses.note: 안쪽에서 보는 '천장'은 ceiling, 바깥쪽 꼭대기는 roof. 복수형은 roofs(rooves 는 옛 형태). a roof over your head = 살 곳.

senses.meaningEn: a part of a building with its own walls, floor, and door

examples.en: Go to your room and clean it up.
This room is too small for a party.

senses.note: 호텔에서는 a single room / a double room. 방 번호는 room 302 처럼 말함.

senses.meaningEn: empty space that you can use

examples.en: Is there room for one more person?
examples.ko: 한 사람 더 탈 자리 있어?

examples.en: Make some room for the cake in the fridge.
examples.ko: 냉장고에 케이크 넣을 자리 좀 만들어.

senses.note: 이 뜻일 때는 불가산(a room ✗). room for ~ = ~할 공간/여지. There's room for improvement = 개선의 여지가 있다.

senses.meaningEn: a person you share a room, apartment, or house with

examples.en: My roommate is from Canada.
I'm looking for a new roommate.

senses.note: 미국에서는 같은 집에 살면 방이 달라도 roommate 라고 함. 영국은 flatmate.

senses.meaningEn: the part of a plant that grows under the ground

examples.en: The roots of this tree are very long.
Carrots are roots that we can eat.
examples.ko: 당근은 우리가 먹을 수 있는 뿌리야.

senses.meaningEn: where a person or their family comes from

examples.en: My roots are in a small town in Busan.
She went back to Korea to find her roots.
examples.ko: 그녀는 뿌리를 찾기 위해 한국에 돌아갔어.

senses.note: 이 뜻은 보통 복수 roots 로 씀. the root of the problem = 문제의 근본 원인.

senses.meaningEn: a flower with a sweet smell and sharp points on its stem

examples.en: He gave me a red rose on my birthday.
examples.ko: 그가 내 생일에 빨간 장미 한 송이를 줬어.

examples.en: The roses in the garden smell wonderful.

senses.note: 장미 꽃다발 = a bunch of roses. 장미 가시 = thorn. 참고: rose 는 동사 rise(오르다)의 과거형이기도 함(The sun rose at six).

senses.meaningEn: a statement about what you must or must not do

examples.en: The first rule is: no phones in class.
examples.ko: 첫 번째 규칙은 수업 중에 휴대폰 금지야.

examples.en: You have to follow the rules of the game.

senses.note: follow/break a rule = 규칙을 지키다/어기다. against the rules = 규칙 위반. as a rule = 보통, 대개.

senses.meaningEn: to have power over a country or people and control them

examples.en: The king ruled the country for forty years.
Who rules this island?

senses.note: ruler 는 '통치자'와 '(길이 재는) 자' 두 뜻이 있음.

senses.meaningEn: a long flat tool with marks on it, used for measuring or drawing straight lines

examples.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
My ruler is thirty centimeters long.

senses.note: '지배자(통치자)'라는 뜻도 있지만 학교에서는 자. 미국은 inch 자가 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: to move quickly using your legs, faster than walking

examples.en: I run in the park every morning.
We ran to catch the bus.

senses.note: 과거 ran, 현재분사 running(n 두 개). go running = 조깅하러 가다. 급하게 뛰는 건 rush 도 가능.

senses.meaningEn: if a bus or train runs, it travels on its route at regular times

examples.en: Buses run every ten minutes.
The last train runs at midnight.

senses.note: 교통수단의 운행 간격·시간을 말할 때 run 을 씀. 'The trains aren't running today.' = 오늘 기차 안 다녀.

senses.meaningEn: to be in charge of a shop, business, or organization

examples.en: My aunt runs a small restaurant.
Who runs this place?

senses.note: run a business/shop/company. '가게를 하다' 를 do a shop 으로 쓰면 틀림, run 을 쓸 것.

senses.meaningEn: if a machine or program runs, it is working

examples.en: The washing machine is still running.
Don't leave the engine running.
examples.ko: 엔진 켜 둔 채로 두지 마.

senses.note: run on batteries(배터리로 작동하다). 'run out of'(다 써 버리다)는 또 다른 구동사이니 구분.

senses.meaningEn: to travel on water in a boat or ship

examples.en: We sailed across the lake on Sunday.
The ship sails at six tomorrow.

senses.note: 요트처럼 바람으로 가는 것뿐 아니라 큰 여객선 출발도 sail. go sailing = 요트 타러 가다. 발음이 같은 sale(세일)과 혼동 주의.

senses.meaningEn: a large piece of cloth on a boat that catches the wind

examples.en: The boat has a big white sail.
examples.ko: 그 배에는 큰 흰 돛이 있어.

examples.en: The wind filled the sails.

senses.note: sailboat = 돛단배/요트. sailor = 선원, 뱃사람.

senses.meaningEn: a cold dish of raw vegetables, often with a sauce on top

examples.en: I'll just have a salad for lunch.
Would you like soup or salad with your meal?
examples.ko: 식사에 수프와 샐러드 중 어느 걸 드릴까요?

senses.note: 샐러드에 뿌리는 소스는 dressing 이라고 함. 식당에서는 흔히 soup or salad? 라고 물음. 발음은 [샐러드]보다 [쌜러드]에 가까움.

senses.meaningEn: a time when a store sells things at lower prices than usual

examples.en: The shoes were on sale, so I got two pairs.
examples.ko: 신발이 세일 중이어서 두 켤레 샀어.

examples.en: There's a big sale at the mall this weekend.
examples.ko: 이번 주말에 쇼핑몰에서 큰 세일을 해.

senses.note: on sale = 세일 중(미국식). for sale = 판매 중(팔려고 내놓은). 두 표현 혼동 주의. clearance sale = 재고 정리 세일.

senses.meaningEn: the act of selling something, or the amount sold

examples.en: The sale of the house took three months.
examples.ko: 집을 파는 데 석 달이 걸렸어.

examples.en: Sales were good this month.

senses.note: 복수 sales 는 '매출' 또는 '영업(부서)'. sales clerk = 판매 직원.

senses.meaningEn: a white substance that you add to food to make it taste better

examples.en: Could you pass the salt, please?
This soup needs a little more salt.
examples.ko: 이 국은 소금이 조금 더 필요해.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: a pinch of salt(소금 한 꼬집). salt and pepper 는 항상 이 순서로 말함. 형용사는 salty(짠).

senses.meaningEn: to add salt to food

examples.en: Salt the water before you add the pasta.
examples.ko: 파스타 넣기 전에 물에 소금을 넣어.

examples.en: Don't forget to salt the meat.
examples.ko: 고기에 소금 치는 거 잊지 마.

senses.note: season(양념하다)보다 소금만 넣는 동작을 구체적으로 말할 때 씀.

senses.meaningEn: tasting of salt or containing a lot of salt

examples.en: The soup is a bit too salty.
I love salty snacks like chips.
examples.ko: 나는 감자칩 같은 짠 간식을 좋아해.

senses.note: salt(소금) + y. 음식이 '싱겁다'는 bland 또는 It needs more salt.

senses.meaningEn: very small pieces of rock found on beaches and in deserts

examples.en: The sand is too hot to walk on.
examples.ko: 모래가 너무 뜨거워서 걸을 수 없어.

examples.en: We built a castle out of sand.

senses.note: 불가산명사(a sand ✗). 모래성 = sandcastle, 모래사장 = sandy beach, 모래밭 놀이터 = sandbox.

senses.meaningEn: light open shoes held on the foot by straps, worn in warm weather

examples.en: I wear sandals in the summer.
She lost a sandal at the beach.
examples.ko: 그녀는 해변에서 샌들 한 짝을 잃어버렸어.

senses.note: a pair of sandals. 발가락 사이에 끼우는 슬리퍼형은 flip-flops. 한국어 '슬리퍼'는 집에서 신는 slippers 와 구별.

senses.meaningEn: two pieces of bread with food such as meat or cheese between them

examples.en: I made a ham and cheese sandwich for lunch.
Do you want half of my sandwich?

senses.note: 발음은 [샌드위치]보다 [쌘위치]에 가깝게, d 는 거의 들리지 않음. 복수형은 sandwiches.

senses.meaningEn: the day of the week after Friday and before Sunday

examples.en: Are you free this Saturday?
I sleep late on Saturdays.

senses.note: this/next/last Saturday 앞에는 on 을 쓰지 않는다. on Saturdays = 토요일마다(습관). 철자에 주의: Sat-ur-day.

senses.meaningEn: a thick liquid that you put on food to give it more flavor

examples.en: Can I get some extra sauce on the side?
examples.ko: 소스 좀 따로 더 주실 수 있어요?

examples.en: This tomato sauce is a little too sweet.
examples.ko: 이 토마토 소스는 조금 너무 달아.

senses.note: 보통 셀 수 없음. soy sauce(간장), hot sauce(매운 소스), on the side(따로 담아서). 한국어 '소스'와 달리 영어에서는 ketchup, mayo 는 보통 sauce 라고 부르지 않고 condiment 라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: to keep money instead of spending it, or to spend less of it

examples.en: I'm saving money for a trip to Japan.
examples.ko: 일본 여행 가려고 돈을 모으고 있어.

examples.en: You can save ten dollars with this coupon.

senses.note: save (up) for + 목표. save money/time/energy = 돈·시간·에너지를 아끼다. 은행 저축 계좌는 savings account.

senses.meaningEn: to stop someone or something from being hurt or lost

examples.en: The doctor saved her life.
Wear a seatbelt. It could save your life.
examples.ko: 안전벨트 매. 목숨을 구할 수도 있어.

senses.note: save a life(생명을 구하다), save the planet(지구를 지키다).

senses.meaningEn: to keep something so you can use it later

examples.en: Save me a seat, please.
Don't forget to save the file before you leave.
examples.ko: 가기 전에 파일 저장하는 거 잊지 마.

senses.note: save some for later(나중을 위해 남겨 두다), save a seat(자리를 맡다). 컴퓨터의 '저장'도 save.

senses.meaningEn: to speak words

examples.en: What did you say? I didn't hear you.
She said she was tired.

senses.note: say + 말한 내용(say hello, say sorry). 듣는 사람을 붙일 때는 say to me(say me ✗). tell 은 사람이 목적어: tell me.

senses.meaningEn: to give information in writing

examples.en: The sign says 'No Parking'.
What does the text message say?

senses.note: 책·시계·표지판이 주어일 때 '~라고 되어 있다'. My watch says 3:00. = 내 시계는 3시를 가리켜.

senses.meaningEn: used to suggest an example or possibility

examples.en: Let's meet at, say, six o'clock.
Say you win the lottery. What would you buy?
examples.ko: 네가 복권에 당첨됐다고 쳐. 뭘 살 거야?

senses.note: 구어에서 '예컨대, ~라고 하자'. Let's say... 로도 자주 씀. 발음: says /sez/, said /sed/ (세이즈 ✗).

senses.meaningEn: to make someone feel afraid

examples.en: You scared me! I didn't hear you come in.
examples.ko: 깜짝 놀랐잖아! 들어오는 소리를 못 들었어.

examples.en: Big dogs scare my little brother.

senses.note: '내가 무섭다'는 I'm scared (of ~) — I scare ✗. scary = 무서운(영화·이야기), scared = 무서워하는(사람). scare away/off = 쫓아내다.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of cloth worn around the neck or head to keep warm or look nice

examples.en: She wrapped a scarf around her neck.
I bought two scarves for my sisters.
examples.ko: 언니들한테 줄 스카프를 두 개 샀어.

senses.note: 복수형은 scarves(scarfs 도 쓰이지만 덜 흔함). 한국어 '머플러'는 영어에서 자동차 배기관(muffler)이라 통하지 않음 — 목도리는 scarf.

senses.meaningEn: a plan that shows when things will happen

examples.en: What's your schedule like this week?
The bus schedule changed yesterday.

senses.note: 미국식 발음은 '스케줄', 영국식은 '셰줄'(/ˈʃedjuːl/). on schedule = 예정대로, behind schedule = 예정보다 늦게. 학교 시간표는 미국에서 class schedule.

senses.meaningEn: to plan for something to happen at a certain time

examples.en: I scheduled a dentist appointment for Monday.
The meeting is scheduled for 3 p.m.

senses.note: be scheduled for + 시간/날짜. reschedule = 일정을 다시 잡다.

senses.meaningEn: a place where children go to learn

examples.en: I walk to school every morning.
My school has a big playground.

senses.note: go to school(학생으로 다니다)은 관사 없이. 건물 자체를 말할 때는 the school.

senses.meaningEn: the time during the day when lessons take place

examples.en: What time does school finish today?
Let's play soccer after school.

senses.note: after school = 방과 후. school is out = 방학이다/수업이 끝났다.

senses.meaningEn: the outdoor area around a school where students play

examples.en: The students lined up in the schoolyard.
We used to play soccer in the schoolyard.
examples.ko: 우리는 학교 운동장에서 축구를 하곤 했어.

senses.note: 주로 미국식. 학교 건물 주변의 야외 공간 전체를 가리키며, playground 는 놀이 기구가 있는 곳에 더 가까움.

senses.meaningEn: the study of nature and the world, done by testing and watching

examples.en: We did a fun experiment in science class.
My sister wants to be a science teacher.
examples.ko: 우리 누나는 과학 선생님이 되고 싶어 해.

senses.note: science class(과학 수업), science fair(과학 전시회). 과학자는 scientist, 형용사는 scientific.

senses.meaningEn: a person who studies science or works in a science lab

examples.en: Scientists found water on Mars.
I want to be a scientist when I grow up.

senses.note: science(과학) + -ist. 전공별로 chemist(화학자), physicist(물리학자), biologist(생물학자).

senses.meaningEn: a tool with two blades, used for cutting paper or cloth

examples.en: Where are the scissors?
Cut along the line with your scissors.

senses.note: 항상 복수형(scissors are...). 한 개는 a scissor ✗ → a pair of scissors.

senses.meaningEn: the number of points someone gets in a test or game

examples.en: My test score was 85 out of 100.
What was the final score of the game?

senses.note: a high/low score. 시험 점수는 score, 등급은 grade. 경기 스코어는 2 to 1 처럼 말함.

senses.meaningEn: to get a point or goal in a game

examples.en: He scored two goals in the second half.
Who scored first in the game?

senses.note: score a goal(골을 넣다), score a point(점수를 내다). 시험에서 '90점 받다'도 score 90.

senses.meaningEn: the salt water that covers most of the earth

examples.en: I love swimming in the sea.
examples.ko: 나는 바다에서 수영하는 게 정말 좋아.

examples.en: Our hotel room has a view of the sea.

senses.note: 보통 the sea. 바닷가로 놀러 간다는 go to the beach 가 더 자연스러움(go to the sea 는 어색). 해산물 = seafood, 바다 쪽 = by the sea.

senses.meaningEn: to look carefully in a place or on the internet to find something

examples.en: I searched the whole house for my phone.
Just search for the recipe online.

senses.note: search + 장소(뒤지는 곳) for + 찾는 것: search the bag for keys. search for = 찾다. 인터넷 검색은 search for / google it. 명사 search(검색) — do a search.

senses.meaningEn: one of the four parts of the year: spring, summer, fall, and winter

examples.en: Which season do you like best?
Korea has four clear seasons.

senses.note: the four seasons = 사계절. the rainy season = 장마(철).

senses.meaningEn: the time of year when a sport or activity happens, or one set of TV episodes

examples.en: The baseball season starts in April.
I watched all three seasons in one week.
examples.ko: 나는 세 시즌을 일주일 만에 다 봤어.

senses.note: 한국어 '시즌'과 거의 같게 쓰인다. in season = 제철인(과일·채소), out of season = 제철이 아닌/비수기의.

senses.meaningEn: a place where you can sit, for example on a bus, train, or plane

examples.en: Is this seat taken?
I'd like a window seat, please.

senses.note: window seat(창가), aisle seat(통로), back seat(뒷자리). 'Take a seat.' / 'Have a seat.' 는 '앉으세요'. seat belt = 안전벨트.

senses.meaningEn: a strap in a car or plane that holds you in your seat

examples.en: Put on your seat belt before we go.
Please keep your seat belt on during the flight.
examples.ko: 비행 중에는 안전벨트를 계속 매고 계세요.

senses.note: '매다'는 fasten/put on/buckle up, '풀다'는 take off/unbuckle. seatbelt 로 붙여 쓰기도 함. 한국어 '안전벨트'를 safety belt 로 옮기면 어색함.

senses.meaningEn: one of the sixty parts of a minute

examples.en: He ran 100 meters in eleven seconds.
Hold the button for three seconds.

senses.note: 구어에서 '잠깐'이라는 뜻으로도 많이 씀: Just a second. / Give me a sec.

senses.meaningEn: coming after the first one

examples.en: Our office is on the second floor.
This is my second cup of coffee today.

senses.note: 서수: first, second, third. 미국에서 second floor 는 한국의 2층과 같지만, 영국에서는 3층(ground floor 가 1층). second hand = 중고의(secondhand).

senses.meaningEn: in the position after the first

examples.en: She came second in the race.
First, mix the eggs. Second, add the flour.
examples.ko: 먼저 달걀을 섞고, 두 번째로 밀가루를 넣어.

senses.note: 순서를 설명할 때 First, … Second, … Finally, … 로 이어 말한다. come/finish second = 2위를 하다.

senses.meaningEn: to notice someone or something with your eyes

examples.en: I saw a rainbow on my way home.
Can you see the bird in that tree?

senses.note: see 는 '눈에 들어오다'(의도 없음), look at 은 '시선을 돌려 보다', watch 는 '움직이는 걸 지켜보다'. 영화는 see a movie 도, watch a movie 도 가능.

senses.meaningEn: to understand something

examples.en: Oh, I see. That makes sense.
Do you see what I mean?

senses.note: I see. = 알겠어/그렇구나. 상대 말을 들었다는 반응으로 매우 자주 씀. 진행형(I'm seeing)으로는 안 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to meet or visit someone

examples.en: See you tomorrow at school!
You should see a doctor about that cough.

senses.note: See you (later/soon/tomorrow) 는 기본 작별 인사. see a doctor(진찰받다). be seeing someone 은 '~와 사귀는 중'이라는 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: the small hard part of a plant from which a new plant grows

examples.en: Put the seeds in the soil and water them.
These apple seeds are very small.

senses.note: 수박·사과처럼 작은 씨는 seed, 복숭아처럼 큰 씨는 pit/stone. sunflower seeds = 해바라기씨(간식).

senses.meaningEn: to give the impression of being a certain way

examples.en: You seem a little sad today.
It seems like everyone is busy this week.
examples.ko: 이번 주에는 다들 바쁜 것 같아.

senses.note: seem + 형용사 / seem to 동사 / It seems (like/that) + 절. 단정하지 않고 부드럽게 말할 때 유용. 눈으로 본 인상은 look, 들은 인상은 sound.

senses.meaningEn: to give something to someone in exchange for money

examples.en: I sold my old bike for fifty dollars.
Does this store sell phone chargers?

senses.note: sell A to B = B에게 A를 팔다. sell for + 가격. 과거형 sold 는 '매진'에도 씀: sold out. '잘 팔린다'는 It sells well.

senses.meaningEn: one of the two halves of a school or college year

examples.en: The new semester starts in March.
I'm taking five classes this semester.

senses.note: semester = 1년 2학기제의 '학기'. 미국은 보통 fall semester(가을 학기)와 spring semester(봄 학기). 영국식 term 은 3학기제. 방학은 break/vacation.

senses.meaningEn: to make a message, letter, or package go to another person or place

examples.en: I sent you a text this morning.
Can you send me the photos from the trip?

senses.note: send 사람 물건 = send 물건 to 사람. 이메일은 send an email, 소포는 send a package. 받다는 receive/get.

senses.meaningEn: to make a person go somewhere

examples.en: They sent their son to a school in Canada.
examples.ko: 그들은 아들을 캐나다에 있는 학교로 보냈어.

examples.en: The teacher sent him to the principal's office.

senses.note: send sb to + 장소. send sb home = 집으로 보내다.

senses.meaningEn: a group of words that expresses a complete idea, ending with a period

examples.en: Make a sentence with the word 'happy'.
Read the first sentence out loud.
examples.ko: 첫 문장을 소리 내서 읽어 봐.

senses.note: a sentence 는 대문자로 시작하고 마침표로 끝남. '문장'은 sentence, '글/본문'은 text, '글 한 단락'은 paragraph.

senses.meaningEn: a punishment given by a judge in court

examples.en: He got a two-year prison sentence.
The judge gave her a light sentence.

senses.note: 뉴스에서 자주 들리는 뜻. life sentence = 종신형, death sentence = 사형. 동사로도 쓰임(be sentenced to 3 years).

senses.meaningEn: the ninth month of the year

examples.en: The weather gets cooler in September.
Chuseok is in September this year.

senses.note: 미국·영국은 보통 9월에 새 학년이 시작된다. 줄임말 Sept. 또는 Sep. 가운데 음절에 강세.

senses.meaningEn: to give food or drink to someone, especially in a restaurant

examples.en: They serve breakfast until ten.
Dinner is served! Come to the table.

senses.note: serve + 음식 / serve + 사람 모두 가능. 'This recipe serves four' = 4인분.

senses.meaningEn: to help a customer in a shop

examples.en: Are you being served, sir?
She serves customers at the bakery.

senses.note: 영국식 가게 표현. 미국에서는 Are you being helped? 가 더 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: to hit the ball to start play in tennis or volleyball

examples.en: It's your turn to serve.
He served the ball really hard.

senses.note: 명사도 serve(서브). 한국어 '서비스'는 영어로 free / on the house.

senses.meaningEn: the number 7

examples.en: There are seven days in a week.
Dinner is at seven, so don't be late.

senses.note: 서수는 seventh(7th). seventeen(17), seventy(70). 서양에서 7은 행운의 숫자(lucky seven). 편의점 이름 7-Eleven 도 seven.

senses.meaningEn: the number 17

examples.en: My cousin is seventeen and in high school.
Our flight leaves from gate seventeen.

senses.note: sevenTEEN(17) vs SEVenty(70). 서수는 seventeenth(17th).

senses.meaningEn: the number 70

examples.en: My grandmother is seventy, but she still works.
The speed limit here is seventy.

senses.note: SEVenty(70) vs sevenTEEN(17). 미국 고속도로 제한 속도는 보통 마일 단위로 65~70. the seventies = 1970년대.

senses.meaningEn: the dark shape made when something blocks the light

examples.en: My shadow is very long in the evening.
The cat was scared of its own shadow.

senses.note: shadow 는 물체 모양의 '그림자', shade 는 그늘(시원한 곳). sit in the shade = 그늘에 앉다.

senses.meaningEn: to move quickly up and down or from side to side

examples.en: Shake the bottle well before you open it.
The whole house shook during the earthquake.

senses.note: milkshake 의 shake. 자동사·타동사 모두 가능.

senses.meaningEn: to hold someone's hand and move it up and down as a greeting

examples.en: We shook hands and introduced ourselves.
He shook my hand firmly.
examples.ko: 그는 내 손을 꽉 잡고 악수했어.

senses.note: shake hands with 사람 / shake sb's hand. hands 는 항상 복수.

senses.meaningEn: to move your head from side to side to mean no

examples.en: She shook her head and said no.
Dad just shook his head at my joke.

senses.note: 고개를 끄덕이는 건 nod. shake your head = 부정·실망.

senses.meaningEn: to tremble because you are cold, afraid, or nervous

examples.en: I was shaking with cold at the bus stop.
Her voice shook when she started to speak.
examples.ko: 말을 시작할 때 그녀의 목소리가 떨렸어.

senses.note: be shaking with cold/fear. 추워서 떠는 건 shiver 도 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to have or use something together with other people

examples.en: Let's share this pizza; it's too big.
examples.ko: 이 피자 너무 커서 같이 나눠 먹자.

examples.en: I share a room with my sister.

senses.note: share A with B. 식당에서 'Do you want to share?' = 나눠 먹을래? 한국어 '쉐어하다'와 같은 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: to tell others about something or post it so they can see it

examples.en: She shared the photos in our group chat.
Thank you for sharing your story with us.

senses.note: SNS 의 '공유'도 share. share your thoughts = 생각을 말해 주다.

senses.meaningEn: a large sea fish with sharp teeth that can be dangerous

examples.en: Are there sharks in this water?
The shark swam right under our boat.
examples.ko: 상어가 우리 배 바로 밑으로 지나갔어.

senses.note: shark fin(상어 지느러미), shark attack(상어 공격). 비격식으로 '남을 속여 돈을 뜯는 사람'(loan shark = 고리대금업자)을 뜻하기도 함. 발음 주의: shark /ʃɑːrk/ 와 shock /ʃɑːk/.

senses.meaningEn: a farm animal with a thick woolly coat, kept for its wool and meat

examples.en: There are hundreds of sheep on that hill.
examples.ko: 저 언덕에 양이 수백 마리 있어.

examples.en: I can't sleep, so I'm counting sheep.
examples.ko: 잠이 안 와서 양을 세고 있어.

senses.note: 단수·복수 모두 sheep(sheeps 는 틀림). 새끼 양은 lamb, 양고기도 lamb, 양털은 wool. count sheep = 잠들려고 양을 세다.

senses.meaningEn: a flat board on a wall or in a cupboard where you put things

examples.en: Put the books back on the shelf, please.
examples.ko: 책들을 다시 선반에 올려 놔 줘.

examples.en: The cups are on the top shelf.

senses.note: 복수형 shelves. 책장 전체는 bookshelf / bookcase. 가게 진열대도 shelf: on the shelves = 진열 중.

senses.meaningEn: to give out or reflect bright light

examples.en: The sun is shining, so let's go outside.
The stars shone brightly over the lake.

senses.note: 과거형 shone(/ʃoʊn/). 날씨 표현 The sun is shining. 명사 sunshine(햇빛).

senses.meaningEn: to point a light at something, or to polish something until it is bright

examples.en: Shine the flashlight over here, please.
He shined his shoes before the interview.
examples.ko: 그는 면접 전에 신발을 닦아 광을 냈어.

senses.note: "닦아서 빛내다" 뜻일 때는 과거형이 shined. shiny = 반짝이는(형용사).

senses.meaningEn: a large boat that carries people or goods across the sea

examples.en: The ship leaves the port at nine.
My grandfather worked on a big ship.

senses.note: 바다를 건너는 큰 배. cruise ship(크루즈), cargo ship(화물선). 작은 배는 boat.

senses.meaningEn: to send goods to a customer or another place

examples.en: Your order will ship tomorrow.
They shipped the package to my office.
examples.ko: 그 사람들이 소포를 내 사무실로 보냈어.

senses.note: 배가 아니라 트럭·비행기로 보내도 ship 이라고 함. 온라인 쇼핑에서 shipping = 배송(비), free shipping = 무료 배송.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of clothing with sleeves and buttons worn on the top half of the body

examples.en: He wore a white shirt and a blue tie.
examples.ko: 그는 흰 셔츠에 파란 넥타이를 했어.

examples.en: This shirt is too big for me.

senses.note: 한국어 '와이셔츠'는 dress shirt. 단추 없는 상의는 top 이라고 두루 부름.

senses.meaningEn: things you wear on your feet, usually made of leather or cloth

examples.en: Please take off your shoes at the door.
I need new shoes for school.
examples.ko: 학교 갈 때 신을 새 신발이 필요해.

senses.note: 보통 복수형, a pair of shoes. 신다/벗다 = put on / take off. 신발 가게는 shoe store(단수형으로 수식).

senses.meaningEn: a small building or room where you can buy things

examples.en: There's a little coffee shop on the corner.
The shop closes at nine tonight.

senses.note: 영국에서는 shop, 미국에서는 store 를 더 많이 씀. 미국에서 shop 은 coffee shop, gift shop 처럼 작은 전문점에 주로 붙음.

senses.meaningEn: to go to shops and buy things

examples.en: I usually shop for food on Saturdays.
We went shopping at the mall yesterday.

senses.note: '쇼핑하러 가다'는 go shopping. shop for + 물건(식료품 등을 사다). 온라인은 shop online.

senses.meaningEn: a list of the things you need to buy at a store

examples.en: Did you bring the shopping list?
Add milk and eggs to the shopping list.

senses.note: 식료품만 살 때는 grocery list 라고도 함. '쇼핑 목록에 올리다'는 put/add ~ on the list.

senses.meaningEn: having less than average height

examples.en: I'm a little short, so I can't reach the top shelf.
examples.ko: 내가 키가 좀 작아서 맨 위 칸에 손이 안 닿아.

examples.en: My sister is shorter than me.

senses.note: 키가 작다는 short, small 이 아니다. small 은 몸집이 작다는 뜻에 가깝다.

senses.meaningEn: small in length or lasting only a little time

examples.en: She has short hair now.
It's just a short walk to the station.

senses.note: short break(짧은 휴식), short answer(짧은 대답), for short(줄여서) 등으로 자주 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: short pants that end above the knee

examples.en: It's hot, so I'm wearing shorts today.
He plays basketball in shorts and a t-shirt.
examples.ko: 그는 반바지에 티셔츠 입고 농구를 해.

senses.note: 항상 복수형, a pair of shorts. 미국에서는 남성용 사각 속옷도 (boxer) shorts 라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: one of the two parts of your body between your neck and your arms

examples.en: My shoulders are sore from carrying the bag.
He tapped me on the shoulder.

senses.note: 보통 복수 shoulders. 어깨를 으쓱하다 = shrug your shoulders. 발음은 '쇼울더'(l 소리 약함).

senses.meaningEn: to say something very loudly

examples.en: Don't shout; I can hear you fine.
He shouted my name across the street.
examples.ko: 그가 길 건너편에서 내 이름을 크게 불렀어.

senses.note: shout at 사람 = 화나서 소리치다(부정적), shout to 사람 = 멀어서 크게 부르다. 미국 구어는 yell 을 더 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a program on television or radio

examples.en: What's your favorite TV show?
