examples.en: I have a toothache, so I'm going to the dentist.
A bad toothache kept me awake all night.
examples.ko: 심한 치통 때문에 밤새 잠을 못 잤어.

senses.note: tooth(이 하나) + ache. 치과 = the dentist / dentist's office. 이가 아프다 = My tooth hurts.

senses.meaningEn: a small brush used for cleaning your teeth

examples.en: I need a new toothbrush. This one is old.
Don't forget to pack your toothbrush.

senses.note: tooth(단수)+brush. teethbrush 라고 하지 않는다. 전동 칫솔은 electric toothbrush.

senses.meaningEn: a soft substance you put on a toothbrush to clean your teeth

examples.en: Put a little toothpaste on the brush.
Which toothpaste do you use?

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사. '치약 하나'는 a tube of toothpaste.

senses.meaningEn: to put your hand or fingers on something

examples.en: Please don't touch the paintings.
He touched my arm to get my attention.
examples.ko: 그는 내 주의를 끌려고 팔을 살짝 건드렸어.

senses.note: 박물관 표지 Do not touch. 음식에 손도 안 댔다 = didn't touch the food.

senses.meaningEn: communication with someone, especially by phone or message

examples.en: Let's keep in touch after you move.
I've lost touch with my old classmates.

senses.note: keep/stay in touch = 연락하다, get in touch = 연락을 취하다, lose touch = 연락이 끊기다.

senses.meaningEn: to make someone feel strong emotion, especially sympathy or gratitude

examples.en: Her kind words really touched me.
I was touched by the surprise party.

senses.note: be touched by = ~에 감동하다. touching = 감동적인.

senses.meaningEn: a visit to a place during which you look at its interesting parts, often with a guide

examples.en: We took a bus tour of the city.
Let me give you a tour of the house.

senses.note: take/go on a tour(투어하다), give someone a tour(안내해 주다). tour guide(가이드), package tour(패키지 여행). 가수 공연 투어도 tour(on tour).

senses.meaningEn: to travel around a place to see it

examples.en: We toured Italy for two weeks.
You can tour the museum for free today.
examples.ko: 오늘은 박물관을 무료로 둘러볼 수 있어.

senses.note: tour + 장소(전치사 없음). 동사보다 명사 take a tour 가 훨씬 많이 쓰임.

senses.meaningEn: a person who is visiting a place for pleasure

examples.en: The beach is full of tourists in summer.
Many tourists visit this old palace.
examples.ko: 관광객이 이 오래된 궁궐을 많이 찾아.

senses.note: tourist attraction(관광 명소), tourist information center(관광 안내소). 약간 '단체 관광객' 느낌이 있어서, 자기 소개엔 traveler 를 선호하는 사람도 있음.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of soft cloth used for drying yourself or things

examples.en: Can you hand me a towel, please?
The hotel gives you fresh towels every day.
examples.ko: 그 호텔은 매일 새 수건을 줘.

senses.note: 목욕 수건 bath towel, 손 수건 hand towel, 종이 타월 paper towel. 발음은 [타월]에 가깝다.

senses.meaningEn: a tall, narrow building or part of a building

examples.en: You can see the whole city from the top of the tower.
The Eiffel Tower is the most famous tower in Paris.

senses.note: N Seoul Tower, Tokyo Tower 처럼 고유명사에 많이 쓰임. 교회의 종탑은 bell tower, 시계탑은 clock tower. 아파트 '~타워'처럼 고층 건물 이름에도 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a place with houses and shops that is bigger than a village but smaller than a city

examples.en: We live in a small town by the sea.
examples.ko: 우리는 바다 옆 작은 마을에 살아.

examples.en: This town has only one school.

senses.note: village < town < city 순서로 커짐. 한국의 '읍·소도시' 느낌. 고향은 hometown.

senses.meaningEn: the center of the place where you live, or that place itself

examples.en: I'm going into town to buy some shoes.
My parents are out of town this week.
examples.ko: 부모님이 이번 주에 다른 지역에 가 계셔.

senses.note: 이 뜻에서는 보통 관사 없이 in town / into town / out of town 으로 씀. out of town = 출장·여행 등으로 동네를 떠나 있다.

senses.meaningEn: a thing for children to play with

examples.en: Please put your toys back in the box.
The baby got a new toy for her birthday.
examples.ko: 아기가 생일 선물로 새 장난감을 받았어.

senses.note: toy store(장난감 가게), toy car(장난감 자동차). 강아지 장난감도 dog toy.

senses.meaningEn: a shop that sells toys for children

examples.en: The kids want to go to the toy store after lunch.
examples.ko: 아이들이 점심 먹고 장난감 가게에 가고 싶어 해.

examples.en: We bought a puzzle at the toy store.

senses.note: 미국식은 store, 영국식은 toy shop. 장난감은 toy(셀 수 있는 명사) → toys.

senses.meaningEn: all the cars and other vehicles moving on the roads

examples.en: There was a lot of traffic this morning.
Sorry, I'm late because of the traffic.

senses.note: 불가산명사: a traffic (X), traffics (X). heavy traffic = 교통 혼잡, traffic jam = 교통 체증, traffic light = 신호등. '차가 막힌다' = There's a lot of traffic / I'm stuck in traffic.

senses.meaningEn: a set of red, yellow, and green lights that controls traffic on a road

examples.en: Turn right at the second traffic light.
The traffic light turned red, so we stopped.

senses.note: 보통 복수 traffic lights 로도 많이 씀(신호등 한 세트). 미국 구어로는 stoplight. '빨간불에 걸렸다'는 We got stuck at a red light. 신호등 색이 '바뀌다'는 turn green/red.

senses.meaningEn: a long vehicle with many connected cars that runs on rails

examples.en: The train to Busan leaves at eight.
I read a book on the train.

senses.note: 기차를 '타다'는 take the train / get on the train, 기차 '안에서'는 on the train(in 아님). '기차로'는 by train. 고속열차는 high-speed train(KTX).

senses.meaningEn: to practice a sport or skill regularly to get better at it

examples.en: She trains for the marathon every morning.
examples.ko: 그녀는 마라톤을 위해 매일 아침 훈련해.

examples.en: The team trains hard before every game.
examples.ko: 그 팀은 매 경기 전에 열심히 훈련해.

senses.note: train for + 대회/목표, train to be a nurse(간호사가 되기 위해 교육받다). 코치가 선수를 훈련시키다도 train(train the players). 명사 '훈련'은 training.

senses.meaningEn: things you throw away because you do not want them

examples.en: Can you take out the trash tonight?
examples.ko: 오늘 밤 쓰레기 좀 내다 버려 줄래?

examples.en: Don't leave trash on the table.

senses.note: 미국식. 영국에서는 rubbish. take out the trash = 쓰레기를 내다 버리다. 셀 수 없는 명사라 a trash (X).

senses.meaningEn: a container that you put trash in

examples.en: Throw it in the trash can over there.
The trash can is full again.

senses.note: garbage can 도 같은 뜻. 영국에서는 bin. 컴퓨터 화면의 쓰레기통도 trash.

senses.meaningEn: to go from one place to another, especially a long way

examples.en: I love to travel with my friends.
We traveled by train across Europe.

senses.note: travel to + 장소(travel to abroad 는 X, travel abroad). 미국식 traveled, 영국식 travelled. 교통수단은 travel by bus/train/plane.

senses.meaningEn: the activity of going to other places

examples.en: Travel is my favorite hobby.
Air travel is getting more expensive.

senses.note: 불가산. 한 번의 여행은 a trip, 'a travel' 은 쓰지 않음. travel agency(여행사), travel insurance(여행자 보험).

senses.meaningEn: a tall plant with a trunk, branches, and leaves

examples.en: There's a big tree in front of our house.
examples.ko: 우리 집 앞에 큰 나무가 있어.

examples.en: The kids love climbing trees.

senses.note: 살아 있는 나무 = tree, 재료인 목재 = wood(a wooden table). 나무를 심다 = plant a tree, 베다 = cut down a tree. Christmas tree, family tree(가계도), apple tree.

senses.meaningEn: a journey to a place and back again, usually for a short time

examples.en: How was your trip to Jeju?
Have a nice trip!

senses.note: 가장 일반적인 '여행'. 왕복 개념이 있음. business trip(출장), school trip(수학여행), day trip(당일치기). go on a trip / take a trip. travel 은 주로 동사/추상명사라 'a travel' 은 틀림.

senses.meaningEn: to hit your foot against something and fall or almost fall

examples.en: I tripped on the stairs this morning.
Be careful, don't trip over the cable.

senses.note: trip over/on + 걸린 물건. 과거형 tripped(p 두 개).

senses.meaningEn: a cup or other object given to the winner of a competition

examples.en: The team lifted the trophy together.
Dad keeps his old bowling trophy on the shelf.
examples.ko: 아빠는 옛날 볼링 트로피를 선반에 두고 계셔.

senses.note: lift/win the trophy(우승컵을 들다/차지하다). 복수형은 trophies. 발음은 '트로피'보다 '트로우피' /ˈtroʊfi/.

senses.meaningEn: a large road vehicle used for carrying goods

examples.en: A big truck was parked in front of our house.
examples.ko: 큰 트럭이 우리 집 앞에 주차되어 있었어.

examples.en: The moving truck arrives at nine tomorrow.

senses.note: 미국식 truck, 영국식 lorry. 픽업트럭은 pickup truck, 음식 파는 트럭은 food truck, 소방차는 fire truck. 트럭 운전사는 truck driver.

senses.meaningEn: to make an effort to do something

examples.en: I'll try to call you tonight.
She tried hard, but she didn't win.

senses.note: try to do = ~하려고 노력하다. 구어에서는 try and do 도 흔함. Nice try! = 아쉽지만 잘했어(격려 또는 가벼운 놀림).

senses.meaningEn: to test something to see if you like it

examples.en: Try this soup. It's really good.
examples.ko: 이 수프 한번 먹어 봐. 진짜 맛있어.

examples.en: Have you tried Korean food before?
examples.ko: 한국 음식 먹어 본 적 있어요?

senses.note: try + 명사 = 먹어 보다/써 보다. try on 은 옷·신발을 '입어 보다'. try doing = 시험 삼아 ~해 보다(try to do 와 뜻이 다름).

senses.meaningEn: an attempt to do something

examples.en: Let me have a try.
He got it right on his first try.

senses.note: give it a try = 한번 해 보다. 미국식으로 have a try 보다 give it a try/shot 이 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: the day of the week after Monday and before Wednesday

examples.en: The meeting was moved to Tuesday.
We play soccer every Tuesday evening.

senses.note: 철자에 주의: Tuesday(Thursday 와 헷갈리기 쉬움). 미국식 발음은 /ˈtuːzdeɪ/, 영국식은 /ˈtjuːzdeɪ/. 글에서는 Tue. 또는 Tues. 로 줄여 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: a brightly colored spring flower shaped like a cup

examples.en: Tulips come out in April.
She planted yellow tulips by the door.
examples.ko: 그녀는 문 옆에 노란 튤립을 심었어.

senses.note: 발음 주의: /ˈtuːlɪp/ (튜울립 아님). 네덜란드(the Netherlands)가 튤립으로 유명함.

senses.meaningEn: to change direction

examples.en: Turn left at the next corner.
Turn around, you're going the wrong way.

senses.note: turn left / turn right / turn around. 길 안내의 기본 표현.

senses.meaningEn: to become a different color, state, or age

examples.en: The leaves turn red in October.
My son turns seven next month.
examples.ko: 우리 아들은 다음 달에 일곱 살이 돼.

senses.note: turn + 색/나이. turn thirty = 서른 살이 되다.

senses.meaningEn: the time when it is your chance to do something

examples.en: It's your turn to roll the dice.
Please wait your turn in line.

senses.note: take turns = 번갈아 하다.

senses.meaningEn: to make a machine, light, or water stop

examples.en: Turn off your phone during the movie.
examples.ko: 영화 보는 동안 폰 꺼 줘.

examples.en: Did you turn off the water in the bathroom?

senses.note: turn off 는 전원·물·가스 모두 가능. switch off 도 같은 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: to leave the road you are driving on

examples.en: Turn off at the next exit.
We turned off the highway to get gas.

senses.meaningEn: to make a machine or light start working

examples.en: Can you turn on the TV?
Turn the light on, it's too dark.

senses.note: turn on the TV / turn the TV on 둘 다 가능. 대명사는 turn it on 만 가능.

senses.meaningEn: to make water or gas start flowing

examples.en: Turn on the hot water for the bath.
Don't turn on the gas yet.

senses.meaningEn: an animal with a hard shell on its back that moves slowly and lives in or near water

examples.en: The turtle slowly walked across the beach.
I have a small turtle as a pet.

senses.note: 미국에서는 민물·바다 거북 모두 turtle. 땅거북은 tortoise. 거북 등딱지는 shell. 느린 것의 대표: as slow as a turtle.

senses.meaningEn: short for television; the machine with a screen

examples.en: Turn off the TV and go to bed.
The TV in my room is really small.

senses.note: 보통 대문자 TV 로 씀. the TV = 기기, 복수는 TVs.

senses.meaningEn: the programs you watch on television

examples.en: What's on TV tonight?
I saw him on TV yesterday.

senses.note: watch TV, on TV 에는 the 를 붙이지 않음. TV show = TV 프로그램.

senses.meaningEn: the number 12

examples.en: Lunch is at twelve.
A year has twelve months.

senses.note: 서수는 twelfth(12th, v 가 f 로 바뀜). 12개 묶음은 a dozen. 12시는 twelve o'clock 또는 noon(정오)/midnight(자정)으로 말함.

senses.meaningEn: the number 20

examples.en: This jacket was only twenty dollars.
I'll be twenty next month.
examples.ko: 나 다음 달에 스무 살 돼.

senses.note: 미국식 발음은 t 가 약해져 /ˈtweni/ 처럼 들림. 21~29는 twenty-one, twenty-two 처럼 하이픈으로 연결. 서수는 twentieth(20th). in your twenties = 20대에.

senses.meaningEn: two times

examples.en: I brush my teeth twice a day.
examples.ko: 나는 하루에 두 번 이를 닦아.

examples.en: She called me twice this morning.
examples.ko: 그녀가 오늘 아침에 두 번 전화했어.

senses.note: two times 보다 twice 가 훨씬 자연스러움. 세 번부터는 three times, four times. Think twice. = 다시 한번 생각해 봐.

senses.meaningEn: two times as much or as many

examples.en: This bag costs twice as much as that one.
examples.ko: 이 가방은 저거보다 두 배나 비싸.

examples.en: My brother eats twice as much as me.
examples.ko: 우리 형은 나보다 두 배는 먹어.

senses.note: twice as + 형용사/부사 + as 형태로 비교. 세 배 이상은 three times as ... as.

senses.meaningEn: one of two children born to the same mother at the same time

examples.en: My brother and I are twins.
She has a twin sister who looks just like her.
examples.ko: 그녀는 자기랑 똑 닮은 쌍둥이 여동생이 있어.

senses.note: 두 명을 말할 때 twins. identical twins = 일란성 쌍둥이, twin brother/sister = 쌍둥이 형제/자매.

senses.meaningEn: having two matching parts, such as two single beds

examples.en: I'd like a twin room for two nights, please.
examples.ko: 1인용 침대 두 개 있는 방으로 이틀 묵고 싶어요.

examples.en: The hotel room has twin beds.
examples.ko: 그 호텔 방에는 1인용 침대가 두 개 있어.

senses.note: 호텔 예약 필수 단어. twin room(침대 두 개) vs double room(2인용 침대 하나).

senses.meaningEn: the number 2

examples.en: A table for two, please.
The movie starts at two thirty.

senses.note: to, too 와 발음이 같음(/tuː/). 서수는 second(2nd). the two of us = 우리 둘. 식당에서 Table for two 는 필수 표현.

senses.meaningEn: a group of things or people that are similar in some way

examples.en: What type of music do you like?
This type of phone is very popular.

senses.note: type of + 명사. kind/sort 와 거의 같은 뜻. 혈액형은 blood type.

senses.meaningEn: to write something using a keyboard

examples.en: Type your password and press Enter.
She types really fast.

senses.note: 손으로 쓰는 건 write, 키보드는 type. 오타는 typo.

senses.meaningEn: not nice to look at

examples.en: That is the ugliest sweater I have ever seen.
examples.ko: 저건 내가 본 것 중 가장 못생긴 스웨터야.

examples.en: The building is old and a little ugly.
examples.ko: 그 건물은 오래되고 좀 보기 흉해.

senses.note: 사람에게 직접 쓰면 매우 무례함. 물건·건물·옷에 쓰는 것이 안전하다. ugly duckling(미운 오리 새끼).

senses.meaningEn: unpleasant, angry, or likely to become violent

examples.en: The argument got ugly very fast.
He said some ugly things to her.
examples.ko: 그가 그녀에게 아주 못된 말을 했어.

senses.note: turn/get ugly = (상황이) 험악해지다. 날씨에도 씀: ugly weather(궂은 날씨).

senses.meaningEn: a thing you hold over your head to keep dry in the rain

examples.en: Take an umbrella; it might rain.
I left my umbrella on the bus again.

senses.note: 우산을 '쓰다'는 use an umbrella, '펴다/접다'는 open/close an umbrella. 양산도 (sun) umbrella 또는 parasol.

senses.meaningEn: the brother of your mother or father, or the husband of your aunt

examples.en: My uncle gave me a bike for my birthday.
Uncle Tom tells the funniest jokes.
examples.ko: 톰 삼촌은 정말 재미있는 농담을 하셔.

senses.note: 삼촌·외삼촌·고모부·이모부 모두 uncle. 한국어처럼 모르는 아저씨를 uncle 이라고 부르지 않음.

senses.meaningEn: to know what something means or how it works

examples.en: I don't understand this question.
Do you understand English?

senses.note: 진행형(I'm understanding)으로 쓰지 않음. 대화 중 '알겠어요'는 I see. / Got it. 이 더 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: to know how someone feels and why they act that way

examples.en: My mom always understands me.
I understand how you feel.

senses.note: I understand. 는 상대의 사정을 받아들인다는 뜻. 상대가 화났을 때 I understand you. 보다 I understand how you feel. 이 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: special clothes worn by all members of a school, team, or job

examples.en: Do you have to wear a uniform at your school?
The nurse was wearing a white uniform.

senses.note: 교복은 school uniform. 소리 /j/ 로 시작하므로 an uniform ✗ → a uniform.

senses.meaningEn: up to a particular time, and then stopping

examples.en: The store is open until nine.
I'll wait here until lunch time.

senses.note: until 은 '그때까지 계속되는' 상태·행동에 쓴다. 마감처럼 '그 전 어느 시점에 한 번' 하는 일은 by 를 쓴다(finish it by Friday). 한국어 '~까지' 가 둘 다를 뜻해 가장 흔한 실수. 구어체 till 도 같은 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: up to the time when something happens

examples.en: Wait until the light turns green.
Stir the soup until it gets hot.

senses.note: until 절도 미래라도 현재형(until it gets hot). not ... until = ~해서야 비로소: I didn't know until yesterday(어제야 알았어).

senses.meaningEn: to copy a file from your device to the internet or another computer

examples.en: Upload your photo to the website.
It took ages to upload the video.

senses.note: upload A to B. 내 기기에서 인터넷으로 가면 up, 반대는 download. 명사도 같은 형태.

senses.meaningEn: to or on a higher floor of a building

examples.en: Go upstairs and brush your teeth.
My bedroom is upstairs, next to the bathroom.
examples.ko: 내 방은 위층에 있어, 욕실 옆에.

senses.note: go upstairs 처럼 to 없이 바로 씀(go to upstairs ✗). 형용사로도 씀: the upstairs bathroom.

senses.meaningEn: to do something with a tool, object, or method for a purpose

examples.en: Can I use your phone for a minute?
We use chopsticks to eat noodles.
examples.ko: 우리는 국수를 먹을 때 젓가락을 써.

senses.note: 동사 use 는 /juːz/(ㅈ), 명사 use 는 /juːs/(ㅆ) 로 발음이 다름. use A to do B(B 하려고 A 를 쓰다). '다 써버리다'는 use up.

senses.meaningEn: the act of using something, or the purpose it is used for

examples.en: This room is for the use of students only.
examples.ko: 이 방은 학생만 사용할 수 있어요.

examples.en: It's no use crying about it now.

senses.note: 명사는 /juːs/. It's no use -ing = ~해도 소용없다. make use of(활용하다), in use(사용 중).

senses.meaningEn: used to + verb: something that happened or was true in the past but not now

examples.en: I used to live in Busan when I was little.
She used to hate carrots, but now she loves them.
examples.ko: 그녀는 당근을 싫어했었는데 지금은 아주 좋아해.

senses.note: used to + 동사원형 = 과거의 습관·상태(지금은 아님). be used to + -ing(~에 익숙하다) 와 구분: I'm used to getting up early.

senses.meaningEn: most of the time, but not always

examples.en: I usually get up at seven.
What do you usually do on weekends?

senses.note: always(100%)보다 약하고 often 보다 강하다(약 80~90%). 위치는 일반동사 앞, be 동사 뒤(He is usually quiet). 문장 앞에 Usually, ... 로 쓸 수도 있음. 형용사 usual: as usual = 평소처럼.

senses.meaningEn: a period when school is closed and students do not have classes

examples.en: Summer vacation starts next week!
What did you do during winter vacation?

senses.note: 미국식 vacation, 영국식 holiday. summer/winter vacation = 여름/겨울 방학. 미국 학교에서는 짧은 방학을 break(spring break)라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: time off from work, often spent traveling

examples.en: We're going on vacation to Jeju.
He's on vacation until Friday.

senses.note: go on vacation / be on vacation. take a vacation = 휴가를 내다. 영국식은 go on holiday. 전치사는 on 을 써야 함(in vacation 은 틀림).

senses.meaningEn: a medium-sized road vehicle with a roof, used for carrying people or goods

examples.en: We rented a van for the family trip.
The delivery van is parked outside.

senses.note: 한국의 '승합차'나 '택배 차'에 해당. 미니밴은 minivan. 사람 많을 때 'Let's take the van.' 처럼 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a plant or part of a plant that is eaten as food, such as a carrot or onion

examples.en: Eat your vegetables before you have dessert.
We buy fresh vegetables at the market every week.
examples.ko: 우리는 매주 시장에서 신선한 채소를 사.

senses.note: 보통 복수형 vegetables 로 씀. 일상 대화에서는 veggies 로 줄여 말함. 발음은 3음절 [베지터블]이 아니라 [베취터블]처럼 e 를 거의 생략.

senses.meaningEn: a game that you play on a computer, phone, or TV screen

examples.en: My brother plays video games every day.
Can I buy a new video game for my birthday?
examples.ko: 생일에 새 게임 하나 사도 돼?

senses.note: 한국어 '게임'은 영어에서 보통 video game 또는 play games. 'PC방'은 internet cafe / PC bang. 콘솔 게임은 console game.

senses.meaningEn: a very small town in the countryside

examples.en: My grandmother lives in a quiet village.
The village has one shop and a church.
examples.ko: 그 마을에는 가게 하나와 교회가 있어.

senses.note: 시골의 작은 마을. 도시 안의 '동네'는 village 가 아니라 neighborhood. 'It takes a village to raise a child' = 아이 하나 키우려면 온 마을이 필요하다.

senses.meaningEn: a small musical instrument with four strings that you hold under your chin and play with a bow

examples.en: She has played the violin since she was five.
examples.ko: 그녀는 다섯 살 때부터 바이올린을 연주해 왔어.

examples.en: The violin sounds so beautiful in this song.
examples.ko: 이 곡에서 바이올린 소리가 정말 아름다워.

senses.note: 강세는 마지막 음절 vio-LIN. 바이올린 연주자는 violinist, 활은 bow. 비슷한 악기 cello(첼로)는 /ˈtʃeloʊ/.

senses.meaningEn: to go to see a person or a place

examples.en: We visited my grandma last weekend.
I want to visit Japan next year.

senses.note: visit to Japan (X) → visit Japan. 동사 뒤에 전치사 없이 바로 장소·사람. 웹사이트 방문도 visit a website.

senses.meaningEn: an occasion when you go to see a person or place

examples.en: Thanks for the visit, come again soon.
examples.ko: 와 줘서 고마워, 또 놀러 와.

examples.en: This is my first visit to Busan.

senses.note: 명사일 때는 a visit to + 장소. pay a visit = 방문하다. 병원 진료도 a doctor's visit.

senses.meaningEn: the sound you make when you speak or sing

examples.en: She has a beautiful singing voice.
Please lower your voice, the baby is sleeping.
examples.ko: 목소리 좀 낮춰, 아기가 자고 있어.

senses.note: 목소리가 안 나오다 lose my voice. 큰 목소리로 in a loud voice. 전화 음성은 voice message.

senses.meaningEn: a game in which two teams hit a ball over a high net with their hands

examples.en: We played volleyball on the beach.
My sister is on the volleyball team.

senses.note: beach volleyball(비치발리볼). 발음은 '발리볼'에 가깝고 첫 음절 강세. 네트는 net, 서브는 serve.

senses.meaningEn: to stay where you are until something happens or someone comes

examples.en: Wait for me! I'm almost ready.
We waited an hour for the bus.

senses.note: wait for + 사람/사물(for 를 빠뜨리는 실수가 많음). Wait a minute. / Hold on. = 잠깐만. I can't wait! = 너무 기대돼!

senses.meaningEn: to serve food and drinks to people at tables

examples.en: She waits tables at a cafe on weekends.
examples.ko: 그녀는 주말에 카페에서 서빙 일을 해.

examples.en: I waited tables when I was in college.
examples.ko: 대학 때 식당에서 서빙 아르바이트를 했어.

senses.note: wait tables = 식당에서 서빙하다(미국 구어). waiter/waitress 가 여기서 나온 말. 요즘은 server 라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: a man who serves food and drinks at a restaurant

examples.en: The waiter brought us the menu.
Let's ask the waiter for some water.

senses.note: 종업원을 부를 때 'Waiter!' 라고 소리치지 않음. 'Excuse me.' 가 자연스러움. 성별 중립 표현은 server.

senses.meaningEn: a woman who serves food and drinks at a restaurant

examples.en: The waitress was very kind to us.
She works as a waitress on weekends.

senses.note: 요즘은 성별 구분 없이 server 를 많이 씀. 사람을 직접 부를 때는 Excuse me.

senses.meaningEn: to stop sleeping

examples.en: I usually wake up at seven.
She woke up late this morning.

senses.note: 보통 wake up 으로 씀. get up 은 '침대에서 나오다'로 뜻이 조금 다름.

senses.meaningEn: to make someone stop sleeping

examples.en: Can you wake me at six tomorrow?
examples.ko: 내일 6시에 나 깨워 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: Don't wake the baby, please.

senses.note: wake somebody up 도 같은 뜻. 목적어가 대명사면 wake me up 순서.

senses.meaningEn: to move forward by putting one foot in front of the other

examples.en: I walk to work every day.
Let's walk; it's not far.

senses.note: walk to + 장소. 'on foot(걸어서)' 보다 동사 walk 를 쓰는 게 더 자연스러움. 산책하다 = take a walk.

senses.meaningEn: to take a dog outside for exercise, or to go with someone to a place on foot

examples.en: I have to walk the dog before dinner.
examples.ko: 저녁 먹기 전에 개 산책시켜야 해.

examples.en: I'll walk you to the bus stop.

senses.note: walk the dog 는 '개를 산책시키다'. walk + 사람 + to/home = 걸어서 데려다주다.

senses.meaningEn: a trip that you make by walking, often for pleasure

examples.en: Let's go for a walk after lunch.
It's a ten-minute walk from here.

senses.note: go for a walk / take a walk = 산책하다. 'a five-minute walk' 처럼 걸어서 걸리는 거리 표현에 자주 씀.

senses.meaningEn: one of the flat sides of a room or building

examples.en: Let's paint the walls light blue.
There's a picture of us on the wall.

senses.note: 벽'에' 걸다는 on the wall(in 아님).

senses.meaningEn: a tall structure of stone or brick that goes around an area

examples.en: There's a stone wall around the old town.
The kids climbed over the wall into the yard.

senses.note: the Great Wall of China = 만리장성. 나무 울타리는 fence.

senses.meaningEn: a small flat case for carrying money and cards

examples.en: I left my wallet at home.
He keeps a photo of his kids in his wallet.
examples.ko: 그는 지갑에 아이들 사진을 넣고 다녀.

senses.note: 남녀 모두 쓰는 접이식 지갑. 미국에서 purse 는 지갑이 아니라 여성용 핸드백이니 주의. 동전 지갑은 coin purse.

senses.meaningEn: to wish to have or do something

examples.en: I want a cup of coffee.
Do you want to go to the movies tonight?

senses.note: want + 명사 / want to + 동사. 'want -ing' 는 틀림(want going ×). 주문·부탁에서는 I'd like... 가 더 정중함. 상대에게 Do you want...? 는 친근한 권유.

senses.meaningEn: to wish for another person to do something

examples.en: Mom wants you to clean your room.
I want everyone to be here by nine.

senses.note: want + 사람 + to 동사. 한국어식으로 want that you... 라고 쓰지 않음. 부드럽게 말하려면 I'd like you to...

senses.meaningEn: a little hot, in a pleasant way

examples.en: It's nice and warm today.
Put on a warm coat before you go out.

senses.note: 온도 순서: cold < cool < warm < hot. warm 은 '기분 좋게 따뜻한' 느낌. warm water = 따뜻한 물, hot water = 뜨거운 물.

senses.meaningEn: friendly and kind

examples.en: They gave us a warm welcome.
She's a warm and caring person.

senses.note: a warm welcome(따뜻한 환영), warm regards(이메일 맺음말: 안부를 전하며).

senses.meaningEn: to make something a little hotter

examples.en: Can you warm up the soup for me?
Sit by the fire and warm your hands.
examples.ko: 불 옆에 앉아서 손 좀 녹여.

senses.note: warm up = 데우다, 몸을 풀다(운동 전 준비운동).

senses.meaningEn: to clean something with water and often soap

examples.en: Wash your hands before you eat.
I washed my face with cold water.

senses.note: wash my face(세수하다), wash my hair(머리 감다). 몸 전체를 씻는 것은 take a shower / take a bath.

senses.meaningEn: to clean clothes or dishes

examples.en: I'll wash the dishes after dinner.
Can you wash these jeans today?
examples.ko: 이 청바지 오늘 빨아 줄 수 있어?

senses.note: wash the dishes = do the dishes(설거지하다). wash the clothes = do the laundry(빨래하다).

senses.meaningEn: to use time, money, or things badly or for nothing

examples.en: Don't waste your money on that.
I wasted the whole afternoon on my phone.

senses.note: waste + 시간/돈 + on + 대상. a waste of time = 시간 낭비(명사).

senses.meaningEn: things that are no longer needed and are thrown away

examples.en: Please put food waste in the green bin.
examples.ko: 음식물 쓰레기는 녹색 통에 넣어 주세요.

examples.en: We should produce less plastic waste.

senses.note: 일상 '쓰레기'는 미국 trash/garbage, 영국 rubbish. waste 는 분리수거·환경 문맥에서 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to look at something for a period of time

examples.en: We watched a movie together last night.
I like watching soccer on TV.
examples.ko: 나는 TV로 축구 보는 걸 좋아해.

senses.note: TV·영화·경기는 watch, 그냥 눈에 들어오는 건 see, 시선을 돌리는 건 look.

senses.meaningEn: a small clock you wear on your wrist

examples.en: I got a new watch for my birthday.
My watch says it's almost three.

senses.note: 벽시계는 clock, 손목시계는 watch.

senses.meaningEn: to be careful about something

examples.en: Watch your step, the floor is wet.
Watch out! A car is coming.

senses.note: Watch out! = 조심해! Watch your head = 머리 조심.

senses.meaningEn: the clear liquid that falls as rain and that people drink

examples.en: Can I have a glass of water, please?
Drink plenty of water every day.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사. a water 가 아니라 a glass of water, a bottle of water. 식당에서 생수는 bottled water, 수돗물은 tap water.

senses.meaningEn: to pour water on plants

examples.en: Don't forget to water the plants.
examples.ko: 식물에 물 주는 거 잊지 마.

examples.en: I water the garden every evening.

senses.note: give water to the plants 보다 water the plants 가 훨씬 자연스럽다.

senses.meaningEn: a place where water falls from a high place, such as a cliff

examples.en: We took photos in front of the waterfall.
You can hear the waterfall from here.

senses.note: water + fall 을 붙여서 한 단어로 씀. 유명한 폭포 이름은 Niagara Falls 처럼 Falls 라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: a very large, round fruit with a green skin and sweet red inside

examples.en: Nothing beats cold watermelon on a hot day.
Can you cut the watermelon into slices?

senses.note: 통째로는 a watermelon(셀 수 있음), 잘라 놓은 과육은 some watermelon(셀 수 없음). 한 조각은 a slice of watermelon. 참외·멜론류는 melon.

senses.meaningEn: to move your hand from side to side to say hello or goodbye

examples.en: She waved at me from across the street.
examples.ko: 그녀가 길 건너편에서 내게 손을 흔들었어.

examples.en: The kids waved goodbye to Grandma.

senses.note: wave at/to 사람. wave goodbye = 손 흔들어 작별 인사. 명사 wave = 손짓 또는 파도(the waves at the beach).

senses.meaningEn: a raised line of water that moves across the sea

examples.en: The waves were too big to swim today.
examples.ko: 오늘은 파도가 너무 커서 수영을 못 했어.

examples.en: We jumped over the small waves at the beach.
examples.ko: 우리는 해변에서 작은 파도를 뛰어넘으며 놀았어.

senses.note: a heat wave = 폭염(더위의 물결). 머리의 웨이브도 wave(wavy hair).

senses.meaningEn: the road or path you take to get to a place

examples.en: Can you tell me the way to the station?
I think we're going the wrong way.
examples.ko: 우리 길 잘못 든 것 같아.

senses.note: the way to + 장소. on the way(가는 길에), on my way(가는 중이야), lose one's way(길을 잃다). 물리적 도로 자체는 road/street.

senses.meaningEn: how you do something

examples.en: This is the easy way to cook rice.
I like the way you talk.

senses.note: the way + 주어 + 동사(…하는 방식). 'No way!'(절대 안 돼/말도 안 돼), 'by the way'(그런데, 참)도 매우 흔한 표현.

senses.meaningEn: not strong in body or health

examples.en: I feel weak after being sick all week.
Grandpa's legs are weak now, so he walks slowly.
examples.ko: 할아버지는 이제 다리가 약해서 천천히 걸으셔.

senses.note: week(주)와 발음이 같다(/wiːk/). 문맥으로 구분.

senses.meaningEn: having little flavor or not much of a substance in it

examples.en: This coffee is too weak for me.
I like my tea weak, with lots of milk.
examples.ko: 나는 차를 연하게, 우유 많이 넣어서 마셔.

senses.note: 커피·차가 연하면 weak, 진하면 strong. thin coffee 라고 하지 않는다.

senses.meaningEn: to have clothes, shoes, glasses, or jewelry on your body

examples.en: What are you wearing to the party?
She wore a red dress yesterday.

senses.note: 한국어는 입다/쓰다/신다/끼다/차다로 갈리지만 영어는 모두 wear. put on 은 '입는 동작', wear 는 '입고 있는 상태'. 화장·향수·머리 모양도 wear(wear makeup, wear perfume). wear-wore-worn.

senses.meaningEn: to become thin or damaged from being used a lot

examples.en: My shoes are worn out.
These jeans have worn thin at the knees.

senses.note: wear out = 닳아서 못 쓰게 되다; 사람에게 쓰면 '지치게 하다'(I'm worn out = 완전히 지쳤어).

senses.meaningEn: the condition of the air outside, such as sun, rain, or wind

examples.en: What's the weather like today?
We had great weather on our trip.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: a weather ✗, a good weather ✗ → good weather ✓. weather(날씨)와 whether(~인지)는 발음이 같음. 날씨 묻기: How's the weather? / What's the weather like?

senses.meaningEn: the day of the week after Tuesday and before Thursday

examples.en: Are you free on Wednesday afternoon?
The library is closed on Wednesdays.

senses.note: 철자와 발음이 다르다: 첫 d 는 발음하지 않음(/ˈwenzdeɪ/). 한국인이 자주 틀리는 것: Wen-nes-day 로 3음절 발음하기. 줄임말은 Wed.

senses.meaningEn: a period of seven days, usually from Monday to Sunday

examples.en: I go to the gym three times a week.
examples.ko: 나는 일주일에 세 번 헬스장에 가.

examples.en: See you next week!

senses.note: this week(이번 주), next week(다음 주), last week(지난주) 앞에는 전치사를 쓰지 않는다: on next week (X). once a week = 일주일에 한 번. 발음이 weak(약한)와 같다.

senses.meaningEn: the working days of the week, Monday to Friday

examples.en: I'm too busy during the week, so let's meet Saturday.
We work a five-day week at my company.

senses.note: during the week = 주중에(평일에). a four-day week = 주 4일 근무. weekday(평일) ↔ weekend(주말).

senses.meaningEn: Saturday and Sunday

examples.en: What are you doing this weekend?
We went camping on the weekend.

senses.note: 미국식은 on the weekend, 영국식은 at the weekend. on weekends = 주말마다. Have a good weekend! 는 금요일 작별 인사로 아주 흔하다. this weekend 앞에는 전치사 없음.

senses.meaningEn: happening or done once every week

examples.en: We have a weekly meeting on Monday.
I get paid weekly, not monthly.

senses.note: 형용사(a weekly meeting)와 부사(meet weekly) 둘 다 같은 형태. 명사로 쓰면 "주간지". once a week 와 같은 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: to have a particular weight

examples.en: How much do you weigh?
The baby weighs four kilos now.

senses.note: 무게를 묻는 기본 문장: How much does it weigh? 명사는 weight(/weɪt/). 체중 질문은 실례가 될 수 있음.

senses.meaningEn: to measure how heavy something is

examples.en: Let me weigh the apples for you.
Weigh your bag before you go to the airport.
examples.ko: 공항 가기 전에 가방 무게를 재 봐.

senses.note: weigh myself = 체중을 재다. 기계는 scale(저울).

senses.meaningEn: how heavy someone or something is

examples.en: I've gained some weight this winter.
What's the weight of this package?

senses.note: 살이 빠지다 lose weight, 살이 찌다 gain/put on weight. wait(기다리다)와 발음이 같다. 동사 '무게를 재다'는 weigh.

senses.meaningEn: a heavy object that you lift to make your muscles stronger

examples.en: He lifts weights at the gym three times a week.
examples.ko: 그는 일주일에 세 번 헬스장에서 웨이트를 해.

examples.en: Start with light weights and go slowly.

senses.note: lift weights = 근력 운동을 하다. 한국어 '헬스하다'에 가장 가까운 표현은 work out.

senses.meaningEn: to greet someone in a friendly way when they arrive

examples.en: They welcomed us with hot tea and cookies.
examples.ko: 그들은 따뜻한 차와 쿠키로 우리를 맞아 주었어.

examples.en: Please welcome our new teacher, Ms. Kim.
examples.ko: 새로 오신 김 선생님을 환영해 주세요.

senses.note: 'Welcome to Korea!' 처럼 인사말로도 씀(welcome to + 장소). 손님에게 'Welcome!' 한 단어로도 충분.

senses.meaningEn: wanted and accepted gladly; also used to reply to 'thank you'

examples.en: Thanks for the ride! — You're welcome.
You're always welcome at our house.

senses.note: You're welcome 은 고맙다는 말에 대한 기본 대답. 'You're welcome to use my car.' = 마음껏 써도 돼. 'welcome' 에 두 번째 l 이 없음(wellcome X).

senses.meaningEn: the direction where the sun goes down

examples.en: The sun sets in the west.
Incheon is to the west of Seoul.

senses.note: the West Coast(미국 서부 해안), the West(서양). 형용사·부사로도 쓰임(west wind, drive west). western = 서부의/서양의, 영화 장르 '서부극'도 western.

senses.meaningEn: a very large sea animal that breathes air through a hole on top of its head

examples.en: The blue whale is the biggest animal on Earth.
We went whale watching on our trip to Hawaii.
examples.ko: 하와이 여행에서 고래 관찰 투어를 했어.

senses.note: whale 의 wh 는 /w/ 로 발음(/weɪl/), wail(울부짖다)과 같은 소리. whale watching(고래 관찰). 고래는 fish 가 아닌 mammal(포유류).

senses.meaningEn: a round object that turns so a car, bike, or cart can move

examples.en: My bike has a flat front wheel.
A car has four wheels.

senses.note: 바퀴의 고무 부분은 tire(타이어). 한국어 '휠'은 보통 금속 부분만 가리키지만 영어 wheel 은 바퀴 전체.

senses.meaningEn: the round part you hold and turn to drive a car

examples.en: Keep both hands on the wheel, please.
examples.ko: 두 손 다 운전대에 올려 둬.

examples.en: Who was behind the wheel when it happened?

senses.note: 정식 명칭은 steering wheel. 자동차 '핸들'은 콩글리시 — handle 은 문손잡이. behind the wheel = 운전 중인.

senses.meaningEn: to speak very quietly so that only a person near you can hear

examples.en: She whispered the answer to me in class.
examples.ko: 수업 중에 그녀가 내게 답을 속삭여 줬어.

examples.en: Why are you whispering? Nobody's here.

senses.note: whisper to 사람 / whisper something in someone's ear. 명사도 whisper(speak in a whisper). 영화관·도서관에서 'Keep it to a whisper.'

senses.meaningEn: a white board that you write on with special markers

examples.en: Write your answer on the whiteboard.
Who can erase the whiteboard for me?

senses.note: 쓰는 펜은 marker(whiteboard marker / dry-erase marker). 회의실에도 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: the woman that a person is married to

examples.en: My wife and I moved here last year.
examples.ko: 아내와 나는 작년에 여기로 이사 왔어.

examples.en: This is my wife, Jiyoung.

senses.note: 복수는 wifes 가 아니라 wives /waɪvz/. 남의 아내는 your wife, 자기 아내는 my wife.

senses.meaningEn: living or growing in nature, not kept by people

examples.en: We saw wild deer in the mountains.
These are wild flowers, not from a shop.
examples.ko: 이건 가게에서 산 게 아니라 야생화야.

senses.note: wild animals(야생 동물), in the wild(야생에서, 명사). 반대는 tame(길들여진) 또는 pet.

senses.meaningEn: very exciting, noisy, or not controlled

examples.en: The party last night was wild!
The kids went wild when they saw the cake.

senses.note: go wild = 열광하다, 난리를 치다. 'That's wild!' 는 '말도 안 돼, 대박' 정도의 감탄.

senses.meaningEn: to be the best or first in a game, race, or competition

examples.en: Our team won the game last night!
Who do you think will win the race?

senses.note: win 의 목적어는 경기·상(game, race, prize)이고 사람은 아님. '그를 이기다'는 beat him. win him 은 틀린 표현.

senses.meaningEn: to get a prize or money because you were successful or lucky

examples.en: She won first prize in the drawing contest.
My uncle won fifty dollars in the lottery.

senses.note: win a prize / win money / win a medal 처럼 '받다'의 의미로 자주 쓰임. 명사형은 win (a big win) 또는 victory.

senses.meaningEn: air that moves quickly outside

examples.en: The wind blew my hat off.
There's a cold wind today.

senses.note: 바람이 불다 = The wind blows / It's windy. strong wind(강풍), a light wind(약한 바람). 명사 wind 는 /wɪnd/, 동사 wind(감다, 구불구불하다)는 /waɪnd/ 로 발음이 다름.

senses.meaningEn: a space in a wall with glass in it that lets in light and air

examples.en: Could you open the window? It's hot in here.
examples.ko: 창문 좀 열어 줄래? 여기 덥다.

examples.en: I like sitting by the window on the train.

senses.note: 창가 자리 = window seat(비행기·기차). 가게 진열창도 window(shop window).

senses.meaningEn: a box on a computer screen that shows a program or a web page

examples.en: Close that window and open a new one.
examples.ko: 그 창 닫고 새 창을 열어.

examples.en: The link opens in a new window.

senses.note: 브라우저 탭은 tab, 창은 window. 팝업 창은 pop-up window.

senses.meaningEn: with a lot of wind

examples.en: It's too windy to use an umbrella.
examples.ko: 바람이 너무 세서 우산을 못 쓰겠어.

examples.en: Jeju is very windy in winter.

senses.note: '바람이 세다'를 The wind is strong 보다 It's windy 로 말하는 게 더 자연스러움. 발음 주의: windy /ˈwɪndi/, wind(감다)는 /waɪnd/.

senses.meaningEn: the part of a bird, insect, or plane that is used for flying

examples.en: The bird hurt its wing and can't fly.
I sat by the window, right over the wing.

senses.note: 새·곤충·비행기 모두 wing. 복수 wings. 'take someone under your wing' = 보살펴 주다.

senses.meaningEn: a chicken wing cooked as food, often spicy

examples.en: Let's get some hot wings and a pizza.
These wings are too spicy for me.

senses.note: 보통 복수 wings 로 쓰고 chicken wings, buffalo wings 라고도 함. 미국에서 스포츠 경기 볼 때 즐겨 먹는 음식.

senses.meaningEn: the person or team that wins a game, race, or prize

examples.en: And the winner is... Team Blue!
The winner gets a free lunch.

senses.note: the winner of + 대회(the winner of the race). 복권 당첨자도 lottery winner. 비격식으로 '대박 아이템'을 a winner 라고도 함(This recipe is a winner).

senses.meaningEn: the coldest season of the year, between fall and spring

examples.en: It gets dark early in winter.
We go skiing every winter.

senses.note: winter break(겨울 방학), winter coat, the Winter Olympics. 날씨 이야기에서 cold/freezing 과 함께 자주 나온다.

senses.meaningEn: to clean or dry something by rubbing it with a cloth or your hand

examples.en: Please wipe the table after dinner.
examples.ko: 저녁 먹고 식탁 좀 닦아 줘.

examples.en: Wipe your hands with this towel.

senses.note: wipe off(닦아 내다), wipe up(흘린 것을 닦다), wipe down(표면 전체를 닦다). clean 은 일반적인 청소, wipe 는 문질러 닦는 동작.

senses.meaningEn: to want something that is not true or not likely to happen

examples.en: I wish I had more time.
I wish it would stop raining.

senses.note: wish + 과거형(가정법): I wish I were taller. 가능한 일에는 hope: I hope it stops raining.

senses.meaningEn: to say that you hope someone will have something good

examples.en: I wish you a happy birthday!
Wish me luck on my test tomorrow.
examples.ko: 내일 시험 잘 보라고 응원해 줘.

senses.note: wish + 사람 + 명사: wish you luck / a safe trip / all the best.

senses.meaningEn: something you want very much to happen

examples.en: Make a wish and blow out the candles.
My wish is to travel the world someday.
examples.ko: 내 소원은 언젠가 세계 여행을 하는 거야.

senses.note: make a wish = 소원을 빌다. Best wishes = 편지·카드의 끝인사.

senses.meaningEn: a wild animal like a large dog that lives and hunts in groups

examples.en: We heard a wolf howling in the forest.
Wolves live and hunt in groups called packs.
examples.ko: 늑대는 '팩'이라고 하는 무리를 지어 살고 사냥해.

senses.note: 복수형은 wolves(f→ves). 늑대는 howl(울부짖다). 동화 속 big bad wolf(나쁜 늑대), cry wolf = 거짓 경보를 울리다.

senses.meaningEn: to eat something very quickly and in large bites

examples.en: He wolfed down his lunch in five minutes.
examples.ko: 그는 5분 만에 점심을 뚝딱 먹어 치웠어.

examples.en: Don't wolf your food. Eat slowly.
examples.ko: 음식 너무 급하게 먹지 마. 천천히 먹어.

senses.note: 거의 항상 wolf down 으로 쓰임. 배고픈 늑대가 먹어 치우는 모습에서 온 표현. 비격식.

senses.meaningEn: an adult female person

examples.en: The woman in the blue dress is my teacher.
examples.ko: 파란 드레스 입은 여자분이 우리 선생님이야.

examples.en: Many women work at this company.

senses.note: 복수 women 의 발음은 /ˈwɪmɪn/ (위민). 단수 woman 은 /ˈwʊmən/ (우먼). 한국인이 자주 섞어 발음함.

senses.meaningEn: to ask yourself a question or want to know something

examples.en: I wonder where she went.
I wonder if it will rain tomorrow.

senses.note: I wonder if/where/why ... 뒤에는 의문문 어순이 아니라 평서문 어순(where she went). I was wondering if you could ... 는 정중한 부탁.

senses.meaningEn: something very surprising and beautiful, or the feeling it gives you

examples.en: The Grand Canyon is a natural wonder.
The kids looked at the snow in wonder.

senses.note: No wonder you're tired! = 피곤한 게 당연하지!(놀랄 일이 아니다).

senses.meaningEn: the hard material that trees are made of, used for building and burning

examples.en: This table is made of wood.
We need more wood for the fire.

senses.note: 재료로서의 나무는 wood(불가산), 살아 있는 나무 한 그루는 tree. wooden = 나무로 된(형용사).

senses.meaningEn: a small forest; an area with many trees

examples.en: We walked through the woods behind the house.
examples.ko: 우리는 집 뒤 숲을 걸어서 지나갔어.

examples.en: Don't go into the woods alone at night.

senses.note: 이 뜻은 보통 복수 the woods. forest 보다 작은 숲.

senses.meaningEn: a single unit of language with a meaning

examples.en: What does this word mean?
I learn ten new words every day.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 새 단어를 열 개씩 외워.

senses.note: word 는 셀 수 있는 명사(a word, words). vocabulary(어휘)는 보통 셀 수 없음. in other words = 다시 말해서.

senses.meaningEn: something you say, or a promise

examples.en: Can I have a word with you?
examples.ko: 잠깐 얘기 좀 할 수 있을까?

examples.en: I give you my word. I'll be there.

senses.note: have a word with = ~와 잠깐 이야기하다(주로 진지한 이야기). keep your word = 약속을 지키다. Don't say a word. = 아무 말도 하지 마.

senses.meaningEn: to do a job, especially for money

examples.en: I work at a bank downtown.
She works from home on Fridays.

senses.note: work at/for + 회사, work as + 직업.

senses.meaningEn: to function correctly

examples.en: The elevator isn't working again.
Does this remote work with the TV?

senses.note: 기계가 '된다/안 된다'는 work / doesn't work. 아주 자주 쓰임.

senses.meaningEn: to have the result you want

examples.en: This medicine really works for headaches.
examples.ko: 이 약은 두통에 정말 효과가 있어.

examples.en: I tried your idea, and it worked!

senses.meaningEn: a job, or the place where you do it

examples.en: I have a lot of work to do today.
What time do you leave for work?

senses.note: work 는 셀 수 없는 명사. a work (X), many works (X). 직장 하나는 a job.

senses.meaningEn: a person who works, especially one who does a particular kind of job

examples.en: The workers start at eight every morning.
She is a hard worker and never gives up.
examples.ko: 그녀는 정말 열심히 일하고 절대 포기하지 않아.

senses.note: office worker(회사원), factory worker(공장 노동자), co-worker(동료). a hard worker = 성실한 사람. 회사 '직원'은 employee/staff 가 더 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: the earth and all the people, places, and things on it

examples.en: I want to travel around the world.
English is spoken all over the world.

senses.note: 항상 the world. in the world = 세상에서(the best food in the world). World Cup, world record.

senses.meaningEn: a particular area of activity or life

examples.en: She works in the world of fashion.
Kids live in their own little world.

senses.meaningEn: a long, thin animal with a soft body and no legs

examples.en: After the rain, there were worms on the sidewalk.
examples.ko: 비 온 뒤에 보도에 지렁이들이 있었어.

examples.en: Birds eat worms early in the morning.

senses.note: warm(따뜻한)과 철자가 비슷하지만 발음이 다름: worm /wɜːrm/, warm /wɔːrm/. 'The early bird catches the worm' = 일찍 일어나는 새가 벌레를 잡는다.

senses.meaningEn: to keep thinking about problems or bad things that might happen

examples.en: Don't worry, you'll do fine on the test.
examples.ko: 걱정 마, 시험 잘 볼 거야.

examples.en: My mom worries about me when I'm out late.

senses.note: worry about + 명사/-ing. 'I'm worried about ~' 가 가장 자연스러운 '걱정돼'. worried(걱정하는) / worrying(걱정스러운) 구분. 'No worries.' = 괜찮아, 별말을.

senses.meaningEn: a problem or feeling of being worried

examples.en: Money is my biggest worry right now.
She has no worries about the trip.
examples.ko: 그녀는 여행에 대해 아무 걱정이 없어.

senses.note: 복수형 worries. 'That's the least of my worries.' = 그건 걱정거리도 아니야.

senses.meaningEn: the part of your body between your hand and your arm

examples.en: I hurt my wrist when I fell.
She wears a watch on her left wrist.

senses.note: w 는 발음하지 않음(/rɪst/). 발목은 ankle. 손목시계 = wristwatch.

senses.meaningEn: to make letters or words on paper or a screen

examples.en: Write your name here, please.
I wrote the answer in pencil.

senses.note: write down = 받아 적다, 메모하다. right(오른쪽/옳은)와 발음이 같음.

senses.meaningEn: to send someone a letter or message

examples.en: I'll write to you when I get there.
She wrote me a long email yesterday.
examples.ko: 그녀가 어제 나한테 긴 이메일을 썼어.

senses.note: write to someone(영) / write someone(미) 둘 다 가능.

senses.meaningEn: to create a book, story, song, or report

examples.en: He has written three children's books.
examples.ko: 그는 어린이 책을 세 권 썼어.

examples.en: We are writing a story in class.

senses.note: 책을 쓴 사람은 writer / author. 노래를 쓰다 write a song, 숙제를 하다 do homework(write ✗).

senses.meaningEn: a person who writes books, stories, or articles

examples.en: My favorite writer is from Japan.
examples.ko: 내가 제일 좋아하는 작가는 일본 사람이야.

examples.en: She is a writer for a travel magazine.
examples.ko: 그녀는 여행 잡지에 글을 쓰는 작가야.

senses.note: author 는 책을 낸 '저자', writer 는 글 쓰는 사람 전반(기자·시나리오 작가 포함). TV 작가는 screenwriter.

senses.meaningEn: the area of land next to a house, usually with grass

examples.en: The kids are playing in the yard.
I need to cut the grass in the back yard.

senses.note: front yard(앞마당), backyard(뒷마당). 미국식 표현. 영국에서는 garden.

senses.meaningEn: a unit for measuring length, equal to about 0.9 meters

examples.en: The store is about a hundred yards from here.
He ran fifty yards in a few seconds.

senses.note: 1 yard = 3 feet ≈ 0.91m. 미식축구·거리 말할 때 자주 등장.

senses.meaningEn: a period of twelve months or 365 days

examples.en: We moved to Seoul two years ago.
Happy New Year!

senses.note: this year / last year / next year 앞에는 전치사 없음. all year (round) = 일 년 내내. 나이: I'm 20 years old. (years 복수) / a 20-year-old student (단수).

senses.meaningEn: a period of about nine months when students go to school

examples.en: My son is in his first year of high school.
The school year starts in March in Korea.

senses.note: 미국 대학은 freshman/sophomore/junior/senior year 로 학년을 부른다. school year = 학년도. 발음에 주의: year(/jɪr/)와 ear(/ɪr/)를 구분한다.

senses.meaningEn: on the day before today

examples.en: I called you yesterday, but you didn't answer.
It rained all day yesterday.

senses.note: yesterday 가 있으면 동사는 과거형: I go there yesterday (X) → I went there yesterday (O). the day before yesterday = 그저께. yesterday morning(어제 아침)이라고 하지만 '어젯밤'은 last night(yesterday night 는 어색).

senses.meaningEn: up to now, used in negative sentences

examples.en: I haven't had lunch yet.
The bus isn't here yet.

senses.note: 부정문 끝에 와서 "아직 ~않다". Not yet. 한 마디로 "아직요"라고 답할 수 있음. still 은 "아직도 계속" 느낌: It's still raining.

senses.meaningEn: used in questions to ask if something has happened

examples.en: Have you finished your homework yet?
Is dinner ready yet?

senses.note: 의문문 끝의 yet 은 "이제 됐어?"라는 기대·재촉의 느낌. already 를 쓰면 "벌써 했다고?"라는 놀람.

senses.meaningEn: but; despite that

examples.en: The hotel was small, yet very clean.
He is rich, yet he is not happy.

senses.note: but 보다 조금 글말 느낌. 뜻밖의 대조를 강조할 때 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a thick, slightly sour food made from milk

examples.en: I had yogurt with fruit this morning.
examples.ko: 오늘 아침에 과일 넣은 요거트를 먹었어.

examples.en: Can you buy some yogurt at the store?
examples.ko: 가게에서 요거트 좀 사 올 수 있어?

senses.note: yoghurt 로도 씀(영국식). 발음은 '요구르트'가 아니라 /ˈjoʊɡərt/. 한국의 마시는 요구르트는 drinkable yogurt.

senses.meaningEn: tasting very good (informal, often used by or with children)

examples.en: Yummy! I love this cake.
Mom made some yummy cookies for us.
examples.ko: 엄마가 우리한테 맛있는 쿠키를 만들어 주셨어.

senses.note: 아주 캐주얼한 말. 격식 있는 자리나 글에서는 delicious 를 씀. 반대말 yucky(맛없는, 더러운).

senses.meaningEn: an African wild animal like a horse with black and white stripes

examples.en: A zebra looks like a horse with stripes.
Zebras live together in big groups.

senses.note: 미국식 발음은 /ˈziːbrə/(지브라), 영국식은 /ˈzebrə/(제브라). 영국에서 zebra crossing 은 횡단보도(미국은 crosswalk).

senses.meaningEn: the number 0; nothing

examples.en: My phone number ends in zero.
The score was two to zero.

senses.note: 전화번호·방 번호를 읽을 때는 zero 대신 oh(/oʊ/)라고도 많이 읽음. 축구 점수에서는 nil(영국)·nothing(미국)도 씀. 복수형은 zeros.

senses.meaningEn: the temperature at which water freezes, 0 degrees Celsius

examples.en: It will be below zero tonight.
The temperature is five degrees above zero.

senses.note: below zero = 영하, above zero = 영상. 미국은 화씨(Fahrenheit)를 쓰므로 미국 날씨에서 zero 는 섭씨 -18도쯤임.

senses.meaningEn: a fastener with two rows of metal or plastic teeth that you pull together to close clothes or bags

examples.en: The zipper on my bag is broken.
Pull the zipper up; it's cold.

senses.note: 미국식 zipper, 영국식 zip. 동사는 zip up(올리다)/unzip(내리다). 지퍼가 '걸리다' = The zipper is stuck.

senses.meaningEn: a place where many kinds of animals are kept for people to see

examples.en: Let's take the kids to the zoo on Sunday.
I saw a real lion at the zoo!

senses.note: go to the zoo / at the zoo 처럼 the 를 붙여 말함. 복수형은 zoos. 어수선한 곳을 비유해 'This place is a zoo!' 라고도 함.
